description:
**This is where** 
 your work makes a difference.
   

  

 At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
   

  

 Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
   

  

 Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Baxter’s Front Line Care business unit products expand therapies to better help patients and physicians to monitor \& manage chronic or acute respiratory and cardiac diseases (COPD, CHF, etc.). The earlier the treatment for these patients – the better the quality of life. The $1\.1B business portfolio includes products for airway clearance, cardiology \& patient monitors.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the overall technical direction and deliverables for Front Line Care products. Based on your significant technical expertise and leadership skills, you will also drive the full product development cycle from feasibility through lifecycle management. Assures that quality is built into the design during new product development. Proactively monitors the program and develops strategies to mitigate technical risks. Report on the progress on a routine cadence to senior management.
   

  

 The role of
 **Principal Engineer** 
 includes responsibility for developing creative solutions to challenging issues associated with the design, development, and sustaining engineering for our new and existing Front line care product portfolio. Possess solid “hands\-on” technical abilities, an excitement and energy for product development, and a passion for the work and the impact it has on meeting the needs of patients. In addition, you will also be responsible for application of human factors engineering principles to the design, development, and testing of medical products while working with cross\-functional program teams. This position is based out of Bangalore and reporting to the Manager, Systems Front\-Line Care.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* As a Principal Engineer Systems, responsible for end\-to\-end development \& sustenance of the product, from capturing the user/marketing needs to final product release. Interact with customers and marketing to develop and refine user requirements.
* System engineering plays a critical role in product development, making sure the product meets all the functional and performance requirements. He/ She is responsible for making sure the manufacturing and service requirements are translated into product design.
* Lead the development and documentation of the product systems architecture and systems level design, including the decomposition of the system architecture and requirements into subsystem and interface specifications.
* Hands on Experience and knowledge in requirements of IEC62366, 60601\-1, IEC62304 and associated guidance’s from FDA, EU MDR.
* Resolve competing constraints between interrelated functions (engineering, manufacturing, regulatory, marketing, etc.) required to deliver the product to market.
* Plan and execute system integration activities to minimize issues in systems verification and validation.
* Document traceability from requirements to verification activities, and from requirements to design entities.
* Resolve system\-related technical issues by applying problem solving tools such as cause\-and\-effect diagrams and Pareto charts
* Adheres to Baxter Quality Management system \& supports the quality audits.
* Plan, coordinate, perform, analyze and document study activities with focus on identifying user needs, intended user profiles, use environment and usability aspects.
* Analyze and define goals and requirements related to usability for the products.
* Plan, coordinate, perform, visualize and document concept of handling design
* Plan, perform and document evaluations of handling related product risks.
* Plan, perform, analyze and document usability evaluation activities according to scientifically accepted tools
* Identify and implement improvements to the internal processes within the competence area to secure that state of art is maintained
* Support in audits and assessments made by authorities and third parties
* Time and budget estimations for Human Factors activities where one or several resources are assigned.
* Identify and define internal and external customer needs, functions, performance, usability and safety requirement for product or solution with thorough knowledge and understanding constraints \- Business and Regulatory, Design trade\-offs and Risk assessment early in the development cycle working independently or under the guidance of senior staff.
* Excels in the development of Use Case for product or solution based on intimate knowledge of customers and their environments.
* Use tools such as DOORS and excels in the management of requirements and decomposition of system level requirements to modules.
* Carry out risk management process in accordance with the EN ISO 14971 throughout product life cycle to ensure compliance and product safety.
* Completes detailed, high\-quality technical documentation to capture and communicate designs.
* As Lead integrator for the product proactively look out for integration issues during development tests and ensure module / system development is successful.
* Actively engage with verification and validation engineers to aid in the development of verification scripts with good test coverage


**What You’ll Bring**
* Graduate or Post\-Graduate in Electrical, Mechanical, Biomedical, or related Engineering.
* An advanced technical degree is desired. Experience should include at least 8\-12 years of relevant technical experience, including some technical leadership.
* Must possess a strong knowledge of engineering disciplines like Risk Management and Usability / Human Factors Engineering and solid knowledge of related disciplines, Electro/Mechanical, Systems, Fluid Mechanics, Materials Science, blowers, pumps, and control systems
* Experience in Medical Device Development, FDA Regulations and MDR.
* Demonstrated excellent skills in Human Factors Engineering techniques.
* Demonstrated understanding and capabilities within user centered design.
* Comprehensive knowledge of applicable usability related to standards and regulations
* Ability to coach less experienced Human Factors Engineers. Expertise to Usability Engineering Process
* Ability to decompose complex problems into actionable tasks, Structured, systematic, result and quality\-oriented working.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with others in a team environment
* Understanding of and adherence to FDA, ISO and IEC design control procedures, regulations and standards.
* Demonstrated experience in accomplishing objectives.
* Able to deliver on multiple projects simultaneously
* Self\-motivated with good interpersonal skills
* A demonstrated track record in system development in Medical Devices or highly regulated products such as military hardware.
* Have a proven track record of management/leadership effectiveness in a fast\-paced environment. Proven ability to create results within budget, timeline, and product/project deliverables.
* Understanding manufacturing and design of electromechanical medical devices and systems.
* Familiarity with ISO, FDA, and other regulatory standards

**Description**
 Amazon is seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive the product strategy and execution for AWIPL — Amazon's only 1P retail entity for B2B in India. AWIPL exists to solve a fundamentally hard problem: the tools and playbooks that power Amazon's B2C businesses were never designed for the B2B operating model.
   

  

 This is a zero\-to\-one product role. You will not inherit a mature product with an established tech stack. You will define what needs to be built, work with stakeholders for prioritization across 20\+ cross\-functional partner teams, write the BRDs and PRFAQs that make the business case, and own delivery end\-to\-end across multiple concurrent initiatives
   

  

 AWIPL serves two distinct B2B customer segments: SSR customers (small sole proprietors and independent retailers) and CPS customers (large enterprises like Infosys procuring at scale). Each segment has different selection, pricing, fulfillment, and credit requirements, and neither is adequately served by existing Amazon B2C tooling. You will close that gap at the foundational level.
   

  

 The role carries broad scope and senior leadership visibility. You will present weekly to leadership team, align stakeholders across organizations, and operate in an environment where every product decision has a direct, measurable impact.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the AWIPL product roadmap acros, spanning tools parity and scalable growth capabilities
* Write PRFAQs, BRDs, and technical intake documents to secure engineering capacity from partner teams including WW AB Tech, SCOT, Recommerce, FC Ops, Tax Engine, and FinOps.
* Drive delivery of in\-flight initiatives:
* Define and execute the 3YF product vision.
* Leverage AI and automation to shift AWIPL from reactive firefighting to predictive decision\-making: WBR diagnostic platforms, causal knowledge graphs, predictive OOS models, and CPS deal workflow automation eliminating 100\+ hours/month of manual coordination.
* Communicate strategy, progress, and blockers to senior leaders weekly and align partner team leadership to prioritize AWIPL's roadmap asks above competing demands.


**About The Team**
 AWIPL is Amazon India's B2B retail entity, operating at the intersection of 1P retail and enterprise B2B. We are building Amazon Business India's supply chain from the ground up — solving problems that have no off\-the\-shelf answers, no existing playbooks, and no direct WW analogues. Our customers are Indian enterprises and retailers. Our opportunity is a $1\.2T Indian retail market with only 7% e\-commerce penetration and 15MM offline retailers underserved by traditional distribution.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
* Experience working in e\-commerce / retail / supply chain / financial services business
* Experience with AI/ML technologies
* Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience in new business or zero\-to\-one product environments

description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Every year, employers and employees spend more than $5 trillion on benefits globally. These products—from health insurance and retirement to fertility, mental health, telemedicine, and financial wellness—shape some of the most important decisions families make. Yet discovering, purchasing, and managing them remains fragmented, expensive, and confusing.
   

  

 Rippling is building the first modern benefits marketplace that connects brokers, employers, employees, and benefit providers in one platform. Our benefits vertical includes the Rippling Benefits Platform, a rapidly growing marketplace of more than 100 partners, Rippling\-native benefits products, and Rippling PEO.
   

  

 We are looking for a Growth Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace \& PEO to turn these product assets into a scaled growth engine. You will own the strategy and product roadmap to unlock growth by expanding the customers and benefit categories Rippling can serve. This role will play a central role increasing marketplace adoption and revenue.
   

  

 This is a highly cross\-functional, zero\-to\-one role at the intersection of product, growth and go\-to\-market. You will work with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Benefits Advisors, Business Development and Operations,. Success will be measured in business outcomes—including qualified demand, funnel conversion and revenue and not only in features shipped.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Own the growth strategy and corresponding product roadmap for the Benefits Marketplace and PEO, with a clear mandate to expand the addressable market.
* Execute product led growth plan across benefit categories, geographies, employer profiles, and distribution channels.
* Expand the marketplace's addressable market by identifying and prioritizing new customer segments based on unmet demand, revenue potential, strategic deal unlocks, and Rippling's right to win.
* Expand awareness and consideration for the Benefits Marketplace by improving how employers discover, understand, compare, and evaluate relevant benefits.
* Accelerate PEO top\-of\-funnel growth by increasing awareness, improving education and discovery, and creating high\-intent entry points that generate and qualify demand across organic, in\-product, partner, broker, and sales\-led channels.
* Expand PEO's TAM by identifying customer profiles and market opportunities Rippling does not serve well today, then shaping the positioning, packaging, product entry points, and cross\-functional investments needed to reach them.
* Translate the growth strategy into clear product requirements, prioritized bets, channel plans, and measurable top\-of\-funnel experiments—while partnering closely with downstream owners on clean handoffs and shared learning.


 What you will need
   

  

* 8\+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of growth in B2B products.
* A track record of delivering measurable business outcomes—such as revenue, conversion, retention, attach, adoption, supply growth — through a combination of product and go\-to\-market levers.
* Strong product judgment and commercial instincts: You can connect customer problems, market dynamics and growth strategy into coherent product capabilities.
* Excellent analytical skills: You can define a funnel, build a business case, segment customers and partners, evaluate experiments, and turn ambiguous data into clear decisions.
* Customer obsession: You are equally comfortable speaking with employers, employees, brokers, partners, sales teams, and operations —and translating their needs into scalable products.
* Strong technical fluency and systems thinking. You can work effectively with engineers on data models, integrations, AI\-powered workflows, operational tooling, and platform capabilities without losing sight of the customer or business outcome.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to align executives and cross\-functional teams around a strategy, metrics, priorities, and tradeoffs.
* A self\-starter with a bias toward action who thrives in a fast\-moving environment, creates clarity from ambiguity, and can shift between long\-range strategy and detailed execution.
* Experience in benefits, insurance, PEO, payroll, marketplaces, partner ecosystems, or B2B2C products is a strong plus.
* Founder or hypergrowth startup experience is a strong plus.
* Strong alignment with Rippling's leadership principles, especially Go and See and Are Right, a Lot.

title: Product Manager
description:
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent, technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to partner with a local in\-person engineering team in Bengaluru focused on music distribution. Distribution is the vital link between music creation and a fan’s headphones, ensuring our music reaches platforms like Spotify and YouTube globally while protecting the complex rights that ensure our artists get paid. You will be a "user\-first" thinker who is responsible for a portfolio of features and products, navigating the high\-stakes world of global rights, supply chain automation, and high\-scale digital delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Continuous Discovery: Build deep empathy for our labels, operations teams, and global partners by maintaining a constant dialogue with them. Uncover their underlying pain points, ensuring that every solution we build truly solves their problems and makes their daily workflows more seamless.
* Strategy \& Roadmap: Define and communicate the long\-term vision and roadmap for your products, ensuring they align with WMG’s broader tech strategy.
* Product Trio Collaboration: Work in a "Product Trio" alongside Engineering and Design to solve complex problems, resolving trade\-offs and tackling risks.
* Execution \& Ownership: Serve as the primary author of PRDs and the "executor\-in\-chief" for your projects, driving development from ideation through technical delivery.
* Launch \& Impact: Develop comprehensive go\-to\-market strategies, including product positioning, internal messaging, and launch plans. You don't just "ship" code; you ensure the organization is ready to adopt it to achieve maximum impact.
* Analytical Optimization: Continuously monitor product performance metrics, user feedback, and market trends. Use this data to make informed prioritization decisions, identify areas for improvement, and manage technical debt to optimize the product over its entire lifecycle.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to the music business or other digital media.
* Technical \& Business Savvy: You can discuss system architecture with engineers and business constraints with executives, mitigating Value, Usability, Feasibility, and Business Viability risks upfront.
* A Master Storyteller: You own the "Why" and can easily adjust your communication style for different audiences, from developers to more senior stakeholders.
* Biased to Action: You have a proven ability to unstick a team, make difficult prioritization decisions, and navigate the ambiguity of a global business.
* Humble Leader: You have strong opinions, held weakly; you are quick to share credit with your team and accept responsibility when things don’t go as planned.
* Mission\-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor**


Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

* To drive the strategy of IWPB Employee Banking Solutions for the allocated market
* To acquire, maintain relationships and increase product penetration within corporates by engaging with Key Influencers, by leading a team of 14\-15 Relationship Managers to drive EBS, Credit Cards, Personal Loans, Any time Credit and Top UP Medical Health Insurance ( BAGIC)
* To ensure that the quality of the corporates acquired are in line with the strategic focus of the Bank
* To ensure the team engages with existing EBS customers to increase penetration across various digital platforms (eg Mobile X \& PIB), IVR Card activations and salary credits.
* Drive open market business (Credit Cards, Personal Loans etc) through activities/deployments, promotions \& lead based calling.
* Develop a robust, diligent and compliant sales channel
* To liaise with product and support teams on a constant basis to enhance customer offerings and service delivery
* To adhere to all regulatory guidelines and handle complaints effectively.
* Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

 **Key activities to be driven**

* Work closely with both the GB/CMB RMs and MSF Business Development Managers (BDM) to engage with key decision makers of target corporates. Actively participate in presenting the HSBC EBS proposition with the objective to empanel them for the salary proposition
* Increase penetration of the corporates employee salary accounts with HSBC in the desired customer segments (Premier, personal Bankers)
* Make corporate work site marketing activities/deployments (WSMs) more interactive and effective
* Drive the overall asset strategy of WPB within the corporate space by identifying under penetrated opportunity segments, showcasing HSBCs offering and driving growth.
* Consistent delivery of the operating plan across all key products like EBS, Personal Banking accounts, PIL Cards, Premier Accounts)
* Controlling/lowering cost of acquisition within mandated cost guidelines

We are currently seeking a passionate and experienced professional to join our team.

title: Client Cyber Engineer - Product - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber helps clients navigate an increasingly complex and fast\-changing threat landscape. We simplify complexity, strengthen resilience, and enable organizations to grow with confidence while proactively managing cybersecurity risk.
   

  

**The Team**
 Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering team is building the technology foundation for the next generation of cybersecurity services. We bring together product thinking, engineering depth, and cybersecurity domain expertise to design and deploy modern platforms and AI\-enabled solutions for our clients. Join us as we build future\-ready capabilities with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 As a
 **Cyber Forward Deployed Engineering Manager** 
 , you will operate at the intersection of client delivery, engineering execution, and solution shaping. You will lead cross\-functional teams to design, build, and deploy high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions in client environments. This role requires strong technical depth, delivery ownership, and the ability to translate ambiguous business and cybersecurity needs into scalable, production\-ready solutions.
   

  

 You will be expected to manage workstreams end\-to\-end, guide architecture and engineering decisions, mentor engineers, and engage directly with client stakeholders to drive outcomes. You will also play a key role in pursuits, prototypes, and product feedback loops that shape reusable capabilities across Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering offerings.
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills**
**Core Engineering \& Architecture**
* 9–15 years of hands\-on experience in software engineering, including meaningful experience leading full\-stack engineering teams and complex technical deliveries.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Next.js.
* Strong backend development experience in Node.js, Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI), or Java (Spring Boot).
* Experience designing and delivering scalable applications using relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL technologies (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
* Deep experience building and integrating REST APIs, microservices, event\-driven services, and serverless architectures.
* Experience architecting and deploying cloud\-native applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based workflows, and engineering lifecycle tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Ability to make sound architecture decisions, evaluate trade\-offs, and enforce engineering quality, security, and maintainability standards.


**AI / GenAI Capabilities**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building and deploying GenAI, LLM, or agentic AI solutions in client, enterprise, or production environments.
* Experience with at least one frontier GenAI platform such as Anthropic, Google, or OpenAI, including hands\-on use of products such as Claude API, Claude Code, Gemini API, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Grounding, GPT\-4o, Responses API, Assistants API, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Strong understanding of AI application architectures, including orchestration, grounding, prompt workflows, model integration, evaluation, security, and operationalization.
* Ability to align application design and engineering pipelines to support AI\-enabled use cases in secure, scalable production settings.


**Client Leadership \& Delivery Ownership**
* Proven ability to independently lead defined workstreams or products end\-to\-end with high\-quality, timely delivery.
* Experience working directly with senior business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into architecture, roadmaps, and delivered solutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, reviewing designs and code, and driving accountability across delivery teams.
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on client outcomes, delivery rigor, and continuous improvement.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Familiarity with cybersecurity domains such as application security, cloud security, identity, SOC engineering, detection engineering, or cyber analytics.
* Experience in product engineering or platform engineering environments.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle.
* Exposure to search and analytics platforms such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and graph databases such as Neo4j.
* Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure as code, and advanced cloud\-native engineering patterns.
* Cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Experience supporting proposals, technical demos, proofs of concept, or early\-stage solution shaping in consulting or client\-facing environments.


**Work You Will Do**
* Solution Delivery \& Engineering Leadership
* Lead the design, development, and deployment of high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions aligned to client requirements, enterprise architecture, and security expectations.
* Own technical delivery across one or more workstreams, including planning, architecture, issue resolution, quality management, and execution oversight.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Identify technical risks, delivery dependencies, and design trade\-offs early, and drive mitigation plans to maintain delivery confidence.
* Establish and uphold engineering best practices across code quality, documentation, testing, observability, and security.
* Client Engagement \& Solution Shaping
* Partner with client stakeholders to define technical approaches, clarify requirements, and shape pragmatic, scalable solutions to cybersecurity challenges.
* Support pursuits and pre\-sales efforts through technical storytelling, demos, prototypes, architecture inputs, and feasibility assessments.
* Influence solution direction by balancing client priorities, engineering practicality, cybersecurity requirements, and reusable platform opportunities.
* Act as a trusted technical leader who can bridge business goals and engineering execution.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Mentor and develop engineers through coaching, design reviews, and day\-to\-day delivery leadership.
* Promote a strong team culture centered on accountability, collaboration, learning, and engineering excellence.
* Help teams adopt delivery discipline, reusable patterns, and effective operating rhythms to improve execution quality and speed.
* Product Feedback \& Continuous Improvement
* Capture delivery insights and translate them into reusable product, platform, or engineering improvements.
* Distinguish between client\-specific customization and scalable enhancements that can strengthen Deloitte’s broader Cyber Engineering capabilities.
* Enable client teams and internal teams through structured knowledge transfer, practical documentation, and durable runbooks.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: Product Owner - Insurance (6 to 8 years)
description:
Job Description: Product Owner – Insurance Domain  

  

Position Description  

Company Profile:  

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: Product Owner \- Insurance
  

Position: Senior/Lead Software Engineer  

Experience: 6 \+ Years  

Category: Software Development/ Engineering  

Shift: Timing/rotation etc. details  

Main location: India, Karnataka, Bangalore and Hyderabad.  

Employment Type: Full Time  

Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 3 years of relevant experience.  

  

Position Summary  

We are seeking an experienced Product Owner with 6\+ years of overall experience, including strong exposure to the insurance domain and Agile product delivery. The Product Owner will be responsible for translating business needs into clear product requirements, managing and prioritizing the product backlog, and working closely with business stakeholders, architects, engineering, quality assurance, and implementation teams to deliver high quality insurance solutions.  

The ideal candidate should have a sound understanding of insurance products, rating processes, policy administration, underwriting, and product configuration. Experience with Ratabase will be an added advantage.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

. Own and manage the product backlog in alignment with the product vision, roadmap, client priorities, and business objectives.  

. Work with insurance business stakeholders, subject matter experts, clients, and internal teams to gather, analyze, and document requirements.  

. Convert business requirements into clear and actionable: Epics Features User stories Acceptance criteria Business rules Process flows  

. Prioritize backlog items based on business value, client impact, risk, dependencies, regulatory requirements, and delivery capacity.  

. Ensure user stories are sufficiently refined and ready for sprint planning and development.  

. Collaborate with engineering, architecture, UX, quality assurance, infrastructure, and implementation teams throughout the product development lifecycle.  

. Participate in Agile ceremonies, including: Backlog refinement Sprint planning Daily stand ups Sprint reviews and demonstrations Retrospectives Program Increment planning, where applicable  

. Clarify functional requirements and provide timely decisions to development and testing teams.  

. Define acceptance criteria and review completed features to ensure they meet business and functional expectations.  

. Support functional testing, defect triage, user acceptance testing, release readiness, and production implementation activities.  

. Evaluate defects and enhancement requests based on severity, business impact, and product strategy.  

. Maintain product documentation, requirement traceability, release scope, and stakeholder communication.  

. Identify dependencies, risks, assumptions, and gaps early in the delivery lifecycle and drive them to resolution.  

. Monitor product adoption, quality, client feedback, and delivery outcomes to support continuous improvement.  

. Contribute to product roadmap planning and provide inputs for effort estimation, release planning, and prioritization.  

. Ensure delivered functionality complies with insurance business rules, audit requirements, security standards, and applicable regulations.  

. Stay informed about insurance industry trends, digital transformation, automation, and emerging technologies.  

  



**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Required Qualifications and Experience  

  

. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Insurance, or a related field.  

. 6\+ years of overall experience in business analysis, product ownership, product management, or software delivery.  

. At least 3 years of experience working as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or equivalent role in an Agile software development environment.  

. Strong experience in the insurance domain, preferably Property and Casualty insurance.  

. Good understanding of one or more of the following: Insurance product configuration Rating and premium calculation Underwriting rules Policy lifecycle Quotes, endorsements, renewals, cancellations, and reinstatements Forms and filings Rules, rates, factors, tables, and formulas Policy administration systems

description:

 **Cyber Forward Deployed Engineering Manager** 
 , you will operate at the intersection of client delivery, engineering execution, and solution shaping. You will lead cross\-functional teams to design, build, and deploy high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions in client environments. This role requires strong technical depth, delivery ownership, and the ability to translate ambiguous business and cybersecurity needs into scalable, production\-ready solutions.
   

  

 You will be expected to manage workstreams end\-to\-end, guide architecture and engineering decisions, mentor engineers, and engage directly with client stakeholders to drive outcomes. You will also play a key role in pursuits, prototypes, and product feedback loops that shape reusable capabilities across Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering offerings.
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills**

* Strong familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based workflows, and engineering lifecycle tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub.

**AI / GenAI Capabilities**

* Strong understanding of AI application architectures, including orchestration, grounding, prompt workflows, model integration, evaluation, security, and operationalization.
* Ability to align application design and engineering pipelines to support AI\-enabled use cases in secure, scalable production settings.


**Client Leadership \& Delivery Ownership**
* Proven ability to independently lead defined workstreams or products end\-to\-end with high\-quality, timely delivery.
* Experience working directly with senior business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into architecture, roadmaps, and delivered solutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, reviewing designs and code, and driving accountability across delivery teams.
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on client outcomes, delivery rigor, and continuous improvement.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Familiarity with cybersecurity domains such as application security, cloud security, identity, SOC engineering, detection engineering, or cyber analytics.
* Experience in product engineering or platform engineering environments.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle.
* Exposure to search and analytics platforms such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and graph databases such as Neo4j.
* Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure as code, and advanced cloud\-native engineering patterns.
* Cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Experience supporting proposals, technical demos, proofs of concept, or early\-stage solution shaping in consulting or client\-facing environments.


**Work You Will Do**
* Solution Delivery \& Engineering Leadership
* Lead the design, development, and deployment of high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions aligned to client requirements, enterprise architecture, and security expectations.
* Own technical delivery across one or more workstreams, including planning, architecture, issue resolution, quality management, and execution oversight.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Identify technical risks, delivery dependencies, and design trade\-offs early, and drive mitigation plans to maintain delivery confidence.
* Establish and uphold engineering best practices across code quality, documentation, testing, observability, and security.
* Client Engagement \& Solution Shaping
* Partner with client stakeholders to define technical approaches, clarify requirements, and shape pragmatic, scalable solutions to cybersecurity challenges.
* Support pursuits and pre\-sales efforts through technical storytelling, demos, prototypes, architecture inputs, and feasibility assessments.
* Influence solution direction by balancing client priorities, engineering practicality, cybersecurity requirements, and reusable platform opportunities.

**Education**

title: Product Owner
description:
#### **About Tripstack**


Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019\. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining.


Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform \- giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non\-partner, low\-cost and full\-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost\-effective API.
Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily.
Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection.  

For more information, visit:  

www.tripstack.com
www.etraveligroup.com##### **The role**


As a Product Owner at Tripstack, you'll report into a Product Manager serving as an operational leader and product strategist for your portfolio within the Content Acquisition team.


You will oversee the integration and operation of flight content into our platform, ensuring we maintain world\-leading content at the highest possible quality while keeping our systems stable and performant.

##### **Job Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership \& Incident Management**

* Own end\-to\-end operational performance of your assigned content portfolio (APIs, consolidators, or scrapes), ensuring system stability, SLA adherence, and production health
* Lead incident management and structured RCA (root cause analysis) investigations for any issues; drive resolution tracking and prevention of recurring production issues
* Define, monitor, and proactively manage operational KPIs: uptime, latency, booking failures, error rates, conversion impact, and portfolio risks
* Act as primary operational escalation point for airline\-related issues, coordinating rapidly across engineering, product teams, and external airline partners

**Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Priority Management**

* Facilitate resource planning and allocation decisions with your engineering team; identify constraints and trade\-offs
* Manage the balance between competing priorities (new feature development, production support, incident response, and ad\-hoc requests)
* Define and communicate clear priorities to engineering teams \- including what gets deprioritized and why
* Coordinate all team standups, sprint planning, ROMs (Rough Order of Magnitude reviews), and alignment meetings
* Track dependencies, blockers, and risks; escalate appropriately and coordinate cross\-team resolution
* Monitor sprint velocity, deliverables, and team output; continuously optimize processes for delivery efficiency

**Stakeholder Alignment \& Communication**

* Align internal stakeholders (engineering, product leadership, data teams) and external partners (Etraveli Group, airlines, consolidators) around priorities, timelines, and expectations
* Communicate operational status, KPIs, and business decisions clearly and concisely \- orally and in writing
* Facilitate regular sync meetings with engineering leadership, other product teams, and stakeholders
* Prepare status reports, milestone updates, and analytics dashboards for leadership visibility

**Product Definition \& Requirements**

* Translate high\-level business objectives and customer needs into clear, well\-documented product requirements and user stories
* Define acceptance criteria and work with QA to establish test cases
* Establish acceptance criteria and work with QA teams to build comprehensive test cases
* Create reusable components and standardized approaches across recipe integrations to improve quality and reduce duplicative work

**Strategic Analysis \& Decision\-Making**

* Conduct data\-backed analysis to inform prioritization decisions; evaluate impact against business value
* Work with architects, engineering managers, and product leaders to assess technical feasibility and design efficient solutions
* Identify opportunities for improvement in security, CI/CD, quality, and performance practices
* Monitor KPIs tied to product decisions and iterate based on results
* Root cause analysis of systemic product issues and recommend structural improvements

**Partnership with Engineering \& Architecture**

* Collaborate with engineering leads on solution architecture, ensuring alignment between product vision and technical implementation
* Work with platform and engineering teams to identify and resolve technical blockers
* Support architecture decisions that balance speed of delivery with long\-term platform health

##### **Job Requirements**

* **3\+ years hands\-on experience in a product or program management role with significant operational responsibility**
* Strong project management and organizational skills with ability to juggle multiple competing priorities
* Excellent communication skills across technical teams, product teams, and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strategic thinker with strong experience in data\-backed decision making
* Comfort with ambiguity; ability to move fast and make decisions with incomplete information
* Leadership skills: ability to bring teams together toward a common purpose and coordinate across multiple teams

**Technical \& Industry Knowledge**

* **Knowledge of software architecture, REST, cloud platforms, platform engineering, and microservices**
* Experience working as a hands\-on QA engineer or application developer would be advantageous
* Travel industry experience \- particularly with airline APIs, NDC standards, or GDS/PSS systems
* Experience building airline or flight content integrations
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring tools, and production observability platforms

**Personal Attributes**

* Output and delivery driven; results\-oriented mindset
* Resilient with ability to thrive under pressure and competing demands
* Proficient in communication: clear, concise, and professional across contexts
* Passion for problem\-solving, root cause analysis, and operational excellence
* Highly accountable team player; takes ownership of outcomes

##### **Benefits**


We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high\-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world\-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!


At Tripstack, we proudly believe in embracing diversity. This is true for our team, clients, communities and stakeholders. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating a safe, healthy and accessible environment. We encourage applications regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other grounds protected by law. Please let us know if you need any accommodations during any part of the recruitment process.


Tripstack thanks all applicants for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.  

  

Learn more about us at www.tripstack.com

title: Senior AI Product Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced **AI Product Manager** who can operate at the intersection of product, technology, client engagement, and execution. This is a high\-ownership, enterprise\-facing role for someone who is excited by the opportunity to shape cutting\-edge AI applications, work directly with international clients, and translate complex business problems into scalable AI\-enabled products.


The AI Product Manager will lead the definition, shaping, and execution of enterprise AI products and features for global clients. This role requires a rare mix of product judgment, AI fluency, consulting maturity, and hands\-on problem solving. You will work closely with clients, engineering teams, designers, and delivery leaders to identify opportunities, define product direction, manage expectations, and bring AI\-first solutions to life.


The ideal candidate understands how to apply GenAI and agentic patterns in enterprise contexts, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and is hands\-on enough to prototype ideas, validate concepts quickly, and sharpen requirements through action. This is not a purely roadmap or coordination role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, engage credibly with clients, and get into the detail when needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product definition and execution of enterprise AI applications, workflows, and features from discovery through release and adoption.
* Work directly with clients and internal stakeholders to identify business problems, frame opportunities, and convert them into clear product requirements and delivery plans.
* Shape AI\-first user experiences, including copilots, assistants, agentic workflows, decision\-support tools, and human\-in\-the\-loop enterprise applications.
* Translate ambiguous business needs into structured product artifacts such as problem statements, user journeys, PRDs, acceptance criteria, prioritization frameworks, and release scope.
* Partner closely with engineering, UX, architecture, and delivery teams to ensure product intent is translated into practical, scalable solutions.
* Drive workshops, requirement discovery sessions, stakeholder reviews, demos, and alignment discussions with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
* Build lightweight prototypes, proof\-of\-concepts, and product mock flows using modern AI tools, no\-code/low\-code methods, vibe coding, and basic design/prototyping techniques where useful.
* Help define and refine AI use cases involving agents, orchestration, retrieval, workflow automation, and enterprise system integration.
* Maintain a sharp eye for detail across business requirements, product behavior, user experience, and delivery quality.
* Manage client expectations proactively by balancing ambition, technical feasibility, timelines, and delivery realities.
* Support value realization and account growth by identifying follow\-on product opportunities, expansion areas, and innovation pathways within client accounts.
* Contribute to a product and delivery culture that values speed, clarity, experimentation, accountability, and customer impact.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Enterprise AI products and features are clearly defined, well\-prioritized, and shipped with strong adoption potential.
* Clients see you as a credible product partner who understands both business value and execution constraints.
* Product requirements are crisp, actionable, and reduce ambiguity for delivery teams.
* AI use cases move beyond demos into usable workflows that solve real operational problems.
* Teams make faster, better decisions because product direction, scope, and trade\-offs are well managed.
* Client confidence improves through strong communication, attention to detail, and disciplined expectation management.
* You help create momentum for account expansion by spotting practical product and AI opportunities that clients want to invest in.

  

**Requirements**  

* + 7–14 years of experience in ProApplication formDesign the application form for this role.duct Management, Business Analysis, Consulting, Enterprise Software, Digital Products, or related technology roles.
	+ Demonstrated experience working on software products, platforms, or enterprise applications in client\-facing environments.
	+ Good understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, with practical exposure to AI\-enabled product design and delivery.
	+ Exposure to building or shaping **agent\-based / agentic workflows** or AI\-driven assistants/copilots in a product or solution context.
	+ Strong experience in requirements discovery, user story definition, prioritization, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional execution.
	+ Ability to engage confidently with enterprise clients, business users, engineering teams, and senior internal stakeholders.
	+ Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and present with clarity.
	+ High attention to detail and the ability to manage product quality and client expectations in parallel.
	+ A hands\-on mindset with the willingness to prototype, experiment, and validate ideas quickly rather than rely only on documentation.
	+ Comfort working in ambiguous, fast\-evolving environments where AI capabilities, client needs, and product direction are still being shaped.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* + Prior experience in a consulting or client advisory environment is highly desirable.
	+ Exposure to enterprise domains and business applications is preferred.
	+ Experience supporting **farming\-led account expansion**, identifying opportunities within existing accounts, or helping grow strategic client relationships is a strong plus.
	+ Background as a Software Engineer or strong technical foundation is preferred.
	+ Familiarity with enterprise workflow systems, platform integrations, business process automation, or complex multi\-stakeholder applications is a plus.
	+ Experience creating basic prototypes independently using AI coding tools, prompt\-based development, wireframing, or lightweight design tools.
	+ Strong educational background from top\-tier institutions is preferred, including **IIMs**, **IITs, BIT Mesra, BITS Pilani, top NITs,** or equivalent institutions.

**Skills and Capability Areas**

* + AI product thinking and practical GenAI application
	+ Agentic workflow understanding and AI feature conceptualization
	+ Enterprise product management and requirements rigor
	+ Client\-facing communication and consulting maturity
	+ Hands\-on prototyping, experimentation, and validation
	+ Cross\-functional collaboration with engineering, UX, and delivery
	+ Strong execution discipline and attention to detail
	+ Commercial awareness and account growth mindset

**Who Will Thrive Here**

* + You are likely to thrive in this role if you are someone who enjoys building in fast\-moving environments, likes solving messy enterprise problems, and can move comfortably between strategy and execution. You are structured but not rigid, hands\-on but not narrow, and client\-focused without losing product depth. You bring ownership, curiosity, and pragmatism. You know how to earn trust in a room, ask the right questions, and turn ambiguity into action.
	+ You should also enjoy working at the frontier of enterprise AI, where the best solutions require not only product thinking and technical awareness, but also judgment, experimentation, and strong partnership with clients and delivery teams.

**Why Join Accellor**

title: Digital Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

As a Digital Product Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the processes related to the definition and delivery of digital products. You will develop functional specifications, including capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, based on feedback from internal and external stakeholders. You will collaborate with business and technology teams to define product strategy, prioritize features, and drive successful product delivery.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Define and lead product strategy and roadmap for digital healthcare and pharmacy solutions

* Manage and prioritize the product backlog and ensure alignment with business objectives
* Collaborate with engineering teams to evaluate capabilities, define solution alternatives, and prioritize product releases
* Effectively communicate product vision, roadmap, and feature requirements to development teams
* Work closely with UX and engineering teams to shape product design and user experience
* Generate release notes, demo scripts, and conduct product demonstrations for stakeholders and clients
* Independently identify and analyze relevant data to support product decisions and business cases
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of product capabilities and feature requirements
* Drive continuous improvement by acting on feedback received during retrospectives and product reviews
* Identify potential risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies
* Foster a culture of innovation across the product portfolio
* Collaborate effectively with onsite and offshore teams to assess requirements and deliver solutions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Allied Health Sciences, MCA, or a related field
* 5\+ years of IT industry experience, including at least 3 years in Healthcare Informatics, Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analysis roles
* Experience in Healthcare, Pharmacy, PBM (Pharmacy Benefit Management), or related healthcare technology domains
* Experience defining capabilities, features, user stories, wireframes, and acceptance criteria
* Proven experience managing product backlogs and working within Agile product development frameworks
* Experience collaborating with development teams throughout feature implementation and delivery
* Solid understanding of healthcare workflows, pharmacy systems, prescription adjudication, specialty pharmacy operations, and member journeys
* Proven solid analytical, logical reasoning, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Proven excellent verbal and written communication skills

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA or advanced degree in Business, Technology, Healthcare, or a related discipline
* Experience with voice, digital, self\-service, IVR, contact center, chatbot, conversational AI, or customer engagement platforms
* Experience launching MVPs and managing products through the entire product lifecycle
* Hands\-on experience with Jira, Rally, Aha!, or similar product management and requirements management tools
* Knowledge of OptumRx domain, prescription adjudication systems, specialty pharmacy subsystems, and prescription member workflows

 **About OptumRx**


OptumRx specializes in the delivery, clinical management, and affordability of prescription medications and consumer health products. Our goal is to deliver high\-quality, integrated services that promote optimal outcomes, superior savings, and outstanding client and consumer experiences.


At Optum, we are dedicated to helping make the health system work better for everyone. As part of a global organization, you'll have the opportunity to work on innovative healthcare solutions that impact millions of lives while collaborating with talented teams across business and technology.


Join us and help shape the future of healthcare through digital innovation.

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
**About Rippling** 




 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
 



 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
 



**Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.** 




  





**We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.** 




  





**About the role** 



* Every year, employers and employees spend more than $5 trillion on benefits globally. These products—from health insurance and retirement to fertility, mental health, telemedicine, and financial wellness—shape some of the most important decisions families make. Yet discovering, purchasing, and managing them remains fragmented, expensive, and confusing.
* Rippling is building the first modern benefits marketplace that connects brokers, employers, employees, and benefit providers in one platform. Our benefits vertical includes the Rippling Benefits Platform, a rapidly growing marketplace of more than 100 partners, Rippling\-native benefits products, and Rippling PEO.
* We are looking for a Growth Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace \& PEO to turn these product assets into a scaled growth engine. You will own the strategy and product roadmap to unlock growth by expanding the customers and benefit categories Rippling can serve. This role will play a central role increasing marketplace adoption and revenue.
* This is a highly cross\-functional, zero\-to\-one role at the intersection of product, growth and go\-to\-market. You will work with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Benefits Advisors, Business Development and Operations,. Success will be measured in business outcomes—including qualified demand, funnel conversion and revenue and not only in features shipped.



  





**What you'll do** 



* Own the growth strategy and corresponding product roadmap for the Benefits Marketplace and PEO, with a clear mandate to expand the addressable market.
* Execute product led growth plan across benefit categories, geographies, employer profiles, and distribution channels.
* Expand the marketplace's addressable market by identifying and prioritizing new customer segments based on unmet demand, revenue potential, strategic deal unlocks, and Rippling's right to win.
* Expand awareness and consideration for the Benefits Marketplace by improving how employers discover, understand, compare, and evaluate relevant benefits.
* Accelerate PEO top\-of\-funnel growth by increasing awareness, improving education and discovery, and creating high\-intent entry points that generate and qualify demand across organic, in\-product, partner, broker, and sales\-led channels.
* Expand PEO's TAM by identifying customer profiles and market opportunities Rippling does not serve well today, then shaping the positioning, packaging, product entry points, and cross\-functional investments needed to reach them.
* Translate the growth strategy into clear product requirements, prioritized bets, channel plans, and measurable top\-of\-funnel experiments—while partnering closely with downstream owners on clean handoffs and shared learning.



  





**What you will need** 



* 8\+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of growth in B2B products.
* A track record of delivering measurable business outcomes—such as revenue, conversion, retention, attach, adoption, supply growth — through a combination of product and go\-to\-market levers.
* Strong product judgment and commercial instincts: You can connect customer problems, market dynamics and growth strategy into coherent product capabilities.
* Excellent analytical skills: You can define a funnel, build a business case, segment customers and partners, evaluate experiments, and turn ambiguous data into clear decisions.
* Customer obsession: You are equally comfortable speaking with employers, employees, brokers, partners, sales teams, and operations —and translating their needs into scalable products.
* Strong technical fluency and systems thinking. You can work effectively with engineers on data models, integrations, AI\-powered workflows, operational tooling, and platform capabilities without losing sight of the customer or business outcome.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to align executives and cross\-functional teams around a strategy, metrics, priorities, and tradeoffs.
* A self\-starter with a bias toward action who thrives in a fast\-moving environment, creates clarity from ambiguity, and can shift between long\-range strategy and detailed execution.
* Experience in benefits, insurance, PEO, payroll, marketplaces, partner ecosystems, or B2B2C products is a strong plus.
* Founder or hypergrowth startup experience is a strong plus.
* Strong alignment with Rippling's leadership principles, especially Go and See and Are Right, a Lot.

 Are you passionate about building products that solve real customer problems at massive scale? As a Sr. Product Manager \- Identity at Amazon, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for products that directly shape our abuse prevention and CX strategy by building robust customer identity solutions. You will work backward from customer needs, define compelling product strategies, and partner with engineering, design, and cross\-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes. description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.
