description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Specialist III, Technical Product Manager**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 This role leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a technical product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the product(s). Products may have enterprise\-wide implications. This role also uses market insights to evaluate product functionality and informs the future product direction based on consumer trends and product performance.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Leads technical product management activities for multiple technical products, or one strategic technical product. Participates in the design and continuous improvement of the technical solution.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to create best practices that drive significant change to the client experience.
* Coaches’ technical product teams towards best practices and learnings. Ensures delivery of messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Partners with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues in a timely manner, and supports/drives escalations where required to enable rapid delivery.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of new technical products. Defines and analyzes technical markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and provides recommendations for ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in the team’s engineering practices in development, continuous integration, and automated deployment.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages the entire product life cycle from planning to execution in alignment with business goals and strategy.
* Researches and analyzes market conditions to identify key consumer trends and opportunities for product enhancements or innovation.
* Determines product features and functions by gathering business and customer feedback and translating it into product requirements.
* Prepares product documentation and supports go\-to\-market activities by providing product knowledge to sales and marketing teams.
* Leverages market and performance feedback to evaluate product effectiveness and steer future product direction.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders

description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Team Summary:
   

  

 Client Services provides industry\-leading operational support to Visa’s clients around the world. With our deep knowledge and expertise, we bring the voice of the customer into the design, development and successful deployment of Visa products and services. We are trusted partners to Visa’s clients, providing expertise to support and successfully grow their business.
   

  

 The AP Go\-To\-Market Services team shapes transformative client service experiences for new product solutions and leads the charge in delivering seamless, end\-to\-end implementations of Value\-Added offerings to ensure clients’ success.
   

  

**What a Consultant, GTMS Service Experience Does At Visa**
 AP Go\-To\-Market Services team is a dedicated team partners with Product and Technology to support client focused product and solution development while advocating for the Client and Client Services team. We enable Client and Client Services teams to successfully deploy and support products solutions in a consistent, scalable as well as repeatable way across Asia Pacific (AP) region.
   

  

 This role is responsible for delivering services and enabling complex initiatives that lack predefined instructions, through individual contributions and matrix management. It includes partnering with Product teams to understand the strategic roadmap and interpreting and communicating both Client Services priorities and client needs. This role holder will be defining the support and implementation plan, executing initial pilot clients or use cases and defining a plan to migrate support to core Client Services teams with a focus on operational efficiency and scaling to support the product pipeline.
   

  

**In This Role, You Are Expected To**
* Design and enable delivery of a scalable, repeatable and effective client service experience from implementation to support for new products and solutions, while anticipating and planning for deviations to intended experience
* Define transition plans to migrate support to wider Client Services teams with a focus on operational efficiency and optimization
* Partner with Product and Technology teams to develop artifacts, training materials and presentations for the Client Services team
* Be the primary liaison with various Product and Technology team to identify client impacts, support and implementation gaps, assist in resolution of gaps prior to product rollouts
* Manage and execute new product and solutions pilot deployment, lead as Project manager to coordinate directly with pilot clients to analyze services and platform requirements to support the business and formulate implementation solutions
* Act as the “voice of the customer” internally to continually enhance the service experience
* Execute key initiatives that may impact clients from a business operations perspective including changes to current products, business and digital release cycle
* Stay current with industry and client trends and maintain a strong knowledge of Visa products and services
* Embrace and implement new methodologies on an ongoing basis as the business scales within the organization
* Responsible for own workflow assignments and must be able to be a fast responder and be proactive in resolving problems and meeting deadlines
* Constantly create good functional collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
* Be an active contributor in the creation of a high\-performing, supportive, and inclusive team culture.


**Why This Is Important To Visa**
 The Visa Acceptance Platform, also known as Cybersource, is an important part of Visa’s Value\-Added Services and broader payments ecosystem. This role supports Visa’s strategy by helping clients successfully implement and adopt Cybersource solutions, while designing consistent and scalable service experiences from implementation through post\-launch support. By partnering with Product, Technology, Client Services, and clients, the role helps strengthen implementation readiness, improve the client experience, and support Visa’s continued growth in digital payments and acceptance solutions.
   

  

 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 What you will need:
   

  

**About**
 We are looking for an individual who brings breadth of experience, a curiosity about payments, is results\-driven and client focused. As a candidate, you should have:
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree with at least 8\+ years of experience in product or project management or product development in the payments industry
* Functional project management experience in a client facing role
* Working knowledge of core transaction processing (message routing, authorization, clearing and settlement)
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to absorb technical information and apply to business solutions where little or no precedence exists. Be able to communicate complex, technical concepts in a focused and well\-organized manner
* Willingness to take on new challenges in a fast\-paced environment and be flexible with multi\-tasking and changing priorities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, problem solving skills, attention to detail and interpersonal skills in negotiating and influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Organized self\-starter, client\-centric, analytic, collaborative, understands and can translate complex issues and speaking to impact and priority
* Excellent client engagement and relationship management skills with collaborative approach to stakeholder management
* Be able to learn and acquire knowledge in new technologies in keeping step with market developments


**What Will Also Help**
* Subject Matter Expertise in multiple areas such as card payments, products and services, payment technologies, wallet services gained through years of experience supporting clients and new product initiatives within a payment\-processing environment
* Experience of working with Issuers, Acquirers, and Processors in the Asia Pacific region
* Team collaboration demonstrated by desire and willingness to share knowledge with a broader team, be receptive to new ideas and changes to the standard operational procedures


**Projects You Will Be a Part Of**
 This is an incredibly exciting time to join the AP Go\-To\-Market Services team. You will be operating in a fast paced, unstructured setting to support new Visa Net Infrastructure, VAS products, solutions and be part of the bi\-annual Business Enhancement Release working team. You will work with Client Services team and Visa clients to deploy new product solutions or use cases, system enhancements and future strategic product launches by collaborating with a high performing team.
   

  

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Online Product Leader
description:
Bengaluru, India Full\-Time Lead**About this role**
-------------------


Mission Brief: Own the World's Most Intelligent Online Eyewear Business
This is not a conventional e\-commerce leadership role. This is your opportunity to architect and own the entire digital growth engine of a global eyewear tech company — one that is redefining how hundreds of millions of people experience vision care.  

As the Online Product Leader, you will own the full Online P\&L across India and Lenskart's international markets, and you will build the AI\-powered commercial machine that drives it. You will move us from campaign\-driven growth to a real\-time, intelligence\-led revenue system — where every rupee of media spend, every digital touchpoint, and every customer interaction is optimised by data and AI.
Your mandate: make Lenskart the most commercially effective and customer\-obsessed digital eyewear brand on the planet.  

Core Mandate
1\. Own the P\&L. Define the Roadmap.* Take full end\-to\-end ownership of the Online P\&L across all channels and geographies — India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and beyond.
* Build and execute a forward\-looking online growth roadmap that works backward from deep consumer insight, not internal assumptions.
* Integrate marketplace and quick commerce into the core business architecture — not as side channels, but as scaled, intelligent revenue streams.


2\. Build an AI\-First Performance Marketing Engine* Lead the transformation of Lenskart's performance marketing from manual optimisation to an AI\-driven acquisition and retention engine — across Meta, Google, Programmatic, Affiliates, and emerging channels.
* Deploy sophisticated LTV\-based audience modelling, predictive cohort targeting, and AI\-powered bidding strategies to maximise return on every dollar of media spend.
* Develop and own the frameworks for AI\-assisted creative testing and real\-time campaign optimisation at scale.
* Scale marketplace and quick commerce presence through intelligent catalogue management, algorithmic ranking strategies, and demand\-signal\-driven inventory positioning.


3\. Lead a Global Online Team* Provide strategic direction and operational clarity to regional online channel teams across markets.
* Ensure each market accelerates its own growth trajectory while staying coherent with global brand, tech, and operational standards.
* Build a team culture where speed, data fluency, and customer obsession are non\-negotiable defaults.


4\. Drive AI\-Powered Product \& Experience Innovation* Partner with Product and Tech to embed AI deeply into the customer journey — from intelligent search and personalised recommendations to virtual try\-on and AI\-led conversion optimisation.
* Champion a culture of continuous experimentation: own the A/B testing roadmap, accelerate learning velocity, and ensure every insight compounds into measurable conversion and retention uplift.
* Define and deliver the digital experience standard that makes Lenskart's web and app not just functional — but genuinely delightful and differentiated.


5\. Turn Data Into Decisions, at Speed* Build and operate a real\-time performance intelligence system — dashboards, funnels, cohort analyses — that enables the team to make high\-quality decisions in hours, not weeks.
* Own growth forecasting, customer segmentation, and hyper\-targeted audience strategies that power scalable, profitable marketing.
* Move the organisation from reactive reporting to predictive, AI\-assisted growth operations.


6\. Connect the Entire Value Chain* Work hand\-in\-hand with Supply Chain, Category, CX, Merchandising, and Creative to ensure every online touchpoint is backed by seamless operational execution.
* Be the connective tissue between commercial ambition and operational reality — ensuring the customer experience is consistent, compelling, and continuously improving.

  

The Essentials
Commercial Ownership at Scale: You have held full P\&L accountability for a large\-scale digital business — and you have delivered aggressive, sustainable revenue growth while managing cost discipline.
AI \& Data Fluency: You don't just commission data analyses — you understand how AI and ML can be applied to performance marketing, personalisation, forecasting, and customer experience. You've either built or led teams that have deployed these capabilities in production.
Performance Marketing Depth: You have managed large, complex media budgets across search and social, and you have led the shift from manual to algorithmic and AI\-assisted campaign management.
Multi\-channel Architecture: You have scaled revenue across owned digital channels (web, app), third\-party marketplaces, and rapid\-delivery platforms — simultaneously, not sequentially.
Customer Experience Instinct: You obsess over the digital journey. You can identify friction at a granular level and move fast to eliminate it — using data, design, and product thinking together.
Cross\-functional Influence: You have a track record of aligning supply chain, creative, and engineering teams behind a single commercial vision — across geographies and cultures.  

The Mindset
Builder, not Manager. You are energised by the opportunity to construct something new — a smarter, faster, more intelligent online business — not just to optimise what already exists.
AI\-Native Thinker. You see AI not as a feature to add, but as the foundational layer through which growth is designed. You are curious about what is possible, and you move fast to test it.
Commercially Fearless. You are comfortable with ambitious targets and the accountability that comes with them. You set the bar high for yourself and for your team.
Customer\-Backward. You make every strategic decision by starting with the customer — their needs, their friction points, their moments of delight — and working backwards to the business model.
Globally Curious. You thrive in multi\-market complexity. You understand that what works in one market is a hypothesis in another, and you build systems that can learn and adapt.**Details**

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.

 • Make timely product decisions and provide clarification throughout the development lifecycle.
 



 • Review delivered capabilities against agreed requirements, acceptance criteria, and intended customer outcomes.
 



 • Balance new capabilities with technical enablers, quality improvements, security requirements, and technical debt.
 



  





  





**Product Discovery and Collaboration** 




 • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, UX, and other stakeholders to understand and validate customer problems.
 



 • Support product discovery through customer feedback, technical investigations, prototypes, and incremental validation.
 



 • Collaborate with other Product Owners to manage dependencies and ensure alignment across teams.
 



 • Understand technical constraints and trade\-offs sufficiently to support effective prioritization and product decisions.
 



 • Identify dependencies, risks, edge cases, and operational considerations early in the development process.
 



  





**Agile Planning and Execution** 




 • Participate in roadmap refinement, PI Planning, iteration planning, backlog refinement, demos, retrospectives, and Inspect \& Adapt activities where applicable.
 



 • Ensure features and stories are sufficiently prepared ahead of planning and development.
 



 • Coordinate priorities and dependencies across teams.
 



 • Track progress toward product outcomes and adjust priorities based on customer feedback, business needs, and delivery learnings.
 



  





**Experience and Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 



 • 12\+ years of overall industry experience in technology and software product development.
 



 • 3–5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Product Manager, or equivalent product\-focused role.
 



 • Experience working with complex enterprise software products or platforms.
 



 • Strong understanding of Agile software development practices and the software development lifecycle.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to translate complex customer and business needs into actionable engineering requirements.
 



 • Strong analytical, prioritization, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
 



 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
 



 • Experience working with global and distributed engineering and product teams is preferred.
 



  





 Technical Understanding
 



 The Product Owner is not expected to define engineering implementation but should have sufficient technical understanding to engage effectively with engineers and architects.
 



  





**Experience or working knowledge in several of the following areas is preferred:** 




 • Cloud\-based and SaaS platforms
 



 • Mobile applications and ecosystems
 



 • REST APIs and system integrations
 



 • Authentication, identity, and authorization
 



 • Security and cybersecurity principles
 



 • Distributed systems and cloud architecture
 



 • Hardware, software, and firmware integration
 



 • IoT and connected\-device ecosystems
 



  





**Added Advantage – Not Mandatory** 




 Experience in the following areas would be beneficial but is not required:
 



 • Physical Access Control Systems (PACS)
 



 • Digital or mobile credentials and mobile wallets
 



 • Access control, identity, authentication, or credential management solutions
 



 • Products integrating cloud, mobile, software, and physical devices
 



  





 Strong Product Ownership and technical product experience from other technology domains will also be considered.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Experience with SAFe or another scaled Agile framework.
 



 • SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) certification or equivalent training.
 



 • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Miro, or similar tools.
 



 • Previous software engineering or hands\-on technical experience is an advantage.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The successful Product Owner will ensure that engineering teams understand what they are building, why it matters, and the outcomes expected. They will maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog, enable timely product decisions, identify dependencies and risks early, and establish strong alignment between Product Management and Engineering.
 



 Most importantly, they will take ownership of customer and business value rather than focusing solely on feature or story delivery.

title: Director, FCSO Screening Product Manager - List Management
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Director, FCSO Screening Product Management supports the ED, Head of FCSO Screening Products in the strategic management, development, implementation, enhancement and ongoing maintenance of the Bank's Screening Products and associated capabilities with a specific focus on List Management.
   

  

 The primary focus of the role is to drive effective List product management practices across the Screening Product portfolio, ensuring that products remain fit for purpose, regulatory compliant, operationally efficient and aligned to the Bank's financial crime risk management objectives. This includes ownership of List product roadmaps, prioritisation of enhancements, management of product backlogs, oversight of defect remediation, implementation of new capabilities and establishment of feedback loops to continuously improve product performance and outcomes.
   

  

 The role holder partners closely with Operations, Technology, Data and Financial Crime stakeholders to identify opportunities to strengthen screening controls, improve screening effectiveness and support the safe introduction of new List products. A key objective of the role is to improve the earlier identification of financial crime risk through enhanced List Management capabilities, improved data utilisation, more effective alert generation and optimisation of Screening processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**
* Drive the strategic development and evolution of the Screening Product portfolio, ensuring products remain effective, scalable, compliant and aligned to the Bank's financial crime risk management objectives.
* Define and execute product roadmaps that enhance screening capabilities, accelerate the implementation of regulatory and sanctions requirements, and support the introduction of new products, customer segments, geographies and payment flows.
* Champion a product\-led approach to continuous improvement through performance monitoring, user feedback, outcome analysis and data\-driven prioritisation of enhancements, fixes and optimisation initiatives.
* Drive improvements that enable earlier identification of financial crime risk by enhancing screening logic, data quality, alert quality and overall risk\-detection effectiveness while reducing false positives and unnecessary operational effort.
* Maintain awareness of emerging financial crime threats, regulatory developments, industry best practices and technological advancements to identify opportunities to strengthen screening products and improve risk outcomes across the Bank.


**Business**
* Own and govern the Screening Product portfolio, ensuring capabilities, configurations, controls and supporting documentation remain effective, compliant and aligned to business and regulatory requirements.
* Lead the assessment, prioritisation and delivery of product enhancements, new screening use cases, onboarding initiatives and change requests, ensuring solutions support effective financial crime risk management across products, channels, customer segments and geographies.
* Establish and maintain robust product governance, including management of regulatory commitments, audit actions, operational risk obligations, procedures, standards and control frameworks relevant to Screening Products.
* Monitor product performance and outcomes through defined metrics, stakeholder engagement and operational feedback loops, driving continual improvements to screening effectiveness, alert quality, data quality and user experience.
* Act as a subject matter expert on Screening Products, translating emerging financial crime threats, regulatory developments and industry best practices into product enhancements that improve risk detection, accelerate regulatory responsiveness and reduce unnecessary operational effort.


**Leadership and Management**
* Champion a product\-led culture across the Screening Product portfolio, ensuring focus remains on improving risk detection outcomes, regulatory compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Lead and influence stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology and CFCC to deliver product enhancements, strategic change initiatives and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Drive a data\-driven approach to product management, leveraging performance metrics, user feedback and operational insights to enhance screening effectiveness, reduce false positives and enable earlier identification of financial crime risk.


**Knowledge Development and Information Management**
* Develop and maintain meaningful product and risk MI, KPIs and performance metrics to measure Screening Product effectiveness, identify trends and support data\-driven decision making.
* Analyse product performance, stakeholder feedback and operational outcomes to identify opportunities for optimisation, enhancement and improved risk detection.
* Promote effective knowledge sharing and documentation of product changes, lessons learned, industry developments and regulatory expectations to support continuous improvement across the Screening Product portfolio.


**Stakeholders Relations**
* Build and maintain strong partnerships across Operations, Technology, Data and CFCC stakeholders to ensure Screening Product priorities, enhancements and outcomes remain aligned to business needs, regulatory expectations and financial crime risk objectives.
* Represent the Screening Product function in engagements with regulators, industry forums, peer institutions and strategic vendors, leveraging external insights and best practices to inform product strategy and drive continuous improvement.


**Process**
* Establish and maintain robust product governance processes covering the prioritisation, design, testing, implementation and ongoing maintenance of Screening Products, ensuring solutions remain effective, compliant and fit for purpose.
* Define and oversee product lifecycle management standards, including change management, defect remediation, performance monitoring, feedback loops and continuous improvement activities across the Screening Product portfolio.
* Ensure product controls, configurations, supporting documentation and operating procedures are maintained in line with regulatory requirements, Group standards and financial crime risk management objectives.


**People \& Talent**
* Foster a high\-performance, product\-led culture that encourages innovation, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement across the Screening Product function.
* Develop team capabilities in product management, screening technologies, data\-driven decision making and financial crime risk management to support evolving business and regulatory requirements.
* Provide clear leadership, coaching and direction to ensure roles, responsibilities and priorities are well understood, enabling effective delivery of product outcomes and strategic objectives.


**Risk Management**
* Own and oversee financial crime risks associated with Screening Products, ensuring capabilities, configurations and controls remain effective in identifying sanctions, AML and other financial crime risks across customers, transactions and products
* Drive continuous optimisation of screening effectiveness through analysis of risk outcomes, alert quality, data quality and system performance, improving risk detection while reducing false positives and operational inefficiencies.
* Assess and manage risks arising from new products, customer segments, payment flows, geographies and regulatory requirements, ensuring appropriate screening controls are designed and implemented.
* Maintain oversight of key screening data, watchlists, regulatory content and product configurations to ensure screening solutions remain current, accurate and aligned to evolving risk and regulatory expectations.
* Strengthen the operational resilience of Screening Products through effective risk management, control monitoring, issue remediation, incident management and governance processes, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of material risks and control weaknesses.


**Governance**
* Establish and maintain effective governance over the Screening Product portfolio, ensuring clear accountability, oversight and reporting of product strategy, performance, risks, issues and change initiatives.
* Oversee the identification, tracking, escalation and remediation of product, operational and financial crime risk issues, ensuring timely resolution of audit findings, regulatory actions, incidents and control weaknesses.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement by capturing, communicating and embedding lessons learned from audits, assurance reviews, incidents, regulatory feedback and product performance reviews into future product enhancements and control design.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Help to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Operation of Financial Markets; Financial Crime Prevention; The Right Environment
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* FCSO List Management,
* FCSO TS and NS Product Owners
* FCSO Screening Operations
* FCSO Global Process Owners (and delegates)
* FCSO Technology
* Group Risk Framework Owners
* Country FCSO
* Country FCC


**Other Responsibilities**
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in FCSO, GBS India / OPS FCSO Screening/ FCSO Product Management; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;


**Skills And Experience**
* Compliance Policies and Standards
* Compliance Advisory
* Surveillance (including Screening and Monitoring)
* Investigations
* Compliance Risk Assessment
* Regulatory Liaison


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Graduate / basic qualifications in banking/ finance/ audit/ systems


**Training**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in Banking and out of which 4 years in managerial capacity leading both direct and in\-direct teams across global/regional footprints;
* Solid record of accomplishment of running effective and efficient surveillance process, product management in FCC highly desirable;
* Transaction Processing background in one or multiple areas (e.g.., Payments, Collections, Trade Products, Security Services, Financial Markets, Clearing Networks like SWIFT, CHAPS, CHIPS, RTGS etc) would be an added advantage


**Certifications**
* ACAMS or equivalent preferred but not necessary


**Languages**

 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before.  Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**

**What We Offer**

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \- SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high\-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C\-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade\-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI\-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go\-to\-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision\-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine\-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**
* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high\-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* \- Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time\-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI\-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real\-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.


**Core Consulting**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI\-enabled digital transformation, data \& AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.


**Preferred:**
* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)

 This role sits at the intersection of telecom infrastructure, identity \& security, and enterprise SaaS. You should be someone who has lived through at least one full product lifecycle from MVP to Scale (or Sunset) and thrives in ambiguity, cross\-functional collaboration, and ecosystem\-level strategic thinking.

Position our APIs within the broader enterprise fraud\-prevention and identity stack to maximize relevance and stickiness. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: AI and Data-Technical Product Manager-VG-CDAO0266
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Specialist III, Technical Product Manager**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 This role leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a technical product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the product(s). Products may have enterprise\-wide implications. This role also uses market insights to evaluate product functionality and informs the future product direction based on consumer trends and product performance.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Leads technical product management activities for multiple technical products, or one strategic technical product. Participates in the design and continuous improvement of the technical solution.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to create best practices that drive significant change to the client experience.
* Coaches’ technical product teams towards best practices and learnings. Ensures delivery of messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Partners with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues in a timely manner, and supports/drives escalations where required to enable rapid delivery.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of new technical products. Defines and analyzes technical markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and provides recommendations for ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in the team’s engineering practices in development, continuous integration, and automated deployment.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages the entire product life cycle from planning to execution in alignment with business goals and strategy.
* Researches and analyzes market conditions to identify key consumer trends and opportunities for product enhancements or innovation.
* Determines product features and functions by gathering business and customer feedback and translating it into product requirements.
* Prepares product documentation and supports go\-to\-market activities by providing product knowledge to sales and marketing teams.
* Leverages market and performance feedback to evaluate product effectiveness and steer future product direction.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in technical product management, with at least 2 years leading large cross\-functional teams. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field required; graduate degree preferred.
* Good to have skills in product lifecycle management, market analysis, product design, user experience evaluation, technical documentation, and cross\-functional stakeholder collaboration. Technical knowledge in software development processes, APIs, cloud platforms, or data\-driven product environments is important.
* Strong communication, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, and project execution skills.
* Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute Product Management Certifications, or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM). Ability to balance technical feasibility with business viability and user desirability is essential.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

***There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.***
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

  

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

**Role Overview**




 As a Staff Product Manager (IC4\) on the IT Service Management (ITSM) product team, you will serve as a principal individual contributor and domain expert driving the next era of enterprise service delivery. This role is designed for a strategic product leader who combines deep technical depth in enterprise IT workflows with the learning agility required to navigate rapidly shifting market dynamics. Sitting at the strategic nexus of Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, and Customer Success, you will act as a high\-impact cross\-functional leader. You will define and execute an ambitious product vision—continuously refining it based on customer empathy, AI\-driven automation, and real\-time operational feedback. If you possess a relentless drive to master complex domain ecosystems, inspire cross\-functional teams without authority, and transform enterprise IT friction into modern, effortless user experiences, this role offers an expansive platform for your craft.
   

  





**The Impact You Can Create**



* **Pioneer Bold Innovation:** 
 Drive market\-defining ITSM features from concept to production, leveraging thought leadership to keep our enterprise platform at the bleeding edge of intelligent service management.
* **Orchestrate Cross\-Functional Success:** 
 Build aligned, high\-velocity team ecosystems where Engineering, UX, Sales, and GTM teams execute in lockstep to achieve aggressive revenue, adoption, and customer retention targets.
* **Deliver Global Scale \& Value:** 
 Continuously analyze user telemetry and enterprise landscapes to deploy intuitive, low\-friction capabilities that eliminate critical operational bottlenecks for global IT teams.
* **Demystify Complex Architectures:** 
 Deconstruct intricate ITSM backend workflows, ITIL frameworks, and integration layers into clean, scalable technical requirements—accelerating developer velocity and minimizing execution risk.



**Roles \& Responsibilities (R\&R)**




**1\. Vision, Strategy \& Strategy Adaptation**



* Own the long\-term product vision and multi\-year strategy for our ITSM capabilities, seamlessly integrating market research, user behavioral data, and emerging technology trends into an actionable roadmap.
* Maintain an agile, high\-conviction roadmap capable of fluidly adapting to shifting enterprise priorities, competitive shifts, and technical discoveries without losing strategic momentum.
* Demonstrate bold thought leadership by challenging legacy ITSM paradigms and introducing modern, self\-service, and AI\-first product paradigms.



**2\. Requirements Definition \& Lifecycle Management**



* Lead the end\-to\-end product lifecycle—from initial problem discovery and UX journey mapping to detailed PRDs, roadmap prioritization, and feature rollout.
* Translate complex IT operational workflows, service desk mechanics, and routing logic into exceptionally clear, developer\-ready technical requirements.
* Maintain daily operational execution standards across engineering squads, driving high velocity in a fast\-paced release environment.



**3\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Alignment**



* Partner intimately with UX Design and Engineering to co\-author elegant, accessible solutions tailored for both IT administrators and end\-users.
* Serve as the primary communications bridge across the business, keeping internal partners (Design, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Leadership) and external stakeholders aligned on delivery timelines and strategic value.
* Drive alignment across executive and cross\-functional leadership through transparent, data\-backed product narratives and clear ROI justification.



**4\. Customer Advocacy \& Co\-Creation**



* Partner directly with enterprise IT leaders, sysadmins, and end\-users to prioritize critical pain points, map high\-impact themes, and co\-design solution workflows.
* Cultivate deep user empathy to convert complex service desk friction into intuitive, consumer\-grade product experiences.



**Skills \& Core Competencies**




**Adaptability \& Learning Agility**



* **Ecosystem Fluidity:** 
 A proven ability to rapidly deconstruct, master, and stay ahead of evolving ITSM frameworks, API ecosystems, and modern enterprise IT infrastructure.
* **Resilience in Motion:** 
 High comfort reprioritizing strategies and roadmaps mid\-cycle in response to new data, technical constraints, or shifting market demands.
* **Problem\-Solving Rigor:** 
 Exceptional analytical capabilities to break down ambiguous, multi\-layered enterprise problems into structured, iterative release phases.



**Cross\-Functional \& Human Capabilities**



* **Inclusive Communication:** 
 Superior written and verbal communication skills, with a natural ability to translate complex technical architecture into clear executive business value, and vice versa.
* **Matrix Influence:** 
 Demonstrated capability to guide, align, and inspire distributed, cross\-functional software teams without direct organizational authority.
* **Active Listening:** 
 High empathy and active listening skills to accurately surface the underlying operational needs of enterprise customers and internal stakeholders.



**Technical \& Domain Expertise**



* **Product Development Mastery:** 
 End\-to\-end fluency across both technical and business layers of SaaS product delivery—from telemetry\-driven prioritization to go\-to\-market positioning.
* **ITSM Specialization:** 
 Comprehensive understanding of modern IT Service Management workflows—including Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management, Service Catalog, and AI\-assisted Service Desk automation.


**Qualifications**

**Qualifications \& Experience**



* **Educational Foundation:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience coupled with a track record of continuous technical growth).
* **Product Leadership:** 
 9\+ years of dedicated SaaS product management experience, demonstrating progressive ownership of complex enterprise software products.
* **SaaS Industry Native:** 
 5\+ years of experience operating within the fast\-scaling, iterative execution cycles of the B2B SaaS industry.
* **Domain Depth:** 
 3\+ years specifically managing products explicitly built for IT or developer teams, with deep exposure to ITSM, ITOM, Service Desk, or workflow automation platforms.
* **Fast\-Paced Delivery:** 
 Documented track record of repeatedly shipping high\-impact software capabilities within rapid release environments while making rigorous data\-driven decisions that balance near\-term execution with long\-term platform health.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**
