title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \- SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high\-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C\-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade\-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI\-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go\-to\-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision\-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine\-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**
* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high\-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* \- Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time\-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI\-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real\-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.


**Core Consulting**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI\-enabled digital transformation, data \& AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.


**Preferred:**
* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)

You will blend platform product management, agile enablement and vendor/financial stewardship while partnering with Admins, Coaches, Security and Business stakeholders.
   

  

 The Atlassian Platform Owner leads the vision, roadmap, and day\-to\-day operations of the Atlassian platform to enable modern, data\-driven delivery practices across the organization. Partnering with Agile Coaches, Atlassian Administrators, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and Business leaders, the Platform Owner ensures the platform is stable, scalable, secure, and aligned to agile best practices and business outcomes.
   

  

**Our Team**
 As an Atlassian Administrator at Opella, you'll play a crucial role in our Enabling Platforms \& DevOps team, delivering solutions that support our global operations. You'll be at the forefront of implementing and optimizing our Atlassian Cloud portfolio products and integration with marketplace apps and custom solutions, while also bridging the gap between development and project management.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 As an Atlassian Platform Owner at Opella, you'll lead platform strategy, governance, reliability and adoption across Jira, Confluence and related apps. You will blend platform product management, agile enablement and vendor/financial stewardship while partnering with Admins, Coaches, Security and Business stakeholders.
   

  

 The Atlassian Platform Owner leads the vision, roadmap, and day\-to\-day operations of the Atlassian platform to enable modern, data\-driven delivery practices across the organization. Partnering with Agile Coaches, Atlassian Administrators, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and Business leaders, the Platform Owner ensures the platform is stable, scalable, secure, and aligned to agile best practices and business outcomes.
   

  

**Platform Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Define and maintain the Atlassian platform vision, strategy, and multi\-quarter roadmap, aligning to organizational priorities and agile practices.
* Ensure alignment of the platform with agile best practices and team workflows to optimize productivity, transparency, and collaboration.
* Track and analyze platform performance, adoption, and value metrics; identify improvement areas and drive strategic enhancements.


**Operations, Reliability \& Upgrades**
* Oversee and manage the Atlassian platform (Jira, Confluence, and related services) as a product, ensuring availability, scalability, and strong user experience.
* Manage platform upgrades, configuration baselines, maintenance windows, and release/change calendars; communicate change impacts effectively.
* Coordinate incident response, problem management, and root cause analysis with support teams; maintain runbooks and SLAs.


**Governance, Compliance \& Security**
* Establish and maintain governance for usage, project/site standards, naming conventions, workflows, fields, and permission models.
* Implement data lifecycle policies, backup/restore patterns, content retention, and access controls in partnership with Security and Compliance.
* Ensure compliance requirements (e.g., GxP in Consumer Healthcare contexts) are enforced through process, validation, documentation, and controls.


**Vendor, Licensing \& Budget Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for Atlassian vendor management: contracts, renewals, usage reviews, performance monitoring, and escalations.
* Manage marketplace apps portfolio (e.g., ScriptRunner, Xray, Comala, draw.io, Snapshots, Guard, Compass, Loom) including value assessments and lifecycle decisions.
* Monitor budget and expenditures for licenses, apps, and operations; forecast demand, right\-size plans, and optimize costs.


**Partnerships \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for Sanofi counterparts, ensuring bidirectional alignment on policies, integrations, and governance.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements and continuously improve the platform to meet evolving business needs.
* Partner closely with Agile Coaches and the Atlassian Administrator(s) to balance configuration agility with platform stability and standards.


**Integrations, Automation \& Extensibility**
* Oversee design and quality of integrations (Forge apps, REST APIs, enterprise systems) ensuring reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Guide adoption of automation to eliminate manual tasks, standardize workflows, and improve data quality and reporting.
* Evaluate and govern custom solutions for sustainability, documentation, and support readiness.


**Enablement, Training \& Adoption**
* Lead training and onboarding programs to ensure teams leverage Jira/Confluence effectively for Scrum, Kanban, and scaled practices.
* Curate templates, playbooks, dashboards, and guidance that support consistent, simple, and value\-focused usage.
* Promote the platform as the system of record for delivery, replacing manual reporting with automated, real\-time insights.


**About You**
**Technical Background**
* 5\+ years owning or administering Atlassian Cloud platforms at scale, including Jira Software and Confluence.
* Deep knowledge of workflows, issue types, fields, schemes, permission models, boards, dashboards, Advanced Roadmaps (Plans), and release management.
* Hands\-on experience with automation (native Automation, ScriptRunner), JQL, and reporting; comfortable guiding admins on best\-practice configurations.
* Experience integrating Atlassian with enterprise systems (via Forge, REST APIs, and standardized integration patterns).
* Familiarity with marketplace apps such as Xray, Comala Document Management, diagrams.net, Guard, Compass, and Snapshots.
* Understanding of agile practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and how to operationalize them within Jira/Confluence.
* Awareness of compliance frameworks (e.g., GxP in Consumer Healthcare), data protection, and audit requirements as applied to Atlassian Cloud.
* Atlassian certifications (ACP) and/or Scrum/Agile certifications.


**Soft Skills**
* Strategic product mindset: able to define vision, prioritize roadmaps, and measure value realization.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management; influences from teams to executives.
* Change leadership: drives adoption, simplifies complexity, and replaces manual reporting with data\-driven practices.
* Structured, pragmatic problem\-solver; balances standardization with team autonomy.
* Customer\-centric, hands\-on when needed, and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment.


**Why us?**
 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

* All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
* Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
* Outcome\-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
* Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.


 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. **Role Summary**
 The Manager, IT Delivery is responsible for leading high\-performing data and technology teams and delivering strategic data initiatives that generate measurable business value.
   

  

 This role combines people leadership, product delivery, stakeholder management, and operational oversight. The manager will lead teams operating across data engineering, data platforms, data warehousing, data lakes, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
   

  

 The manager will have end\-to\-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership and communication capabilities, experience managing product\-oriented teams, and a sound understanding of modern data ecosystems. The role requires the ability to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans, develop engineering talent, manage delivery commitments, and ensure the scalability, quality, security, and reliability of data solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and develop high\-performing data and technology teams, including hiring, performance management, workforce planning, and talent development.
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives across data engineering, data warehousing, data lakes / lakehouses, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, and business intelligence.
* Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering stakeholders to translate priorities into product roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product\-oriented teams with end\-to\-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products.
* Drive Agile practices, including intake management, backlog prioritization, estimation, sprint and release planning, and delivery governance.
* Manage capacity planning, resource forecasting, delivery commitments, risks, issues, and cross\-team dependencies to enable predictable execution.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, reusable, and compliant with applicable technology, risk, privacy, and information security standards.
* Promote effective data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, ownership, and stewardship practices.
* Monitor delivery, quality, and operational health through relevant metrics, and provide clear, concise updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Foster strong stakeholder relationships and communicate complex data and technology topics effectively to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Promote automation, standardization, engineering excellence, cost optimization, and modern data practices, including cloud and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and business\-outcome ownership.

**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, data platforms, or IT services, including people leadership experience.
* Proven experience leading teams in a product\-based environment with responsibility for delivery execution and stakeholder management.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, backlog management, sprint planning, and Jira.
* Experience leading data\-focused technology initiatives, including data engineering, analytics, data quality, governance, or modern data platforms.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution, manage ambiguity, solve complex problems, and lead organisational change.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively partner with engineering teams to deliver business outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Exposure to cloud\-based data platforms and AI\-enabled technology initiatives.
* Agile, Scrum, PMP, SAFe, or related certifications preferred.
* Experience leading cloud data platform, data modernization, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed or cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with industry\-standard cloud, data engineering, analytics, governance, and data quality technologies.


**Key Success Factors**
* Experience in data\-centric technology environments.
* Ability to build, scale, and lead high\-performing teams.
* Sound understanding of data engineering, data platforms, governance, quality, and analytics.
* Strong product and Agile delivery leadership.
* Effective capacity planning, forecasting, and execution management.
* Ownership and accountability for delivery and operational outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication.
* Ability to connect data and technology investments to business outcomes.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, cross\-functional environment.

title: IT Program Project Delivery - Senior Manager
description:
****Who We Are Looking For:****
* The Compliance Technology Project Manager role plays a key role in managing projects across Compliance Technology projects.
* AML Sanctions Screening, AML Transaction Monitoring, and KYC suite of applications.
* We are looking for someone who has proven experience with managing multiple projects consisting of complex applications using globally distributed, cross\-functional teams.
* The role will be responsible for a variety project management of tasks related to Agile Kanban software development lifecycle, management, and reporting under the direction of the Program Managers in Compliance Technology.


****Why This Role Is Important To Us:****
 Compliance Technology partners with Financial Crime Compliance as a critical part of the company because it protects the firm from regulatory and reputational risk while enabling safe business growth and client trust. It’s also a high\-impact area to work in because it combines real\-world problem solving (financial crime) with cutting\-edge innovation in AI, data, and enterprise platforms, offering strong visibility and career growth.
   

  

****What You Will Be Responsible For As Compliance Tech:****
* As a Project Manager you will Collaborate with Program Manager(s) in rolling\-out projects assigned to application team(s).
* Maintain the Screening Demand Backlog including demand prioritization, Schedule Matrix, linkages to Clarity, Financial Crimes Compliance (FCC) AML Screening Roadmap, and other tools as appropriate.
* Maintain Resource allocations against a maintained list of timekeeping tasks, and track actuals against these tasks for one or more projects, as assigned in Clarity.
* Maintain list of timekeeping tasks in Clarity identifying which activities are deferrable and which are not.
* Manage SOP98 Deferrable workflows in Clarity including Statements of Works (SOWs): annual updates, as costs change, as well as monthly tracking against targets for resources and fixed price contracts.
* Responsible for estimating each project.
* Responsible for resource forecasts in Clarity.
* Responsible for reviewing resource time actuals and resolving inconsistencies in Clarity.
* Build, monitor and maintain project plans in Clarity including tasks, dates, dependencies/predecessors, owners, etc.
* Build, monitor, and maintain the various project teams’ work items in Jira Agile Kanban boards.
* Perform role as Kanban Scrum Master as specified by the Agile Office.
* Record, distribute and follow\-up on notes and action items for meetings, as needed (project coordinator may assist in this activity).
* Support all aspects of Status Reporting within Clarity.
* Support risk \& issue tracking and maintenance in Clarity.
* Support, maintain, follow\-up and update SDLC tollgate processes for all assigned projects using Jira and Microsoft Teams. Project coordinator may support this activity, but it is the PM’s responsibility to review and ensure tollgates are completed and closed per SDLC Governance guidelines and training.
* Responsible for procurement management including procurement requests, contract review, approvals, requisitions, invoice approvals, and change orders.
* Maintain a list of all procurement requests including vendor SOWs, software and hardware requests, and annual maintenance renewals.
* Responsible for managing the Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) process for each vendor engagement including Inherent Risk Questionnaire (IRQ).
* Ensure Information Security Risk Management Process (ISRMP) is updated as needed for each application.
* Support the Project Management Office (PMO) in providing timely updates as directed.
* Ensure a Data Steward is assigned, and that Data Governance and Data Privacy guidelines are completed by the team when data is involved.
* Work with business partners in prioritizing deliverables.
* Manage the IT budget for programs/projects—both during the budget cycle as well as throughout project execution.
* Manage the change control process for designated projects.
* Maintain Resource Tracking worksheet for onboarding and offboarding of resources (employees and contractors).
* Manage time and material (T\&M) and fixed price (FP) vendors in the Beeline tool including onboarding contracts, resources, timesheet approvals, milestone payments, etc.
* Effectively leverage AI tools (Microsoft Copilot), including prompt engineering and generative AI capabilities, to enhance planning, execution, reporting, and decision\-making across the project lifecycle.
* Support training, access and orientation for new team members.
* Build and maintain positive cross\-team relationships.


****These Skills Will Help You Succeed In This Role****
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail – able to move from one task to another efficiently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication (English) skills including.
* Ability to capture key notes and actions items from meetings.
* Proficiency at follow\-up emails, chats, calls and face to face interactions.
* Required to overlap work at Eastern Time zone.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and on more than one project at a time.
* Knowledge of system delivery methodologies – Waterfall, Agile, Kanban.
* Competency with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, SharePoint, Jira, Clarity, Copilot.
* Strong AI literacy, including effective prompt engineering and use of generative AI tools, to enhance productivity, insight generation, and stakeholder communications.
* Ability to leverage data analytics to drive fact\-based decision\-making, performance tracking, and proactive issue identification throughout the project lifecycle.
* Proven experience delivering multiple versions of one or more applications.
* Experience leading a cross\-functional team, including assigning project priorities, communicating status to other managers and mentoring.
* Experience managing on and offshore resources.


****Education \& Preferred Qualifications:****
* Bachelor’s degree with concentration in Engineering, Business or Technology preferred.
* Minimum 10\-14 years’ work experience.
* Two or more years of full\-time experience in an iterative development environment using an iterative Agile\-like methodology, with experience of delivering working software to production through the entire lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring, Know Your Customer (KYC), financial securities, and trading principles.
* Team oriented attitude.
* PMP Certification Work Requirement.
* This is an onsite role in Hyderabad (India).


**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**
 We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.
   

  

****Why This Role Is Important To Us:****
 Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.
   

  

 We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization.  Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.

title: Business Specialist - Process and Change Management [T500-29249]
description:
**About CIBC India:** 




 CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):** 




 The Business Specialist supports the Retail Mortgage Services (RMS) portfolio by providing business identification and consultative support for process changes. The role proactively analyzes and recommends enhancements to existing processes, communicates rationale, and negotiates solutions to improve operational effectiveness and client experience. The incumbent contributes to the overall change approach, roadmaps, and implementations of internal and partner\-led initiatives.
 



 The Process \& Change Management (P\&CM) team is responsible for facilitating the implementation of operational changes that impact Retail Mortgage Services (RMS). The Specialist is accountable for providing in\-depth advice/consultation typically of an operational or tactical nature, to management, business partners, and team members, within an area of specialization. In this position you will provide business identification and consultative support relative to the development, analysis and identification of process changes and/or system enhancements. You will also proactively analyze and recommend enhancements to the existing business processes; clearly communicate rationale and negotiate solutions which will enhance operational effectiveness. Ensure that all assigned initiatives are implemented in an effective manner within area of responsibility. May lead projects related to the development and implementation of new and revised policies, procedures and standards.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):** 




**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:** 



* Research and analyze specialized business information to recommend solutions for operational issues
* Draft procedural documentation and implement change within the production team.
* Identify, develop, and implement operational process enhancements to increase departmental efficiency
* Assess the impact, effectiveness, and feasibility of proposed change decisions and present recommendations to Senior Management
* Prepare and present reports to Management on project status, upcoming changes, and recommendations
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, effectively prioritize tasks, and work independently in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment
* Consult and provide subject matter expertise on mortgage business on Retail Operations processes and how frontline processes connect into Retail Operations.
* Collaborates with Retail Operations teams to identify and implement process improvements
* Partners with internal stakeholders such as Product Management, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Project Management to ensure successful change initiatives
* Engages with external partners and vendors for process enhancements and implementation of partner\-led initiatives
* Works closely with Senior Management to present recommendations and influence decision\-making
* Supports communication and coordination across multiple departments to drive operational effectiveness and client experience



  





**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls



  





**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:** 




**JOB DIMENSIONS:** 




**Experience:** 
 5\+ years of experience
 


* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness
* Scope includes Retail Mortgage Services portfolio and related process improvement initiatives
* Responsible for analyzing, recommending, and implementing enhancements impacting departmental efficiency and client satisfaction
* Accountable for preparing and presenting status reports and change impact assessments to Senior Management
* Operates with a high degree of independence and accountability



  





**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):** 




**Must Have Skills:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations Management, or related field
* 5\+ years of experience in process improvement or business analysis preferably in Canadian financial/banking services
* Professional certifications as asset (eg: Six Sigma, PMP)
* Flow charting
* Proficiency in English (written and verbal)
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills
* Ability to build trust and influence outcomes across relationships and networks
* Proficiency in process improvement methodologies and relevant software/tools (e.g., MS Office, process mapping tools)
* Adaptability and change management skills to continuously evolve and deliver optimal results



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 


* We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and Moment Makers, our social, points\-based recognition program
* Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
* We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development

 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the candidate privacy statement.

**We work with C\-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most, from navigating complex M\&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high\-stakes moments.** 
**But we don’t stop at client impact, we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation, from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end\-to\-end M\&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement \& restructuring, to infrastructure \& real estate advisory and sustainability\-driven innovation.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact, and where your growth matters as much as your clients’, Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.**
**The Team**
 Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
   

  

 Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
   

  

 We are looking for Consultants for our Enterprise and Growth Strategy practice, with relevant experience in Insurance Industry.
   

  

**Work You Will Do**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
   

  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop appropriate business models, operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues, determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches, evaluating, and validating analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement
* Contribute to multiple work\-threads of large, complex engagements, with high\-quality deliverables
* Participate in the development and presentation of proposals for business development activities
* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future business strategies

**Enterprise and Growth Strategy – FSI – Insurance**

 Following experience would be required as a part of this job role:

* Enterprise and Growth Strategy consulting experience \- Corporate Strategy, Go\-to\-market (GTM) Strategy, Business Unit Growth Strategy, Roadmap Development, Business Model, Capability Assessment, Efficiency Plays, Cost Take\-out, Market Research / Assessment, Business Planning, Business \& Digital Transformation, Vendor Assessment, Operating Model Assessment, etc.) within Insurance Industry
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends within the Insurance industry. Interest and knowledge about the current trends in any one of its sectors (Life, Commercial, Personal, Specialty, Reinsurance etc.)
* Demonstrate ability to understand and analyze business issues and leverage technology to solve them
* Preferred experience of engaging in strategic issues with senior\-level clients including C\-Suite executives
* Exposure to working in non\-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders
* Exposure around building dynamic Excel models and macros for market sizing, forecasting, and automation of repetitive analysis and reporting tasks
* Ability to craft structured generative research prompts and use tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude or MS Copilot in Excel/PowerPoint) to streamline research, create slides, synthesize interviews, or simulate models
* Experience in developing and deploying LLM tools to accelerate research, generate summaries, and support slide creation


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Clear and concise communication \- Conduct client interviews, participate in workshops / trainings and present recommendations; strong verbal and written skills are critical
* Good client presence – Interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking – Comfortable with managing large data sets, ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary), synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data through configurable dashboards; familiarity with Python, and Excel Macro scripting is nice to have
* Logical structuring \- Structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused – Support team in development of deliverables, manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Ownership – Take ownership, manage and co\-ordinate activities and tasks assigned and drive to completion
* Network \- ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**\#FY27ReferralCampaign**
**Required Qualifications**
**For Consultants:**
* MBA or MS from a premier (Tier\-1\) school in India or abroad (not more than 6 years post MS / MBA)
* 4 to 5 years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA) in Insurance Industry
* Experience in consulting, or corporate strategy environment strongly preferred
* 3\+ years of industry experience with Insurance industry focus (preferably US clients)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

 We are seeking a dynamic and strategic

 is the
 **world’s leading allergy brand** 
 and a trusted name in respiratory health across the globe. We are committed to helping consumers live their lives fully by providing effective, now\-drowsy allergy solutions that enable them to be at their best.
 



 In this role you will leverage your scientific and commercial acumen to drive short and mid\-term executional HCP excellence, from defining the global HealthCare Professional marketing strategy to building the assets needed for multi\-channel engagement of HCP activation with GPs, ENTs, Pediatricians, Allergists and other members of the medical community in key focus markets and around the globe.
 



* Lead initiatives that advance our brands and strengthen our reputation worldwide.
* Mentor and uplift emerging talent while pushing your own growth and influence.
* Put purpose into practice — embedding sustainability, access and social impact into every decision.
* Model the challenger mindset: question complexity, act with integrity and make things radically simple.

* Reporting to the Global Brand General Manager for Allegra, the Global HCP lead collaborates closely with Zone Brand Leads and Zone HCP/MCE Leads in focus markets as well as with Global Medical \& Regulatory, Global Claims Lead, Global Strategy and Content Leads.



  





**About You**




  





**Education** 



* Graduate degree in Marketing, Management degree/MBA (preferable)



  





**Languages** 



* Fluency in English in a professional context spoken and written is a must.



  





**Professional Experience** 



* Relevant Experience in HCP marketing (detailing, conferences and omni\-channel HCP marketing) in the OTC, Health/Wellness, or Healthcare/Pharma sectors is a must. Experience marketing in FMCG or OTC healthcare brands is highly desirable. 5\+ years of senior level marketing and general managerial experience
* Regional experience is desired and Global experience a plus.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking: Ability to translate scientific and market insights into actionable global HCP strategies and craft and execute HCP\-centric marketing activation that builds Brands Love.
* Commercial acumen with P\&L management and project ROI judgement.
* Scientific/medical Literacy: Strong ability to understand therapeutic areas and claims and ability to translate into clear, compelling and differentiated messaging.
* Project Management/Prioritization: Skilled in managing multiple projects, timelines, and stakeholders across geographies. Proven adaptability to changing priorities and strategies.

* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  



As a Digital Product Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the processes related to the definition and delivery of digital products. You will develop functional specifications, including capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, based on feedback from internal and external stakeholders. You will collaborate with business and technology teams to define product strategy, prioritize features, and drive successful product delivery.

* Define and lead product strategy and roadmap for digital healthcare and pharmacy solutions
* Elicit, analyze, and translate business requirements into capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria

* Collaborate with engineering teams to evaluate capabilities, define solution alternatives, and prioritize product releases
* Effectively communicate product vision, roadmap, and feature requirements to development teams
* Work closely with UX and engineering teams to shape product design and user experience
* Generate release notes, demo scripts, and conduct product demonstrations for stakeholders and clients
* Independently identify and analyze relevant data to support product decisions and business cases
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of product capabilities and feature requirements
* Drive continuous improvement by acting on feedback received during retrospectives and product reviews
* Identify potential risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies
* Foster a culture of innovation across the product portfolio
* Collaborate effectively with onsite and offshore teams to assess requirements and deliver solutions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Allied Health Sciences, MCA, or a related field
* 5\+ years of IT industry experience, including at least 3 years in Healthcare Informatics, Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analysis roles
* Experience in Healthcare, Pharmacy, PBM (Pharmacy Benefit Management), or related healthcare technology domains
* Experience defining capabilities, features, user stories, wireframes, and acceptance criteria
* Proven experience managing product backlogs and working within Agile product development frameworks
* Experience collaborating with development teams throughout feature implementation and delivery
* Solid understanding of healthcare workflows, pharmacy systems, prescription adjudication, specialty pharmacy operations, and member journeys
* Proven solid analytical, logical reasoning, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Proven excellent verbal and written communication skills

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA or advanced degree in Business, Technology, Healthcare, or a related discipline
* Experience with voice, digital, self\-service, IVR, contact center, chatbot, conversational AI, or customer engagement platforms
* Experience launching MVPs and managing products through the entire product lifecycle
* Hands\-on experience with Jira, Rally, Aha!, or similar product management and requirements management tools
* Knowledge of Optum domain, prescription adjudication systems, specialty pharmacy subsystems, and prescription member workflows

 **About Optum**


Optum specializes in the delivery, clinical management, and affordability of prescription medications and consumer health products. Our goal is to deliver high\-quality, integrated services that promote optimal outcomes, superior savings, and outstanding client and consumer experiences.


At Optum, we are dedicated to helping make the health system work better for everyone. As part of a global organization, you'll have the opportunity to work on innovative healthcare solutions that impact millions of lives while collaborating with talented teams across business and technology.


Join us and help shape the future of healthcare through digital innovation.

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Product Manager - Tax New
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.


Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.


Arcesium is looking for a hands\-on Product Manager to own and drive the evolution of our Tax Product for the Alternative Investment industry. This is a builder’s role for someone who can work closely with Engineering to translate complex tax workflows into scalable technology solutions—from requirements definition through production delivery.



We are looking for someone who has personally built and shipped technology solutions for hedge fund tax operations. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience taking products or platform capabilities from concept and requirements through design, development, testing, and production, working closely with engineering teams throughout the process.



The role requires a strong combination of tax domain expertise, product thinking, and technology execution. You should be comfortable understanding complex hedge fund tax workflows, identifying opportunities to solve them through technology, defining clear product requirements, and partnering hands\-on with Engineering to deliver solutions that are scalable, reliable, and user focused.


**What You'll Do:**

  

* **Own the product**: Drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery for the Tax Product roadmap, working directly with engineering through the full lifecycle from problem definition to production.
* **Go deep on the technical detail**: Translate hedge fund tax mechanics like partnership allocations, wash sales, tax lot classification, K\-1 processing, and regulatory filings (FBAR, FATCA, FIN48\) into precise specifications.
* **Engage clients directly**: Handle client and internal stakeholder questions on tax product with the accuracy and timeliness the role demands.
* **Support the roadmap**: Contribute to and eventually own the vision and roadmap for the Tax Product that is informed by market trends and the needs of Alternative Investment clients.
* **Grow with the role**: This role starts as an individual contributor. Candidates who demonstrate strong independent delivery and domain command will have a path to leading the Tax Product team, earned through performance.


**What You'll Need:**


* 8–12 years of experience in US Taxation, with hands\-on domain expertise in US Tax Compliance and Planning for Hedge Funds.
* Working knowledge of wash sales, tax lot classification (including Section 1256 treatment), K\-1 and investor allocation processing, and regulatory filings such as FBAR, FATCA, and FIN48\.
* Direct, verifiable experience building or delivering technology solutions for tax operations like platform features, workflow automation, or systems you helped design and ship with an engineering team.
* Ability to work independently and produce accurate output that holds up on subsequent reviews.
* Strong communication skills, with a track record of meeting client and internal commitments on time.
* An outstanding academic background and genuine interest in working in a high\-tech software development environment.


Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.

We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers\-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers\-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).

We are the leaders in using technology and risk models that focus on alternate / surrogate methods for scoring customers. Our origination is 100% digital with over 100 embedded partnerships like Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Paytm, Paisabazaar, META, etc. for providing credit access to MSME businesses.
 



 Founded by CA/ISB alumni, FlexiLoans is funded by marquee funds and HNIs in the form of MAJ invest, Fasanara Capital, Sanjay Nayar (Founder \- Sorin Investments, Chairman \- KKR India and Ex\-CEO, Citibank South Asia), Dr. Harry Banga (Founder, Caravel group), Yogesh Mahansaria (Founder, Alliance Tyres) Gunit Chaddha (Ex\-CEO, Deutsche Bank, Asia Pacific), Anil Jaggia (Ex\-CIO, HDFC Bank), Vikram Sud (Ex\-COO, Kotak Mahindra Bank), Narayan Seshadri (Ex\-Managing Partner, KPMG), Gopal Srinivasan (Chairman, TVS Capital) and Siddharth Parekh (Co\-Founder, Paragon Partners) to name a few.
 



 Our product offerings and value proposition can be accessed on our website:
 
 https://www.flexiloans.com/
 









**Why join us?** 




 A six\-times certified ‘Great Place to work’ workplace, at FlexiLoans you will be working with top tier talent from diverse backgrounds hungry to make a dent in the MSME universe. We believe in people owning what you do and providing support to folks for making decisions (sometimes even wrong decisions!) all the while learning and growing with the organization. FlexiLoans is your front row seat to the MSME Fintech revolution in India!
 



  





**The role in a gist:** 




 FlexiLoans has lent to over 1,00,000 MSMEs across 300\+ cities, almost all of it through one motion: a business needs capital, we underwrite, we disburse, they repay, and the relationship goes quiet. We're building a new product line on the belief that it shouldn't go quiet, approval rate stops being the north star, and most of our existing playbook doesn't transfer. You'll own it alongside the Product Owner — not executing a defined backlog, but deciding what the backlog should be.
 



  





**What we are looking for in the role:** 



* 2\-4 years of full\-time product experience in product life cycle management
* This is not a stretch role for someone transitioning from engineering, consulting, or analytics
* You get to data yourself \- your own SQL, or answers out of Amplitude / Mixpanel / CleverTap without joining a queue
* You write clearly. Muddy specs make muddy products
* You've shipped to real users and can talk honestly about what didn't work
* You work with engineers as peers: scope a trade\-off, push back on an estimate that doesn't add up



  





**Ideal candidate:** 



* **Adoption and depth of usage** 
 : why businesses don't make this their default, and the experiments that change it
* **The in\-life experience** 
 : everything after approval: how customers transact, whether they understand what they're being charged, and how they get back to a good state after a bad month
* **The origination funnel** 
 : lead to approval, where it leaks, and how much friction each data pull (bureau, bank statement, GST) is actually worth
* **Product policy, with Credit and Risk** 
 : translating eligibility, reviews and renewals into something a customer can navigate
* **Instrumentation** 
 : the events and cohort views that make usage and repayment behaviour legible, and then using them to decide what's next



  





**Qualification \& Experience:** 



* MBA in Business Analytics, Marketing, or IT preferred. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, or related field
* Minimum 2\-4 years of experience in fintech or lending background (NBFC, bank, LOS/LMS, payments, collections); a funnel metric you've owned and moved
* Not the role for someone who wants a roadmap handed to them, or who measures their contribution in tickets closed

title: Storefront and eCommerce
description:
* About the role


 As our Storefront and CRO Manager, you will be the centre of expertise for everything that happens on our storefronts. You will own and drive the storefront experience for Crazy Domains, Vodien and BigRock, and support the wider Digipac group of brands.
   

  

 Our brands sit across a mix of platforms including WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager and our own in\-house stack, with control panels managed separately. A significant part of this role is bringing a coherent roadmap, one standard of experience and one testing discipline across all of them, while respecting where each brand needs to be different.
   

  

 You will be accountable for the storefront roadmap and for the commercial outcomes that come with it, with a focus on conversion rate, cross sell, and the overall quality of the customer experience. You will work with marketing, design, engineering, analytics and brand teams to make sure everything that ships is consistent with our wider eCommerce and marketing strategy.
   

  

 This role offers a largely remote working experience with flexible working hours and the opportunity to work with teams across the globe.
   

  

* Job Description


**What You Will Own**
 Targets are agreed by brand at the start of each financial year with the eCommerce and brand leads. Baselines are set in your first quarter.
   

  

**Revenue and conversion**
* Storefront conversion rate. Improve visit to cart and cart to purchase across priority funnels for each brand.
* Cross sell and attach rate. Grow attach of adjacent products at cart, checkout and in the control panel, measured by attach rate and revenue per visit.
* Average order value and revenue per session. Own the onsite levers that move both, including merchandising, pricing presentation, bundling and upgrade paths.


**Experience And Performance**
* Site performance. Page load and Core Web Vitals on key templates, with particular attention to mobile.
* Experience quality. Reduction in onsite defects reaching production, faster time to resolution on storefront bugs, improved task success and friction scores from behavioral and qualitative research.
* Consistency across brands. A shared component and experience standard applied across the portfolio, so that a fix or a win on one brand can be reused rather than rebuilt.


**Delivery and process**
* Experimentation velocity. An agreed number of tests live per quarter, each with a documented hypothesis, a clean readout and a decision logged, whether the test wins or loses.
* Roadmap delivery. Percentage of committed roadmap delivered in the quarter, and cycle time from PRD to live.
* Delivery against Strategi Project. Own and deliver platform support where applicable for strategic global projects such as brand migrations and consolidations


**A day in the life of our Storefront and Conversion Manager**
**Core deliverables**
* Build, maintain and track the storefront and control panel roadmap across Crazy Domains, Vodien, BigRock and the Digipac brands, keeping it continuously aligned with business strategy and with the commercial priorities of each brand.
* Manage the execution of storefront and customer panel driven marketing, UX and product initiatives from idea through to live.
* Run a continuous onsite testing program, using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and other forms of customer insight, and turn what you learn into a prioritized backlog rather than a folder of results.
* Create PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and build wireframes and high level mockups in Figma alongside our Design team to define desired outcomes.
* Make and manage day to day content, layout and campaign updates on our WordPress properties, and scope and brief larger changes to engineering for our AEM and in\-house stacks.
* Lead storefront redesign and rebranding work as it comes up, covering page templates, navigation, product and pricing pages, cart and checkout.
* Worl closely with storefront QA and pre release teams, so that what goes live matches what was specified and does not quietly break something else.
* Actively participate in and represent marketing in weekly project grooming, sprint planning and release readiness in Jira.
* Continuously measure and report key storefront metrics including conversion rate, click and engagement metrics, funnel drop off and load time.


**Stakeholder management**
* Proactively manage all relevant stakeholders including senior management, building consensus and commitment to project outcomes.
* Work with brand and marketing leads across the portfolio to sequence competing requests into a single roadmap, and be comfortable explaining why something is not being built this quarter.
* Work collaboratively with cross functional stakeholders and in close conjunction with design and engineering teams to align on roadmaps and deliverables across all three stacks.
* Engage and cultivate relationships with partners across the business, gain insight and adopt best practices.
* Partner closely with Analytics and BI teams to evolve our understanding of performance across eCommerce.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales and support teams on go to market planning for products and campaigns.
* Close the loop with customer support and care teams, using what they hear every day as a source of onsite improvements.


**Data and analysis**
* Monitor, report and find ways to improve platform performance across brands and funnel steps.
* Work with the BI team to build visibility for key platform metrics, including dashboards that let brand teams self serve.
* Investigate anomalies and conversion drops quickly, and separate a tracking problem from a real experience problem.
* Analyze data from internal and external sources to develop strategies and define platform objectives.
* Leverage data and insight to continually optimize and maximize the value of our platform and processes.
* Benchmark our storefronts against competitors and against good practice outside our category.


* Additional Job Description


**What You Will Need To Succeed**
* Five or more years in eCommerce, conversion rate optimization, digital product or web experience roles, ideally across multiple brands or markets.
* A demonstrable track record of moving conversion rate, attach rate or average order value, with the ability to talk through how you did it and what you learned when it did not work.
* A keen eye for good design and a strong understanding of user experience.
* A customer first mindset and the ability to apply design thinking principles.
* Data driven, but able to make a judgement call when the data is thin or the sample is small.
* Strong working knowledge of tracking customer journeys, event and tag setup, and the ability to analyze and act on what you see.
* Hands on experience with Figma and Jira. Both are everyday tools in this role, not occasional ones.
* Comfortable working directly in AEM/WordPress (or have the willingness to learn this). You should be able to make and QA basic content, layout and template updates yourself without waiting in a development queue. Experience with Adobe Experience Manager or a similar enterprise CMS is a strong advantage.
* A working understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Enough to read a page, spot what is wrong, estimate effort and hold a credible conversation with engineers. You will not be asked to ship production code.
* Experience with analytics and experimentation tooling such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and similar.
* Strong communication, organizational and analytical skills.
* Attention to detail, comfort with multitasking, and a customer service focus.
* Independent thinking, and not being afraid to suggest new ideas.
* Experience working in an agile organization or with cross functional teams.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.
* Driven by delivery, delivering on time and to a high standard.


**Nice to have**
* Experience in domains, hosting, SaaS or subscription businesses.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and how onsite changes affect organic performance.
* Exposure to Adobe Analytics or Adobe Target.
* Working knowledge of accessibility standards and page speed optimization.
* Experience working across multiple time zones and distributed teams.


**What Success Looks Like**
**First 90 days.** 
 You know our stacks, our funnels and our numbers. You have audited the storefronts across brands, established a clean baseline for conversion, attach and performance, and shipped a first set of quick wins.
   

  

**First six months.** 
 A prioritized storefront roadmap is agreed with brand and engineering leads, a regular testing cadence is running, and reporting is in place that everyone trusts and uses.
   

  

**First twelve months.** 
 Measurable improvement against your conversion, attach and performance targets, a shared experience standard applied across brands, and a healthy backlog of tested, evidenced ideas ready for the following year.
   

  

**Why you'll love us.**
* We've evolved; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work\-from\- home, hybrid, or work\-from\-the\-office environment.
* Work\-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 \+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
* We care about you. At Newfold, taking care of our employees is our top priority. we make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place to for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi\-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
* Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with \#teamnewfold

 :
 



 GridTweak is an AI\-native Grid Intelligence Platform focused on enabling the global energy transition. The platform helps transmission utilities unlock hidden grid capacity, integrate more renewable energy, and reduce curtailment without constructing new transmission lines.
 



  





 Using a validated physics engine combined with proprietary AI, GridTweak delivers real\-time and forecast transmission capacity with high accuracy with no hardware installation required. Utilities rely on GridTweak to increase capacity on existing lines, reduce dependence on fossil\-fuel backup plants, and defer multi\-billion\-dollar grid upgrades.
 



  





 We're solving the critical bottleneck to renewable energy: grid congestion
 



  





 We currently offer no\-cost pilots to select utilities and continue to expand our impact in modernizing power systems.

 :
 



 This is a genuine Co\-Founder role, not a salaried employee position.
 



  





 You will work directly with the founding team and be responsible for shaping the company's strategy, product direction, and market positioning.

 Most importantly, you should want to pursue something of your own.

 Join at an early stage with significant ownership

\* Business \& Entrepreneurship

3\. Build the Creator Community

\* Identify and build relationships with relevant online communities across India.

\* Explore partnerships with finance educators, student communities, professional groups and financial\-content platforms.

Key Performance Indicators

Lead Generation Leads generated through creators

Partnerships High\-value long\-term creator partnerships

Requirements
