title: EAM- FSI GTM
description:
EAM\- FSI GTM  



This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



**Global Sales** at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000\+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector \& small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

***Job Family Definition:***


Manages one or several larger accounts or acts as the account lead for a substantial part of a top account. Understands the customer’s IT and business objectives, priorities, requirements and challenges, and adds value by implementing HPE’s strategy. Drives business performance for all HPE BUs and manages the portfolio mix to optimize profitability of the account. Accountable for pipeline building; accountable for and supportive in deal closing and orchestrating the deal team. Builds and develops relevant customer relationship networks with key influencers and decision makers in IT and business. Develops and engages with the extended partner ecosystem to maximize HPE’s presence in the account. Constantly develops information technology industry knowledge to position HPE’s portfolio in the account. Orchestrates, engages, guides and provides feedback to the extended account team members. Acts as customer’s advocate inside HPE. Plans for accounts to deliver results through the financial year and beyond.

***Management Level Definition:***


Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Frequently contributes to the development of new ideas and methods. Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross\-functional initiatives. Acts as an expert providing direction and guidance to process improvements and establishing policies. Frequently represents the organization to external customers/clients. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives. May provide mentoring and guidance to lower level employees.

**What you’ll do:**

***Responsibilities:***

* Articulates a two\-way connection between the customer's core KPIs, business priorities and initiatives, and the plan to support the customer with IT solutions. Influences the decision\-making of customer executives through describing the value of HPE's solutions and their relevance to the customer's priorities. Positions HPE strategy and solutions in such a way that the customer sees that HPE is critically important to their business. When appropriate, understands the innovation agenda and digital journey of the customer, and provides input into them. Builds a business value framework for the customer.
* Builds and executes a plan to drive growth and profitability across HPE's portfolio, in a structured and recurring way. Drives growth in HPE's strategic value portfolio through positioning these solutions with the customer. Formulates and presents technology choices for the customer that will expand HPE's presence and margin in the account. Leverages HPE programs and tools (e.g. Executive Sponsors, BU deal support, and supply chain programs) to improve business performance. Contributes to internal reviews connected to deals and sales planning.
* Engages with the customer to identify opportunities. Translates customers' business challenges and goals into IT opportunities. Ensures a strong and rightsized pipeline funnel from the account team. Leads pipeline building activities for the account, involving account team members as appropriate. Identifies and develops opportunities for short and mid\-term success. Proactively leads early engagements. Accountable for deal closure. Ensures ownership throughout the team for the deals in the pipeline. Drives deals to closure through a multi\-disciplinary team, including partners.
* Develops and maintains a professional relationship network within the customer to maximize efficiency and effectiveness for HPE. Understands and leverages the underlying principles for the customer organization's functioning. Builds influential relationships with executives. Defines an effective engagement model with the customer's key influencers and decision makers.
* Develops and maintains a view of the partner landscape in the account. Develops partner relationships. Runs an active governance process for the partner network for the account. Works with the Partner Business Manager to assess and update the partner strategy for the account.
* Develops and updates expertise in IT technology. Engages as appropriate with the customer's CTO/CIO. Articulates relevant modern trends in IT and presents them to executives within the customer when appropriate. Describes HPE's portfolio and references its use in other customers.
* Builds, develops and leads the extended account team. Runs a governance with the extended team and empowers account team to engage on different levels within the account. Establishes a recurring process to provide feedback to the account team members and the relevant managers.
* Provides feedback into other HPE organizations and coordinates with other customer facing HPE organizations to improve the customer experience. Utilizes HPE tools and processes for customer advocacy. Leverages the existing tools, processes and resources to assure customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Develops and executes a comprehensive account business plan for defined accounts. Manages the collective effort to build and maintain both strategic and tactical elements of the plan. Shares and aligns the plan with relevant stakeholders of the account.

**What you need to bring**

***Education and Experience:***

* University or Bachelor’s Degree preferred, or equivalent experience. Engineering or technology education, advanced degree or MBA desired.
* Typically 6\-10\+ years account management experience.
* Experience in IT industry preferred. Experience working within an IT department and/or working within customers is a plus.
* Experience in vertical industry preferred.
* Experience in different sales roles is a plus.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* **Drives Results**: Shows strong will to win, is persistent in face of obstacles and has a clear results orientation.
* **Strategic Planning**: Able to skillfully articulate a vision for the future and a path to achieve it in an account business plan, aligned with the HPE strategy, direct leadership, and the HPE business units.
* **Sales Execution**: Able to efficiently deliver on short term sales engagements and objectives.
* **Continuous Learning**: Continuously and actively pursues own learning.
* **IT Industry Acumen**: Builds and maintains thorough knowledge of cutting edge IT industry developments and technology trends with potential impacts to our customers.
* **HPE Portfolio Knowledge**: Builds and continually updates a thorough understanding of HPE products, solutions, and service offerings \- their value propositions, competitive differentiators, and benefits to our customers and our customers' customers.
* **Team Leadership**: Skilled at leading teams (including dispersed and indirect team members) successfully through sales engagements in a complex matrix organization.
* **Network/Relationship Building**: Skilled at creating strong professional relationships; understands and leverages the value of networks and collaboration.
* **Two\-way communication**: Able to listen actively to understand the perspectives of others, and to articulate value propositions, plans, and proposals in language relevant to the customer, partner or internal stakeholder.
* **Influencing and Negotiating**: Understands and proficiently leverages influencing and negotiation techniques.
* **Business Acumen**: Understands how different parts of a business interoperate to produce business outcomes and how actions impact company results. Has a thorough understanding of general business concepts and the economy. Able to understand financial reports and make relevant conclusions for planning. Similar principles apply to public sector organizations.
* **Operational Excellence**: Able to show predictability and operational excellence both internally and externally.
* **Integrity**: Acts with integrity throughout complex situations even if under pressure.
* **Vertical/Industry Knowledge Preferred**: Understands the customer's industry landscape, enterprise architecture, and partner and influencer ecosystem, and is able to use this knowledge to build and advise the customer on its digital journey plan.
* **Consulting**: Can synthesize a number of skills and relevant knowledge to guide the customer through a process of achieving business outcomes leveraging HPE's portfolio.

***Impact/Scope:***

* Typically manages 1 to many accounts representing moderate revenue for HPE. One or more accounts may be a large multi\-national or global account. May manage a portion of a large Top Account, usually within an assigned geography.
* Typically qualifies and closes large deals of moderate to high complexity and cross\-BU scope.
* Works with all levels of decision\-makers in the customer organization.
* Orchestrates regional pursuit resources for the account.
* Participates in account investment decisions about pricing and resources.

***Complexity:***

* Leads complex sales engagements, project management and coordination to meet deadlines.
* Typically oversees engagements with cross\-BU portfolio solutions.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health \& Wellbeing**


We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal \& Professional Development**


We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**


We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**


Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

title: Brand Communication Manager
description:
**Location:** Navi Mumbai**Employment Type:** Full\-Time**About the Role**
------------------


We are seeking a dynamic and strategic **Brand Communication Manager** to lead our brand’s voice, positioning, and market presence. This role will be responsible for driving end\-to\-end communication strategies—from crafting compelling content to enabling sales and delivering impactful marketing campaigns and events.
The ideal candidate is a **creative storyteller with a data\-driven mindset**, capable of building strong brand narratives while supporting revenue growth initiatives. We are **specifically looking for candidates with experience in the trading domain**, who understand industry nuances, audience behavior, and market dynamics.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. Content Strategy \& Creation**

* Develop high\-quality, on\-brand content across formats: blogs, whitepapers, case studies, newsletters, video scripts, and thought leadership pieces.
* Ensure consistency in tone, messaging, and brand identity across all channels.
* Align content with business objectives and marketing goals.

### **2\. Social Media Management**

* Own and manage social media platforms (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube).
* Plan and execute content calendars and growth strategies.
* Track performance metrics, engage with audiences, and optimise platform performance.

### **3\. Presentation \& Visual Communication**

* Design impactful presentations for leadership, client pitches, and industry events.
* Ensure all presentations adhere to brand guidelines and communicate ideas clearly.
* Utilise tools such as PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, or Adobe Suite.

### **4\. Campaign Planning \& Execution**

* Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels.
* Define objectives, manage timelines and budgets, and track campaign KPIs.
* Drive brand awareness, lead generation, and customer engagement.

### **5\. Pre\-Sales Enablement**

* Partner with sales teams to create customised pitch decks, proposals, and product collateral.
* Tailor messaging to industry\-specific pain points and client needs.

### **6\. Sales Collateral Management**

* Develop and maintain a repository of sales assets including one\-pagers, case studies, product sheets, and FAQs.
* Ensure all materials remain updated, relevant, and aligned with brand standards.

### **7\. CRM \& Data Hygiene**

* Maintain CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) to ensure accurate and updated data.
* Implement data hygiene practices to improve segmentation, reporting, and campaign effectiveness.

### **8\. Lead Generation \& Funnel Optimization**

* Support lead generation initiatives through campaigns, gated content, and partnerships.
* Monitor lead quality, conversion metrics, and optimise funnel performance.

### **9\. Demand Generation**

* Design and execute demand generation strategies including ABM, nurturing campaigns, paid media, and SEO.
* Drive high\-quality pipeline and accelerate conversion rates.

### **10\. Inbound \& Outbound Marketing**

* Execute inbound strategies (SEO, content marketing, landing pages) and outbound campaigns (email, LinkedIn, paid ads).
* Measure performance and optimise channel ROI.

### **11\. Events \& Industry Engagement**

* Plan and manage participation in industry events, conferences, and webinars.
* Handle end\-to\-end execution including promotion, logistics, and follow\-ups.
* Maximise brand visibility and lead acquisition.

**Qualifications \& Skills**
----------------------------

### **Education \& Experience**

* Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in brand communication or B2B marketing.
* Experience in technology, consulting, or professional services is preferred.

### **Core Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot) and marketing automation platforms.
* Solid understanding of SEO, SEM, digital marketing, and analytics tools.
* Advanced skills in presentation and design tools (PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, Adobe).
* Event management experience with strong execution capabilities.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to derive insights from data.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* A fast\-paced, high\-growth work environment.
* Opportunities for professional development and industry exposure.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Exposure to diverse markets and leading\-edge brands.

description:
**About Druva**
 Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud\-native SaaS platform that delivers air\-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on\-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph\-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.
   

  

 Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.
   

  

 Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The SaaS Apps product line is a significant revenue generator for Druva with massive expansion and growth plans in the near term. With the explosion in AI and the implications for data protection, data governance, identity and security, many key Druva initiatives are being driven out of the SaaS Apps team. This is a key role with major scope and will provide opportunity for immediate impact and company\-wide visibility. The candidate will gain valuable experience in a hyper\-growth startup and develop key career skills on driving a growing product to product\-market fit and SaaS go\-to\-market.
   

  

**Role Purpose \& Impact**
 This is a field and customer\-facing product management role which acts as a strategic partner to senior leadership, influencing product direction and aligning the SaaS roadmap with company objectives. You will collaborate with our cross\-functional customer\-facing teams to interact with our growing customer base to understand their data protection, security and governance needs and bring back insights and ideas for Druva’s roadmap.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Explore new product features, concepts and develop comprehensive market/product requirements across SaaS applications
* Sales, Customer interaction for product demos, roadmap presentations, product feedback and escalations
* Analyze business metrics to develop insights for product go\-to\-market activities and execute on them in collaboration with product marketing, sales
* Work with product managers and product marketing team to build key product marketing collateral and deliver field sales team training
* Analyze product telemetry to develop insights for product roadmap and drive product adoption
* Respond to industry analyst questionnaires, surveys and develop analyst facing presentations


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* 8\+ years of total professional experience building and shipping B2B SaaS products, with at least 5 years of functional product management experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, MBA would be a plus
* Experience working in the data protection domain, particularly in the Microsoft ecosystem (M365, Copilot, D365, Intune)
* Experience with other major SaaS platforms (Google, Salesforce, ServiceNow) a major plus
* Experience with Identity infrastructure (Entra ID, Okta, Active Directory) a major plus


**Highly technical background with an ability to dive deep into products, technology, UX**
* Excellent product sense with an ability/empathy to deeply focus on customer pain points, workflows and an ability to articulate the same
* Highly analytical with an ability to understand metrics, develop a data driven point\-of\-view


**Excellent PM Presence With Clear Written, Verbal Communication Skills**
* Track record of iterating, taking ownership and driving products from concept to execution
* Experience working in high growth, startup environments, with a can\-do attitude


**What Success Looks Like In The Role**
* Ensure customer success through strategic leadership, operational excellence, and collaboration with cross\-functional teams
* Establish strong relationships with customers and partners in order to drive outside\-in thinking across the organization
* Identify new business opportunities based on deep understanding of customer needs, competitive offerings, and Druva’s unique value proposition
* Drive planning and execution of new high\-profile products to support revenue growth.
* Enable the sales and technical sales teams so that they can successfully sell products and deliver maximum ROI for customers
* Mentor and guide junior product managers, fostering a culture of best\-practice sharing.
* Lead the discovery and definition of long\-term product strategy, translating market trends and deep customer insights into actionable, multi\-quarter roadmaps.


**Why You’ll Love Working Here**
 Innovation is how we operate, not a side project. You’ll work in a culture that values bold thinking and continuous improvement, where global teams experiment, iterate, and turn new ideas into products customers can rely on.
   

  

 If you’re looking for high\-ownership work, visible impact, and a culture that values innovation, collaboration, accountability, and growth—where you’ll be trusted to lead and empowered to build—you’ll thrive at Druva.

title: Product Owner
description:
**About Tripstack**
 Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019\. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining.
   

  

 Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform \- giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non\-partner, low\-cost and full\-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost\-effective API.
   

  

 Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily.
   

  

 Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection.
   

  

 For more information, visit:
   

  

 www.tripstack.com
   

  

 www.etraveligroup.com
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As a Product Owner at Tripstack, you'll report into a Product Manager serving as an operational leader and product strategist for your portfolio within the Content Acquisition team.
   

  

 You will oversee the integration and operation of flight content into our platform, ensuring we maintain world\-leading content at the highest possible quality while keeping our systems stable and performant.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Incident Management**
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance of your assigned content portfolio (APIs, consolidators, or scrapes), ensuring system stability, SLA adherence, and production health
* Lead incident management and structured RCA (root cause analysis) investigations for any issues; drive resolution tracking and prevention of recurring production issues
* Define, monitor, and proactively manage operational KPIs: uptime, latency, booking failures, error rates, conversion impact, and portfolio risks
* Act as primary operational escalation point for airline\-related issues, coordinating rapidly across engineering, product teams, and external airline partners


**Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Priority Management**
* Facilitate resource planning and allocation decisions with your engineering team; identify constraints and trade\-offs
* Manage the balance between competing priorities (new feature development, production support, incident response, and ad\-hoc requests)
* Define and communicate clear priorities to engineering teams \- including what gets deprioritized and why
* Coordinate all team standups, sprint planning, ROMs (Rough Order of Magnitude reviews), and alignment meetings
* Track dependencies, blockers, and risks; escalate appropriately and coordinate cross\-team resolution
* Monitor sprint velocity, deliverables, and team output; continuously optimize processes for delivery efficiency


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Communication**
* Align internal stakeholders (engineering, product leadership, data teams) and external partners (Etraveli Group, airlines, consolidators) around priorities, timelines, and expectations
* Communicate operational status, KPIs, and business decisions clearly and concisely \- orally and in writing
* Facilitate regular sync meetings with engineering leadership, other product teams, and stakeholders
* Prepare status reports, milestone updates, and analytics dashboards for leadership visibility


**Product Definition \& Requirements**
* Translate high\-level business objectives and customer needs into clear, well\-documented product requirements and user stories
* Define acceptance criteria and work with QA to establish test cases
* Establish acceptance criteria and work with QA teams to build comprehensive test cases
* Create reusable components and standardized approaches across recipe integrations to improve quality and reduce duplicative work


**Strategic Analysis \& Decision\-Making**
* Conduct data\-backed analysis to inform prioritization decisions; evaluate impact against business value
* Work with architects, engineering managers, and product leaders to assess technical feasibility and design efficient solutions
* Identify opportunities for improvement in security, CI/CD, quality, and performance practices
* Monitor KPIs tied to product decisions and iterate based on results
* Root cause analysis of systemic product issues and recommend structural improvements


**Partnership with Engineering \& Architecture**
* Collaborate with engineering leads on solution architecture, ensuring alignment between product vision and technical implementation
* Work with platform and engineering teams to identify and resolve technical blockers
* Support architecture decisions that balance speed of delivery with long\-term platform health


 Job Requirements
   

  

* 3\+ years hands\-on experience in a product or program management role with significant operational responsibility
* Strong project management and organizational skills with ability to juggle multiple competing priorities
* Excellent communication skills across technical teams, product teams, and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strategic thinker with strong experience in data\-backed decision making
* Comfort with ambiguity; ability to move fast and make decisions with incomplete information
* Leadership skills: ability to bring teams together toward a common purpose and coordinate across multiple teams


**Technical \& Industry Knowledge**
* Knowledge of software architecture, REST, cloud platforms, platform engineering, and microservices
* Experience working as a hands\-on QA engineer or application developer would be advantageous
* Travel industry experience \- particularly with airline APIs, NDC standards, or GDS/PSS systems
* Experience building airline or flight content integrations
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring tools, and production observability platforms


**Personal Attributes**
* Output and delivery driven; results\-oriented mindset
* Resilient with ability to thrive under pressure and competing demands
* Proficient in communication: clear, concise, and professional across contexts
* Passion for problem\-solving, root cause analysis, and operational excellence
* Highly accountable team player; takes ownership of outcomes


**Benefits**
 We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high\-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world\-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!
   

  

 At Tripstack, we proudly believe in embracing diversity. This is true for our team, clients, communities and stakeholders. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating a safe, healthy and accessible environment. We encourage applications regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other grounds protected by law. Please let us know if you need any accommodations during any part of the recruitment process.
   

  

 Tripstack thanks all applicants for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.
   

  

 Learn more about us at www.tripstack.com

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \- SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high\-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C\-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade\-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI\-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go\-to\-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision\-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine\-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**
* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high\-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* \- Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time\-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI\-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real\-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.


**Core Consulting**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI\-enabled digital transformation, data \& AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.


**Preferred:**
* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

description:
**Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader**

 Faurecia Clarion Electronics (FCE) is seeking an experienced
 **Product Development Lead** 
 to drive the end\-to\-end technical delivery of automotive electronic products and platforms from
 **RFQ through development, industrialization, launch, and series production support** 
 . The role serves as the primary technical interface with customers and leads cross\-functional teams to achieve quality, cost, timing, and performance objectives.

* Lead product development activities across RFQ, design, validation, industrialization, launch, and serial\-life support.

* Act as the primary technical contact for customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

* Ensure requirements are analyzed, allocated, traced, implemented, and validated.

* Automotive embedded systems lifecycle, systems engineering, requirements management, integration, validation, and release management.

* Agile/Scrum and traditional development methodologies.
* Tools: Jira, Confluence, Requirements Management, PLM, Configuration Management, and Defect Tracking Systems.

****Mindset / Attitude****
* Strong leadership, ownership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Customer\-focused with strong execution and accountability.
* Analytical problem solver with a focus on quality, cost, risk, and delivery.


**What We Can Do For You**

* We are the seventh\-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
* We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast\-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
* We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in\-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)
* We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans.
* Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net\-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1\.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.


**Why join us**
 FORVIA, a global automotive technology supplier, comprises the complementary technology and industrial strengths of Faurecia and HELLA.
   

  

 With over 137 500 people, including more than 12,000 R\&D engineers across 40\+ countries, FORVIA provides a unique and comprehensive approach to the automotive challenges of today and tomorrow. Composed of 6 business groups and a strong IP portfolio of over 12,400 patents, FORVIA is focused on becoming the preferred innovation and integration partner for OEMs worldwide.
   

  

 In 2025, the Group achieved a consolidated revenue of 26\.2 billion euros prior to IFRS 5\. FORVIA SE is listed on the Euronext Paris market under the FRVIA mnemonic code and is a component of the SBF 120 index.
   

  

 FORVIA aims to be a change maker committed to foreseeing and making the mobility transformation happen. www.forvia.com

title: Growth Manager (D2C)
description:
\[
 **Apply with the Excel sheet at the bottom]**
 Blue Dot Transform Consulting is a private limited company based out of pune. It works in multiple domain \- training \& Coaching, e\-commerce, alternative healing modalities.
   

  

 For the e\-commerce brand \- Divine Heals, we are currently hiring a growth manager.
   

  

 Divine Heals is a D2C spiritual products brand — The brand sells crystals, Rudraksha, essential oils, and combination bracelets, with a post\-purchase journey designed to move customers into Charu's coaching programmes.
   

  

 The brand is live, growing, and generating revenue. What it does not yet have is an operational system that can scale without the founder or the business head being pulled into execution daily.
   

  

 This role exists to build that system — and then run it.
   

 You will own the full operations function of Divine Heals.
   

  

 Shopify, fulfillment, inventory, post\-purchase flows, WhatsApp automation, SOPs, vendor management, customer experience, and the backend processes that make the business work without someone manually holding everything together.
   

  

 The marketing strategy and content are handled. Charu remains the face of the brand. Your job is to make sure everything behind the face works.
   

  

 What you will own
   

  

 Shopify and store operations
   

  

 Product page quality — descriptions, imagery formatting, size guides, care instructions, trust elements
   

  

 Inventory management — stock tracking, reorder triggers, low\-stock alerts
   

  

 Checkout experience — friction reduction, GoKwik integration performance, cart abandonment flows
   

 New product launches — end\-to\-end coordination from product briefing to live listing
   

  

 Pricing and offer architecture — seasonal promotions, bundle logic, prepaid incentives
   

 Fulfilment and logistics
   

  

 Shadowfax and XpressBees coordination — daily dispatch, exception handling, return management
   

 Shipping policy — SLA adherence, delay communication to customers, escalation handling
   

  

 COD to prepaid conversion — building incentive structures and checkout nudges to shift the ratio
   

 Customer experience
   

  

 Post\-purchase WhatsApp sequence — building and managing the 14\-day nurture flow in Charu's voice that moves buyers toward the Level I coaching programme
   

  

 Query handling SOP — standard responses, escalation paths, response time standards
   

 Review and testimonial system — collection, verification, and deployment across Shopify and social
   

  

 Automation and systems
   

  

 WhatsApp automation via QuickReply.ai — flows, triggers, campaign sequences
   

  

 Email marketing — post\-purchase drip, product education sequences, seasonal campaigns via whatever tool is in use
   

  

 CRM or tracking system — building a basic customer record so follow\-up is systematic, not memory\-based
   

 SOPs and documentation
   

  

 Every operational process documented — written down, version\-controlled, and accessible to the team
   

 Onboarding new team members into the Divine Heals operational workflow
   

  

 Monthly operations report — inventory status, fulfilment metrics, customer satisfaction indicators, open issues
   

  

  

  

 What we are looking for
   

 Non\-negotiable
   

  

 4\-5 years of hands\-on D2C operations experience — you have worked inside a D2C brand and you know what it takes to run one, not just advise one
   

 Shopify proficiency — you can manage products, collections, discounts, apps, and basic theme edits without needing a developer for everything
   

 Experience building or managing post\-purchase flows — WhatsApp, email, or both
   

 SOPs mindset — you document what you build. If it only exists in your head, it does not exist.
   

  

  

  

 Strong advantage
   

  

 Experience in spiritual, wellness, or lifestyle D2C categories — you understand the customer and the purchase psychology
   

  

 Familiarity with QuickReply.ai or similar WhatsApp business automation tools
   

  

 Experience managing logistics partners — Shadowfax, XpressBees, Shiprocket, or equivalent
   

 Understanding of COD\-heavy D2C operations in India — prepaid conversion strategies, RTO reduction, return management
   

  

 Experience with GoKwik or similar checkout optimisation tools

* Self\-motivated with the ability to lead a global team toward a common goal.

**Key Behaviors:**
* Collaboration;
* Result – oriented;
* Critical thinking;
* Evaluating problems;


**Reporting Structure:** 
 Reports to the Associate Manager of the Display Quote team.
   

  

**In the fast** 
 lane of technology. At Visteon, we’re redefining how the world connects through its vehicles. Our innovations transform the driving experience for millions, powered by a high\-performance culture that challenges the status quo and sparks new possibilities—in careers and communities. Join us and help shape the future.

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Product Manager \- Technical
Overview  

  

MasterCard Data \& Services enables customers across industries and geographies to make smarter decisions and reach better outcomes with a tailored portfolio of solutions beyond the transaction.  

  

* We harness the power of real\-time, anonymized, aggregated transaction data; powerful software platforms; and a wealth of expertise

* We work with financial institutions, retailers, telecommunications organizations, travel companies, and more

  

The MasterCard Data \& Services Operational Insights Program Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology\-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements leading to building and commercialisation of products and services.
  

  

This individual will partner closely with other Global Product Management team members to support the development of the product strategy and ensure product priorities are well\-aligned with commercial objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long\-term technical vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.
  

  

Product Managers in Data \& Services at Mastercard
  

  

* Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value

  

* Balance the long\-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products

  

* Ensure the technical success of our products through close partnerships with Technology teams

  

* Drive globally relevant solutions by understanding regional needs and trade\-offs, and building scalable products that serve an array of customer segments

  

* Set product direction with coordination, not in isolation—taking into account how our products all work together to serve customer needs

  

Role  

  

* Own, define and deliver end\-to\-end strategy for multiple features for the products from inception to launch

  

* Design and conduct user research, including customer interviews, to deepen understanding of customers’ pain points, motivations and opportunities

  

* Work closely with engineering teams, designers, and operational teams to prioritize development efforts as they align against product strategy

  

* Determine release goals for the platforms and prioritize assigned features

  

* Ensure consistent alignment between business priorities and development objectives

  

* Oversee timely and high\-quality execution of the creation of technical requirements

  

* Build strong working relationships with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to achieve product goals

  

* Translate business priorities into clear, actionable technical requirements for the engineering team

  

* Identify issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirement and communicate to the leadership

  

* Promote internal and external feature adoption

  

* Partner with internal teams to answer product questions and provide product support

  

* Provide input into product pricing and our go\-to\-market strategy

  

* Exhibit expertise within the platform feature area and coordinate with interdependent teams

  

All About You  

  

* Proficient agile product management experience in analytical products and business intelligence solutions

  

* Extensive experience in managing analytical solutions designed for payments or related financial services sectors preferred

  

* Analytical, solutions\-oriented skillset with the ability to drive thought leadership

  

* Experience designing, executing, and distilling user research to drive value for the customer, an outstanding user experience and stickiness

  

* Requires minimal supervision/assistance

  

* Keen understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends in the data monetization, self\-service analytics and predictive insights space, and the ability to translate that understanding into meaningful actions and enhancements

  

* Proven track record collaborating in cross\-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features

  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to interface with clients

  

* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities

  

* Knowledge and skills using product management tools, (e.g., market and product plans, project timelines, marketing research, pricing, business case development)

  

* Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant experience

  

* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science or related field) a plus

  

* Experience in the payments industry with data insights a plus

  

* Certifications in product management and agile processes will be an added advantage

  

* An advanced degree is helpful

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: AI Transformation Lead
description:
Mergen Compass is seeking an entrepreneurial, client\-facing AI Transformation Lead to build, commercialise and deliver AI\-enabled consulting and digital\-product solutions for enterprises, startups, public\-sector organisations and ecosystem partners.
 
   
 




 The role is to drive AI use\-cases end\-to\-end i.e. owning the roadmap, delivery, and go\-to\-market that turn high\-value use cases into measurable impact across how the client sells, serves it's customers, and operates.
 
   
 




 The successful candidate will own opportunities from discovery and commercial closure through solution definition, delivery, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.
 
   
 




 Mergen Compass provides practical, data\-driven and execution\-focused consulting support across growth strategy, market entry, business transformation, digital products and implementation. The firm works with corporates, startups and public\-sector organisations across India, the Middle East and international markets.
 
  
 
  
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilties** 
  
 




  
 





 AI Strategy \& Use\-Case Ownership
 

  
 



* Own the AI transformation roadmap for the clients, prioritizing use cases, and driving consensus across key stakeholders on the same.
* Translate opportunities into clearly scoped initiatives with defined success metrics, owners, and timelines.
* Maintain a sharp view of the client's priorities, ensuring AI initiatives are sequenced against the problems that matter most.



  






 AI Product Delivery
 

  
 



* Drive the end\-to\-end delivery of AI products and agents \- spanning conversational and voice agents, AI\-generated client narratives, and internal/external productized tools \- from build through testing, go\-live, and iteration.
* Run disciplined launch governance, including mandatory Go/No\-Go decisions, milestone calendaring, and structured course\-correction when risks surface.
* Set and hold quality and performance bars (e.g. accuracy targets, latency, conversation quality) and define the test cases and acceptance criteria required for go\-live.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to unblock delivery, and manage external AI vendors and partners against scope, cost, and quality.
* Go\-to\-Market \& Client Rollout
* Design and execute the GTM for AI products \- defining target segments, decision\-maker outreach, launch sequencing, and enablement.
* Build the supporting assets and operating model for rollout: sales scripts, communication templates, support flows, manuals, and beta framing.
* Coordinate sales leaders, business consultants, and client\-facing teams through structured testing and launch and establish feedback loops to capture qualitative and quantitative outcomes from clients.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Act as the connective layer across Strategy, Product, Engineering, Commercial, and external partners, aligning them around shared goals and timelines.
* Influence and align senior stakeholders, sequencing the right people into the right decisions at the right time.
* Coach and direct junior team members and contributors supporting AI workstreams, raising the bar on execution quality across the group.



**Desired Qualifications** 

  
 



* 5–6 years of experience in a high\-performance environment (top\-tier consulting \+ strategy, product, or AI/technology), with a track record of shipping initiatives to outcomes.
* Prior work in software engineering is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex, cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end \- structuring ambiguous problems, driving execution, and managing risk and stakeholders to a result.
* Strong fluency with applied AI \- practical understanding of LLMs, agents, and AI product workflows \- and the judgment to know where AI does and does not create value.
* Experience driving go\-to\-market or commercial rollout, ideally with client\-facing or sales stakeholders.
* Comfort with data: able to define metrics, work with data to diagnose and decide, and build a compelling, insight\-led business case.
* Excellent storytelling and executive communication — able to build crisp narratives and presentations for senior and executive audiences.
* Ability to work with and influence people at all levels of the organization, and to direct or coach others on delivery.

title: D2C Lead
description:
**Company Description:** 




 Sneakare is a New Delhi\-based, fastest\-growing sneaker care brand, built for people who genuinely love what they are wearing on their feet. We market premium, no\-nonsense products — cleaning kits, insoles, suede care, and storage solutions — designed to help sneaker fans protect what they paid for and wear what they love, longer. We started small, made it to Shark Tank India, and haven't slowed down since. Our team is young, fast\-moving, and obsessed with getting things right — whether that's a product formula, a listing copy, or a customer interaction. We care about quality over shortcuts, ownership over excuses, and learning over ego.
 



  





**Job Overview:** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on D2C Lead to fully own our website — sales, updates, maintenance, analysis, retention, and performance. This is a single\-owner role: there is no separate website/tech/CRM team behind you today, so you'll both set the strategy and execute the day\-to\-day. You're accountable for revenue coming through the site, how it looks and runs, and how well we keep bringing customers back. You'll work closely with the Founder, marketing, and external dev/tech vendors.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Website Sales \& Revenue** 




 • Own the website's revenue number end\-to\-end — set monthly/quarterly targets with the Founder and be accountable for hitting them
 



 • Plan and execute on\-site promotions, discounting, and bundling strategy to hit revenue targets without eroding margin
 



 • Work with marketing to align website offers/landing pages with paid and organic campaigns
 



**2\. Website Updates \& Content** 




 • Manage all product listings — new launches, pricing changes, descriptions, images, and stock status
 



 • Update homepage, banners, collections, and campaign pages in line with the marketing/promo calendar
 



 • Keep site content (policies, FAQs, size/fit guides) accurate and current
 



**3\. Maintenance \& Technical Health** 




 • Monitor site uptime, page speed, and mobile experience; flag and triage issues before they hit customers
 



 • Coordinate bug fixes and feature builds with the developer/agency, writing clear requirements and testing before go\-live
 



 • Own the Shopify (or equivalent) app/plugin stack — evaluate new tools, manage renewals, and remove what isn't earning its keep
 



**4\. Analysis \& Reporting** 




 • Track the full funnel — traffic, conversion rate, AOV, cart/checkout drop\-off — and know where the leaks are
 



 • Build and maintain a recurring performance dashboard (GA4/Shopify analytics) for leadership review
 



 • Run structured A/B tests on landing pages, PDPs, and checkout flow to improve conversion
 



**5\. Retention** 




 • Own retention channels — email, SMS, WhatsApp — from flow design (welcome, abandoned cart, post\-purchase, winback) to performance tracking
 



 • Design and iterate on loyalty/subscription mechanics to increase repeat purchase rate
 



 • Segment the customer base and personalize campaigns/offers by behaviour (first\-time vs. repeat, high\-AOV, etc.)
 



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 6\-12 Months):** 




 • Website revenue is tracked weekly and hitting agreed targets, with clear visibility into what's driving or dragging performance
 



 • Conversion rate and AOV show a measurable, explainable improvement over the baseline
 



 • A live retention program (email/SMS/WhatsApp flows) is running and contributing a growing share of repeat revenue
 



 • Site uptime/speed issues are caught and resolved before they meaningfully impact sales
 



 • Leadership has a reliable, self\-serve dashboard instead of needing to ask for numbers
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 • 4\-6 years of experience in D2C e\-commerce, website management, or growth roles (D2C/e\-commerce brand background preferred)
 



 • Hands\-on experience managing a Shopify (or similar) storefront, including working directly with developers/agencies
 



 • Strong grasp of web analytics (GA4, Shopify analytics) and CRO fundamentals
 



 • Experience running retention/CRM programs (e.g. Klaviyo, WebEngage, or similar)
 



 • Comfortable working with data — strong Excel skills; ability to turn numbers into a decision, not just a report
 



 • Ability to own a function solo — this role has no team under it today
 



 • Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment
 



  





**Experience:** 
 4\-6 years
 



**Location:** 
 Kirti Nagar, Delhi (Onsite)
 



**Department:** 
 D2C / E\-commerce
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time

 Amenify was founded in 2017 in San Francisco and has raised $25M to date. Amenify is the leading AI\-powered resident commerce platform in the US that helps property managers and residents with services they love. Through a proprietary network of local providers, enterprise integrations, and personalized concierge tools, Amenify powers services like local retail, dining, grocery, home services, maintenance, and more. Through its API integrations powering resident engagement, Amenify is available in 15 million homes in the USA. We encourage high\-performers from all backgrounds to reach out, provided they share our core values listed here: https://www.amenify.com/about\-us.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Product Manager** 
 to bridge business, product, and engineering teams. You will own products end\-to\-end, from defining requirements and roadmap to execution, launch, and optimization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own product roadmap, priorities, and product strategy.
* Translate business and customer needs into PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, and business teams to deliver products on time.
* Understand technical architecture, APIs, integrations, databases, and engineering dependencies.
* Manage product backlog, sprint priorities, releases, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Track product KPIs and use data and customer feedback to drive improvements.
* Identify opportunities for new features, automation, and product enhancements.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years of experience in Product Management / Technical Product Management.
* Strong experience working closely with engineering teams.
* Good understanding of software development, APIs, databases, and system architecture.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as Jira.
* Engineering/Computer Science background is preferred.
* Experience with AI/ML or SaaS products is a plus.



  





**Why should you join us?** 



* Above\-industry salary \+ performance bonus \+ monthly bonus
* Stock options according to performance in long term
* Team lunches and outings
* High\-growth trajectory with rapid learning
* Best referral bonus in the market
* Massive ownership of work \& projects
* Direct 1:1 time with founders
* Work with an ambitious, collaborative, transparent team



  





**Meet our Founders:** 



* Danish Chopra
* Everett Lynn

title: Product Manager
description:
**About 30 Sundays** 




 30 Sundays is on a mission to build the most customer\-centric outbound leisure travel company from India. We combine deep destination expertise with technology, operational rigor, and a strong bias for action to deliver effortless, high\-quality travel experiences while building a profitable, scalable business.
 



 Founded by alumni from Apple, BCG, and IIT. Backed by InfoEdge Ventures and Eximius Ventures.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're hiring a Product Manager to own and build products across the 30 Sundays ecosystem, from customer\-facing tools that power the pre\-sales and post\-sales journey, to internal platforms that make our sales and operations teams more effective.
 



  





 Depending on the vertical, you could be shaping how couples discover, plan, and experience travel, or building the systems that help our teams sell smarter, operate faster, and deliver at scale.
 



  





 This role is for a builder. Someone who combines deep user empathy, strong product judgment, data fluency, and AI\-first thinking to turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions. We believe PMs should be able to go from idea to working prototype fast, using vibe coding with tools like Claude, Cursor, and Replit to build, test, and validate without waiting for engineering cycles.
 



  





 This is an early\-stage, high\-intensity environment. You'll wear multiple hats, move fast, and have outsized ownership. If you thrive in ambiguity and want to build things that ship, not just write docs about them, read on.
 



  





**What You'll Work On** 



* Own the end\-to\-end product experience for your vertical, whether customer\-facing or internal
* Define and drive a clear product vision grounded in user needs and business impact
* Lead product discovery through user research, stakeholder interviews, feedback loops, and data
* Translate insights into clear PRDs, prioritized roadmaps, and measurable success metrics
* Rapidly build functional prototypes and internal tools using vibe coding, turning ideas into working software by prompting AI tools like Claude, rather than waiting for dev bandwidth
* Use LLMs and automation to streamline workflows, personalize experiences, and reduce manual effort
* Use analytics, funnels, cohorts, and experiments to guide decisions and measure outcomes
* Conduct competitive and category research to inform product direction
* Partner closely with design and engineering to ship high\-quality experiences
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with ops, CX, sales, growth, and tech teams to drive adoption and impact



  





**Requirements** 



* 3\+ years of Product Management experience with clear ownership of a product or product area
* Experience building B2C consumer products (web or mobile), travel, fintech, e\-commerce, food delivery, or similar domains where the end user is a person making lifestyle or purchase decisions
* Strong user\-centric mindset, whether the user is a customer booking a trip, a salesperson closing a deal, or an ops team member planning logistics
* Hands\-on comfort with vibe coding, you've used tools like Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or Replit to build working apps, dashboards, automations, or prototypes. Not just used AI to write docs, but actually shipped something.
* Comfort using data and analytics to drive prioritization and measure impact (SQL, Mixpanel, GA4, or similar)
* Familiarity with AI tools, LLM capabilities, and automation platforms
* Solid understanding of UX principles and lifecycle thinking
* Strong academic background or demonstrated intellectual rigor



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in travel, hospitality, or high\-consideration purchase categories
* Experience at an early\-stage startup (seed to Series A) where you wore multiple hats
* Growth and funnel expertise, SEO, conversion optimization, A/B testing, retention loops
* Side projects, community building, or entrepreneurial attempts that show initiative beyond the day job



  





**Why Join 30 Sundays** 



* Own a product vertical end\-to\-end at a fast\-growing travel company redefining how Indians travel internationally
* Work directly with founders (ex\-Apple, ex\-BCG, ex\-IIT) with high autonomy and real impact
* Build both the customer experience (how couples discover and book travel) and the engine behind it (how the team sells, plans, and delivers)
* Ship fast using AI and vibe coding, we value PMs who can build, not just spec
* Shape AI\-driven, user\-first products in a category (outbound leisure travel) that's still early and wide open
* Gurugram, on\-site. Competitive base \+ meaningful ESOPs.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
