title: Product Lead – EdTech
description:
**About GIDE:** 

 GIDE AI is a premium career counselling and college advisory platform that helps Indian students win admissions to the world's top\-tier universities. Our ecosystem spans test preparation (SAT, ACT, AP, IELTS, TOEFL, TMUA), the GPATHS career assessment, and GIDE Exclusive college mentorship. We are now building GIDE 2\.0, our futuristic product, and we are looking for a Product Lead to help us design a platform that brings counselling, test prep, and study\-abroad journeys together in one intelligent experience.
 




  





**The Role:** 
 You will sit at the intersection of business, counselling, and technology. Your core job is to listen to every team, translate what they need into a clear product vision, and work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our engineers and designers to build it. You will own how requirements become process, and how process becomes a platform that students and counsellors love to use.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 



* Consolidate the requirements of counselling, test prep, study\-abroad, operations, and marketing teams into a single, coherent product roadmap.
* Map end\-to\-end user and business processes, spotting gaps, overlaps, and opportunities to simplify.
* Translate business needs into clear PRDs, user stories, and specifications the tech team can build against.
* Partner closely with engineering and design to shape the GIDE 2\.0 technology platform and make sure it meets real business requirements.
* Own prioritisation, timelines, and trade\-offs, and keep every stakeholder aligned from idea to launch.
* Define success metrics, track adoption, and iterate the product based on evidence.



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 



* 3 to 4 years of product management experience, with prior work in EdTech
* Hands\-on exposure to at least one of: study\-abroad product management, Test Prep product management, or counselling product management.
* A proven ability to consolidate cross\-team requirements, map processes, and turn them into buildable specifications.
* Comfort working directly with tech development teams to design and ship a platform.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management, with a bias for clarity and action.
* **Bonus: familiarity with AI\-driven products and a genuine curiosity about the future of education.

Daxko builds the software that powers fitness, wellness, and community organizations—everything from member management and payments to digital engagement and analytics. From small studios to the largest associations, we help thousands of fitness businesses streamline operations, enhance member experiences, and drive sustainable revenue growth.
   

  

 This is a senior\-level role for someone who knows how to lead complex web projects from kickoff through launch without losing steam in the middle. As
 **Lead Digital Website Manager** 
 , you'll own high\-impact initiatives across Daxko's public websites and web experiences, managing timelines, stakeholders, and quality standards while using data and AI tools to keep everything running efficiently. You'll work closely with teams in the US and India and serve as the go\-to point of contact for cross\-functional digital initiatives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead digital marketing and website development projects across Daxko's public websites, microsites, landing pages, and integrated campaigns, from sprint planning through post\-launch review
* Serve as the primary point of contact for complex cross\-functional web initiatives, including technical SEO, CRO, and QA
* Build and maintain detailed project plans in Asana, keeping timelines, resources, and stakeholder expectations aligned throughout
* Manage stakeholder relationships at the Director and VP level with clear, consistent communication and a steady hand in challenging conversations
* Use AI tools and analytics platforms to inform forecasting, performance reporting, and timeline decisions
* Partner with US\- and India\-based team members to execute project milestones efficiently across time zones
* Identify workflow improvements that reduce turnaround times and improve outcomes like web traffic and conversion rates


**What You'll Bring**
* 10\+ years of experience in website and digital project management, preferably in a B2B SaaS or agency environment
* Proven track record managing marketing website projects from kickoff to launch with measurable results
* Deep understanding of web development workflows, CMS platforms, plugin integrations, and digital campaign mechanics
* Strong project management skills with experience in tools like Asana, Trello, or Monday.com
* Comfortable communicating across all levels, from technical teams to executive stakeholders
* Experience using AI tools in planning, reporting, or optimization workflows
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Nice to have**
* Hands\-on experience with CMS platforms like WordPress or GoHighLevel
* Familiarity with marketing automation tools like HubSpot or Marketo
* Experience with analytics tools for performance reporting and insights
* Prior experience collaborating with remote or globally distributed teams
* Master’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or related field.


 Daxko is dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. We are committed to diversity in the broadest sense, including thought and perspective, age, ability, nationality, ethnicity, orientation, and gender. The skills, perspectives, ideas, and experiences of all of our team members contribute to the vitality and success of our purpose and values.
   

  

 We truly care for our team members, and this is reflected through our offices, and benefits, and great perks. These perks are only for our full\-time team members.
   

  

**Some Of Our Favorites Include**
 🏢 🏡 Hybrid work model
   

  

 📆 Leave entitlements
   

  

 🤕 Recently introduced hospitalization/caregiving leaves
   

  

 🍼 Paid parental leaves (Maternity, Paternity, \& Adoption)
   

  

 ⚕️Group Health Insurance
   

  

 🚵🏽 Accidental Insurance
   

  

 💲Tax\-saving reimbursements
   

  

 🤑 Provident Fund (PF)
   

  

 👖 Casual work environments
   

  

 🎉 Company Events and Celebrations
   

  

 🏆 Performance achievement awards
   

  

 💸 Referral bonus
   

  

 🚀 Learning \& Development opportunitieses

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Sprinto is an
 **Autonomous Trust Platform** 
 that centralizes trust requirements across
 **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
 Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
 **raised** 
**$31\.8M** 
 in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
 **4,000 organizations across 75 countries** 
 , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
 **300\+ native integrations** 
 and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports
 **200\+ global security standards natively** 
 , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
   

  

**Founded in 2020** 
 by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
   

  

**Life as a Sprinter \-**
 Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
   

  

 We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
   

  

 Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
   

  

 We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
   

  

 And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
   

  

**The mission \-**
**Where you'll leave your mark?**
* Own the onboarding journey end\-to\-end — from contract signature to go\-live and the first audit milestone, as the single point of accountability for your customer's success in this phase
* Run a structured implementation project for every customer — kickoff, milestone tracking, risk flags, and go\-live. You hold the timeline, drive the cadence, and close the gaps
* Manage senior stakeholder relationships — your primary contacts are founders, CTOs, and security leads; run executive check\-ins, communicate progress and blockers clearly, and build trust that turns customers into advocates
* Drive product adoption and setup completion — guide customers through integration setup, control activation, and compliance framework alignment; you don't need to be a security engineer, but you know what good looks like
* Own internal escalations — when a customer is stuck, you are the bridge between them and Product, Support, and Compliance, and you follow through until it's resolved
* Track and act on customer health signals — setup completion %, time\-to\-value, CSAT, and days since last contact — surfacing risks proactively, not after a customer goes quiet
* Improve the playbooks you use — document what works, flag what doesn't, and make onboarding better for every customer who comes after yours


**The kind of builder we're looking for \-**
* 2–4 years of experience, with at least 2 years in a customer\-facing implementation, onboarding, or technical account management role at a SaaS company — someone who has run onboarding projects, not just supported them
* Experience managing VP\-level and above relationships, with comfort working towards C\-suite engagement
* A project runner at heart — you build the plan, set milestones, chase progress, and keep 10–20 concurrent onboardings moving without dropping the ball
* A clear communicator — you explain complex concepts simply, write crisp async updates, and hold a confident conversation with a technical founder
* A fast learner in new domains — you don't need to be a compliance expert on day one, but you can get there in 60 days
* A solid technical baseline — comfortable with cloud tools, SaaS integrations, and basic API behaviour; familiar with tools like Jira, Slack, HubSpot, and genuinely curious about AI productivity tools
* Nice to have: exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA), certifications like CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, and experience at a startup where the playbook was still being written


**How we care for our Sprinters?**
* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co\-working, on the house: If co\-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you


**Inclusion \& Diversity \-**
 At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
   

  

 We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: CBS-BMC-Technology Enablement-Supervising Associate-BMC Product Manager-CJA And AJO
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Discipline**
 Technology Enablement
   

  

**Role Type**
 BMC Technology Enablement – Product Manager – Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) – Supervising Associate
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY’s BMC function is continuing to grow and improve its marketing and communications technology stack across member firms worldwide. As part of a multi\-year transformation agenda, we are investing in technology, delivery discipline and portfolio execution to improve the way BMC plans, governs and delivers change globally.
   

  

 The BMC Product Manager – Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) will lead the product strategy, roadmap and business adoption of EY's customer data, audience management and journey orchestration capabilities. The role will partner with marketing, analytics, technology and business stakeholders to drive the evolution of Adobe\-powered customer intelligence and activation solutions, ensuring measurable business outcomes, improved audience insights and enhanced personalization capabilities.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, priorities and success measures for assigned BMC technology (Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and enablement of products or capabilities.
* Partner with BMC stakeholders to understand business objectives, user needs, operational pain points, adoption barriers, and opportunities to improve product value.
* Translate business priorities into clear product outcomes, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and backlog items that guide delivery teams.
* Own backlog prioritization and trade\-off decisions, balancing business value, user impact, delivery complexity, risk, dependencies and available capacity.
* Work closely with project managers, business analysts, data engineers, Power BI developers, EY Technology and vendors to ensure delivery is aligned to product intent and agreed outcomes.
* Lead product discovery, option assessment and stakeholder alignment activity, ensuring decisions are based on strong evidence, clear requirements and realistic delivery considerations.
* Monitor product performance, adoption, benefits, feedback and user experience to identify enhancements and inform future roadmap decisions.
* Support governance, planning, and leadership reporting by providing clear updates on product priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected value.
* Contribute to continuous improvement across BMC Enablement by helping standardize product management practices, roadmap governance, backlog discipline and value measurement.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Hands\-on experience working with Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics and/or Adobe Journey Optimizer.
* Strong product management capability in complex, matrixed organizations, ideally working across business, technology, data and vendor teams.
* Strong understanding of customer data platforms (CDPs), audience management, customer profile architecture and marketing activation ecosystems.
* Good understanding of marketing, communications, or enterprise technology environments, with the ability to quickly understand user needs, business processes, and platform implications.
* Commercial and outcome\-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect product decisions to strategic priorities, user value and measurable business impact.
* Structured thinker who can turn ambiguity into clear product direction, practical priorities and actionable delivery requirements.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage roadmaps, backlogs, stakeholders and competing priorities without losing sight of outcomes.
* Clear communicator who can translate product complexity into concise messages, decisions and recommendations for delivery teams and senior stakeholders.
* Confident stakeholder manager with the ability to build trust, challenge constructively, influence without formal authority and keep teams aligned around shared goals.
* Solution\-focused and resilient, with the persistence to resolve blockers, manage trade\-offs and maintain product momentum through ambiguity.
* Committed to quality, governance and operational discipline, acting as a dependable point of product ownership across teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Proven experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner or Digital Product Lead supporting Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP/CDP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) or related MarTech platforms.
* Experience supporting technology, digital, marketing, communications, transformation, analytics or enablement of products or platforms.
* Strong practical skills in roadmap management, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, requirements shaping, user story definition, and value tracking.
* Experience working with cross\-functional delivery teams, including project managers, business analysts, data, engineering, technology, vendors and/or offshore resources.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, make clear product trade\-offs, and produce high\-quality product artefacts, leadership updates and decision materials.
* Experience using agile, product\-led or iterative delivery approaches to deliver measurable improvements for users and the business.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Product management certification or working knowledge of agile, SAFe, Scrum, design thinking, service design or similar delivery approaches.
* Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem including Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign and related customer experience technologies.
* Experience with product discovery, user research, adoption planning, benefits measurement, OKRs, KPIs or product performance reporting.
* Experience with marketing technology, content platforms, campaign operations, data products, analytics, AI\-enabled capabilities or enterprise workflow tools.
* A continuous improvement mindset and confidence proposing practical ways to simplify, standardize and strengthen product management ways of working.
* Experience working in a cross\-border role or supporting globally distributed teams.


**Technologies and Tools**
* Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)
* Software or Marketing technology products
* MS Office tools (Word, Excel, IE); web/production technologies such as HTML, XML, JavaScript, and CSS


**What We Look For**
* Analytical mind\-set and problem\-solving capability.
* Passionate about new technologies and digital products
* Enthusiastic and self\-motivated, with the ability to lead projects proactively.
* Meticulous attention to detail, with an overall passion for continual improvement.
* Innovative and creative, with a logical and methodical approach to problem solving.
* Credible and articulate, with excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to think strategically and guide marketers of different levels with the best practices and industry trends


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior MES Delivery Lead
description:

 The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for MES and digital manufacturing systems, helping to define future\-state manufacturing processes, support Smart Factory initiatives, and contribute to the long\-term development of SPS's manufacturing technology landscape. As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements.
* Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria.

title: E-Commerce Manager
description:
**E\-commerce Manager**

**Company:** Angroos Gifts Boutique

**Location:** Kadavanthra, Kochi, Kerala

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Salary:** **₹15,000 – ₹22,000 per month** \+ Performance Incentives

**Work Mode:** In Person

**About the Role**

Angroos Gifts Boutique is looking for a smart, technology\-friendly, and detail\-oriented **E\-commerce Manager** to manage our e\-commerce website, online orders, digital inventory, product listings, and day\-to\-day online store operations.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with technology and have basic knowledge of **SEO, digital marketing, AI tools, e\-commerce operations, and online inventory management**.

This role is suitable for someone who enjoys managing an online business and taking responsibility for keeping the website, products, stock, orders, and customer information accurate and up to date.

**Key Responsibilities**

**E\-commerce Website Management**

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the Angroos e\-commerce website.
* Add and update products, categories, prices, descriptions, specifications, and images.
* Ensure all product information displayed on the website is accurate.
* Update banners, offers, collections, and seasonal products when required.
* Monitor the website regularly and identify errors, broken pages, incorrect information, or other issues.
* Coordinate with the development team for technical website issues and improvements.
* Ensure new products are published on time.

**Online Order Management**

* Monitor and process online orders.
* Verify customer, product, payment, and delivery information.
* Update order status accurately at each stage.
* Coordinate with packing, accounts, inventory, and delivery teams.
* Ensure customers receive proper order and delivery updates.
* Follow up on delayed, pending, cancelled, or incomplete orders.
* Maintain accurate online order records.

**Digital Inventory Management**

* Maintain and update digital inventory regularly.
* Ensure website stock matches actual available inventory.
* Update out\-of\-stock and restocked products promptly.
* Monitor fast\-moving and low\-stock products.
* Coordinate with the store, purchase, and inventory teams for stock updates.
* Avoid overselling caused by incorrect online inventory.
* Maintain accurate product SKUs, variants, quantities, and pricing.

**SEO \& Website Performance**

* Perform basic SEO for products, categories, and website pages.
* Create SEO\-friendly product titles, descriptions, meta titles, and meta descriptions.
* Conduct basic keyword research.
* Monitor website visibility through Google Search Console and other available tools.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic website traffic.
* Coordinate with the SEO or marketing team for advanced optimization when required.

**Digital Marketing Support**

* Support online promotions, seasonal campaigns, offers, and product launches.
* Coordinate with the digital marketing and social media teams.
* Assist with website landing pages and campaign\-related product updates.
* Understand basic Google, Meta, social media, and digital marketing concepts.
* Monitor which products and categories are performing well online.

**Product Content \& Photography**

* Coordinate product photography and content requirements.
* Take clean product photos and short videos using a smartphone when required.
* Edit/crop basic product images for website use.
* Ensure website product images are clear, attractive, and properly organized.
* Coordinate with photographers, designers, and content creators when professional content is required.

**AI \& Technology**

* Use **AI tools such as ChatGPT** and other productivity tools to improve product descriptions, SEO content, research, and day\-to\-day work.
* Explore new AI and technology tools that can improve e\-commerce efficiency.
* Be comfortable learning new software, dashboards, and online tools.
* Suggest technology\-based improvements for website and e\-commerce operations.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent qualification.
* Basic knowledge of **e\-commerce website management**.
* Basic understanding of **SEO and Digital Marketing**.
* Good computer and internet skills.
* Comfortable working with AI tools and modern technology.
* Understanding of online orders and digital inventory management.
* Basic smartphone photography and video skills.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office / Google Workspace.
* Good communication skills in Malayalam and English.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and take responsibility for daily website operations.
* Experience with WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, or another e\-commerce platform is an advantage.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge and relevant skills may also apply.

**Skills Preferred**

* E\-commerce Management
* Digital Inventory Management
* SEO

* AI Tools
* Website Management
* Product Listing \& Optimization
* Google Search Console
* Basic Analytics
* Smartphone Product Photography

**Benefits**

* Career Growth Opportunities
* Professional Training \& Skill Development
* Exposure to SEO, Digital Marketing, AI \& E\-commerce Technologies
* Friendly and Professional Work Environment

 We're hiring a Senior Product Manager who has lived through the 0→2M journey someone who knows what it takes to find early product\-market fit, prioritize ruthlessly under constraints, and translate messy agency workflows into clean, scalable product features. This is a high\-ownership role at a pivotal inflection point.

**Why UAGenius**

description:
**Job Title:** 
 Senior Product Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Noida
 



**Experience:** 
 5\+ Years
 



  





**Our Story:** 




 Founded in 2000 by Dilip Modi, Spice Money Limited is India’s leading rural fintech company, headquartered in Noida and operating as a subsidiary of DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited, a publicly listed entity. The company is driven by a strong mission to accelerate financial inclusion and empower the underserved “Bharat” through technology\-enabled financial services.
 



 With a network of 1\.6\+ million Adhikaris across India, the company enables last\-mile access to essential services including AEPS cash withdrawal and deposits, domestic money transfer, bill payments, insurance, micro\-ATM services, credit solutions, travel bookings, account opening, and UPI\-led digital payments. Spice Money has consistently introduced industry\-first innovations such as a zero\-cost Adhikari platform, one of India’s largest assisted payments networks, a rural credit marketplace, and Spice Money UPI \& Spice Pay wallet to accelerate digital adoption in smaller towns and villages.
 



 Operating across 95%\+ pincodes with a team of 1,000\+ employees, Spice Money combines the agility of a high\-growth fintech with the scale and impact of a nationwide distribution network—creating meaningful economic opportunities and driving the next phase of financial inclusion in India.
 



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 




 This role is critical in defining the strategic direction and long\-term success of an end\-to\-end product domain. As a domain lead, you will chart a 12–18 month strategy, make key trade\-off choices, and independently set domain priorities that drive business growth and platform stability. In addition to driving domain outcomes, you will lead cross\-functional squads and mentor junior product managers. Depending on organizational assignment, the role may oversee domains such as Adhikari onboarding and KYC, assisted payments, merchant acceptance, lending, insurance, growth and engagement, internal sales tools, risk/compliance platforms, or shared product infrastructure. Across all domains, you will be accountable for balancing customer value, business viability, technical feasibility, operational simplicity, platform reliability, and regulatory compliance.
 



  





**How You'll Contribute:** 



* **Strategic Vision \& Roadmap:** 
 Formulate and execute a comprehensive 12–18 month product domain strategy that directly supports revenue, margin, and business expansion goals.
* **Autonomous Decision\-Making:** 
 Independently establish product priorities, balance competing demands, and make strategic choices within your domain.
* **Squad Leadership \& People Development:** 
 Lead and actively coach junior PMs to foster team growth and high execution standards.
* **End\-to\-End Metric Ownership:** 
 Take ultimate P\&L/performance responsibility for domain health, including revenue contribution, margins, active adoption, retention loops, system reliability, and minimization of fraud/ operational losses.
* **Multi\-Dimensional Balance:** 
 Deliver solutions that harmoniously integrate customer value, business viability, scalable architecture, operational simplicity, high availability, and strict adherence to regulatory guidelines.
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Partner with senior business, risk, operations, and technology leaders to align domain goals with broad company objectives.



  





**What Will Make You Successful:** 



* **Education \& Experience:** 
 B.Tech/BE or MBA (preferably from Tier\-1 institutes) with 4–6 years of overall experience, including 4\+ years in core Product Management owning full domain lifecycles in Fintech, Digital Payments, or high\-scale Tech Startups.
* **Proven Domain Leadership:** 
 Experience driving 12–18 month strategies, making complex portfolio choices, and leading multi\-disciplinary product squads.
* **Mentorship \& People Management:** 
 A track record of coaching junior team members and building high performing product practices.
* **Business \& Financial Acumen:** 
 Strong capability to connect product metrics directly to top\-line revenue, bottom\-line margins, risk controls, and system stability.
* **Empathy for "Bharat":** 
 Deep insight into rural merchant behaviors, assisted tech adoption, and designing intuitive digital journeys for underserved markets.
* **Executive Presence:** 
 Outstanding stakeholder management skills to articulate strategic trade\-offs and drive consensus across business and technical leadership.

title: Senior Product Manager II - Identity & Access Management
description:
Here at Appian, our values of **Intensity** and **Excellence** define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you'll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.



*Own the Identity and Access Management product roadmap and deliver enterprise\-grade authentication features that secure every connection between Appian and the enterprise.*

  


**ABOUT THE TEAM**



The IAM Product team is on a mission to secure every identity, authentication flow, and access point that connects Appian to the enterprise. This team operates with high autonomy and directly influences how global enterprises trust and deploy AI\-Powered Process Automation at scale. Your work will define how millions of users authenticate securely across mission\-critical workflows.

  


**THE OPPORTUNITY**



As enterprises accelerate digital transformation, identity security has become the frontline of platform trust. This role exists because Appian is scaling its authentication and authorization capabilities to meet zero trust demands from the world's most security\-conscious organizations. You will shape how the platform handles federated identity, modern protocols, and seamless user experiences in highly regulated environments.

  



**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



* Lead the end\-to\-end IAM product roadmap, defining priorities that balance enterprise security requirements with developer and end\-user experience
* Partner with Engineering to evaluate, design, and enhance authentication and authorization capabilities including native authentication and support for SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, and federated identity frameworks
* Execute discovery and requirements gathering with enterprise customers to understand identity provider integrations, compliance needs, and zero trust adoption patterns
* Architect product specifications and user stories that translate complex identity protocols into intuitive, scalable platform features
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with Security, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver authentication features that accelerate enterprise adoption
* Analyze product performance metrics, customer feedback, and competitive positioning to continuously improve IAM capabilities and reduce friction in authentication flows
  


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**



* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
* 4\+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager with a proven track record of successfully managing products that involve identity and access management
* Deep experience with identity and access management, user authentication, or identity provider software in enterprise environments
* Strong technical proficiency with authentication protocols including SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, and federated identity architectures
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver secure, scalable authentication solutions
  


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**



* Knowledge of zero trust architecture principles and implementation strategies
* Experience working with cloud identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity, or Auth0
* Background in cybersecurity, compliance frameworks, or enterprise security product management
* We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise\-Grade Orchestration environment.

**This role is based at our Chennai office in DLF Downtown Chennai.** **Appian was built on a culture of in\-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. Employees hired for this position are expected to be in the office 5 days a week to foster that culture and ensure we continue to thrive through shared ideas and teamwork. We believe being in the office provides more opportunities to come together and celebrate working with the exceptional people across Appian.**


**Tools and Resources**


* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department\-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First\-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We'll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee\-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.


**Benefits**



Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family\-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

HYDERABAD OFFICE INDIA PSC PGH**Job Description**


P\&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.

**Dedication from Us:** You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.

**What we Offer:** Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day\-to\-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the centre, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.

**The Opportunity**


We are looking for a Digital Product Manager to join our Digital Products team and build digital products and capabilities that solve meaningful business problems. This role is designed for a professional with prior technology experience who can connect business needs with technology solutions and translate strategy into products that deliver measurable outcomes.


You will work at the intersection of business, technology, data, users, and AI. You will understand user and business needs, shape product strategy, prioritize opportunities, work closely with engineering and technology teams, and drive products from discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Position Responsibilities**

**Own Product Vision, Strategy \& Roadmap**

* Define product vision, objectives, roadmap, priorities, and success measures aligned to business outcomes.
* Understand user needs, business processes, pain points, and opportunities and translate them into clear product requirements and user stories.
* Own backlog prioritization, balancing business value, user experience, technical feasibility, risk, dependencies, and engineering capacity.
* Use data, user feedback, experimentation, and business signals to make informed product decisions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes and create scalable digital capabilities
* Build 0\-1 Products which are AI Native first.

**Drive Product Delivery**

* Lead cross\-functional product initiatives from discovery through development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with engineering, data, architecture, design, security, and technology teams to translate product intent into scalable solutions.
* Understand technical constraints, architecture choices, APIs, data dependencies, and delivery trade\-offs sufficiently to make effective product decisions.
* Create clarity on requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Track delivery progress, proactively address risks and blockers, and ensure commitments remain aligned to product priorities.

**Influence Stakeholders \& Drive Change**

* Build alignment among stakeholders with different priorities, perspectives, and levels of technical understanding.
* Influence without relying solely on formal authority and create commitment around priorities, decisions, and trade\-offs.
* Drive change management through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, adoption, and feedback loops.
* Anticipate resistance and create practical approaches to move users and stakeholders toward adoption.
* Act as a trusted partner and 'go\-to' person for the products and initiatives you own.

**Build Data\- and AI\-Enabled Products**

* Identify opportunities where data, analytics, AI, GenAI, automation, or digital technologies can improve business outcomes.
* Work with data and technology teams to ensure products are built on trusted, accessible, and appropriately governed information.
* Explore AI\-enabled experiences and workflows that help people access information, make better decisions, and reduce repetitive work.
* Ensure AI and automation capabilities are introduced with appropriate human oversight, controls, and accountability.

**Drive Adoption \& Value Realization**

* Define product KPIs, adoption metrics, user experience measures, and value metrics.
* Use product usage and business performance signals to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop stakeholder engagement and adoption plans for new capabilities.
* Create feedback mechanisms that continuously bring user and business insights back into product development.
* Ensure products deliver measurable value beyond initial launch.

**Partner with Technology \& External Teams**

* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, data, design, cybersecurity, IT, and vendor teams.
* Manage technology and business dependencies required to deliver product outcomes.
* Partner with vendors and external technology providers where required, ensuring clarity of outcomes, delivery expectations, and accountability.
* Contribute to solution design, testing, release planning, reliability, security, data quality, and long\-term sustainability.

 **The Ideal Candidate**

* Has an MBA or prior hands\-on experience in technology, software, data, IT, digital engineering, or a related technical environment building AI native products.
* Has less than 3 years of post\-MBA experience / Relevant experience and is looking to build a career at the intersection of business, technology, and product management.
* Can combine business thinking with enough technical depth to engage credibly with engineers and technology teams.
* Is comfortable translating ambiguous business problems into structured product opportunities and clear requirements.
* Has strong influencing and stakeholder\-management skills and can create alignment without formal authority.
* Demonstrates the ability to drive adoption and change across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Is analytically strong and comfortable using data, KPIs, user feedback, and business signals to make decisions.
* Can communicate clearly with senior leaders, business users, engineers, data teams, designers, vendors, and other partners.
* Has strong ownership, bias for action, learning agility, and resilience in a fast\-moving environment.
* Is curious about emerging technologies, including AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, cloud, and modern digital platforms.

**Job Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Analytics, or a related field.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate management qualification from a recognized institution.
* Less than 3 years of professional experience post\-MBA.
* Prior professional experience in technology, software engineering, data, IT, digital, systems, or another technology\-focused role.
* Strong understanding of technology\-enabled business solutions and the software development lifecycle.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, influencing, structured problem\-solving, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across business and technology teams and translate between the two.

With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders can lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories, and functions. Senior Specialist Product Manager
Senior Product Manager, Business Experimentation \& Optimization
  

  

Who is Mastercard?
  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  

  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  

  

Overview
  

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting\-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end\-to\-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments\-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test \& Learn), and data\-driven information and risk management services.
  

  

As a member of the Business Experimentation Product Management team, you will build industry\-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are rapidly building new products, evolving products in the age of AI, and expanding the ways we deliver Test \& Learn to our clients. We are looking for AI native PMs who can execute and evolve our product strategy and help us build the AI enhanced version of Test \& Learn.

Can work closely with cross\-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales, marketing, and users.

Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap.

Experience building with AI or using AI to enhance an existing software application

description:
**Summary:**

**Duties \& Responsibilities:**

**Job Description**

**Senior Product Manager – AIOps \& Agentic AI (Telecom)**

**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India \| **Function:** Product Management \| **Level:** Senior Individual Contributor (IC4 / SPM equivalent)

**About the Role**


VIAVI Solutions is at the forefront of AI\-driven network intelligence, powering the next generation of telecom operations through its **NITRO AIOps platform** — a full\-stack, domain\-agnostic intelligence and automation framework serving Tier\-1 and Tier\-2 operators globally.


We are hiring a **Senior Product Manager – AIOps \& Agentic AI** based in **Chennai** to own the product definition, backlog strategy, and go\-to\-market alignment for our AI/ML and Agentic AI capabilities within the NITRO L8 (AIOps Intelligence Layer) and L9 (Vertical Solutions Layer). This is a high\-visibility role sitting at the intersection of network operations intelligence, multi\-agent AI orchestration, and operator outcome delivery — working closely with solution architects, R\&D, platform engineering, and global field teams.


This role reports to the Director of AIOps Solution Architecture (London/global) and operates as the product authority for the India\-aligned product development function.

**What You Will Own**

**Product Strategy \& Roadmap**

* Define and maintain the product backlog and 2\-quarter rolling roadmap for AIOps Intelligence and Vertical Solutions capabilities across RAN, Core, and Transport domains
* Translate operator pain points (MTTR reduction, NOC automation, root cause analysis, proactive anomaly detection) into structured product requirements — PRDs, PDDs, and user stories — with clear acceptance criteria and operator\-outcome metrics
* Lead product discovery with global field teams and customers to validate feature hypotheses before R\&D commitment
* Drive feature prioritisation using value\-vs\-effort frameworks anchored to operator outcomes, not internal capability milestones

**Agentic AI \& AI/ML Product Definition**

* Own the product definition for Agentic AI capabilities: multi\-agent orchestration workflows, autonomous remediation pipelines, LLM\-assisted root cause analysis, and GenAI interfaces for network operations
* Define human\-in\-the\-loop validation requirements, guardrails, and trust frameworks for autonomous AI features — particularly in safety\-critical network operations contexts
* Partner with R\&D and data science teams to define model evaluation criteria, KPIs, and feedback loops for deployed ML models (anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, traffic forecasting)
* Maintain awareness of emerging frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, Model Context Protocol) and assess applicability to platform capabilities

**PDD / PRD Authoring \& Artifact Quality**

* Produce operator\-grade Product Definition Documents (PDDs) and Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) as primary artifacts, anchoring each to a one\-year product goal and a release outcome map
* Ensure full backlog traceability from PRD to sprint\-level user story; drive zero\-gap traceability as a team standard
* Champion agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, AI\-assisted pipelines) as a force multiplier for artifact velocity — with mandatory human validation before any commit

**Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Alignment**

* Act as the primary product interface between India\-based R\&D engineering and global solution architecture, PLM, and field teams
* Run structured sprint reviews, backlog refinement sessions, and roadmap alignment meetings with a globally distributed team
* Communicate product decisions, trade\-offs, and release outcomes clearly to senior technical and commercial stakeholders
* Provide market intelligence inputs on Indian operator dynamics (Jio, Airtel, Vi, BSNL/BBNL) to inform localisation and vertical solution priority

**Go\-to\-Market Support**

* Author customer\-facing product briefs, capability comparisons, and battlecard inputs for AIOps and Agentic AI features
* Support pre\-sales and solution architecture teams with product positioning for Indian operator bids and RFP responses
* Track competitive landscape across AIOps vendors (Dynatrace, Datadog, IBM Instana, NETSCOUT) and synthesise inputs into roadmap decisions

**What You Bring**

**Experience**

* **7–12 years of total experience**, with a minimum of **4 years in product management** (PO or PM) in a B2B technology or telecom domain
* Demonstrable ownership of AI/ML\-powered products from inception to GA release — not just feature contribution
* Experience working within a **global product organisation** with distributed engineering and solution architecture stakeholders
* Prior exposure to **telecom operations environments** — NOC, OSS, network analytics, or network management — strongly preferred; prior operator\-side experience (Jio, Airtel, Vi, Ericsson, Nokia, ZTE, Amdocs, NetCracker) is a differentiator

**Technical Literacy (Required)**

* Working knowledge of **ML operations concepts**: model training pipelines, inference, evaluation metrics, data labelling, and drift monitoring
* Ability to read and critique API specifications, data schemas, and system architecture diagrams — not required to code, but required to engage meaningfully with engineering at a design level
* Familiarity with **AIOps platform capabilities**: event correlation, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, automated remediation, topology mapping
* Understanding of **5G/LTE network domains** at functional level: RAN (gNB, CU/DU split), Core (AMF, SMF, UPF), Transport; sufficient to define domain\-specific vertical solutions without requiring constant domain SME support
* Awareness of agentic AI frameworks and LLM orchestration patterns (RAG, tool use, multi\-agent coordination)

**Technical Literacy (Preferred)**

* Hands\-on experience with agentic tooling: Claude Code, LangChain/LangGraph, n8n, or equivalent — even in personal/prototype context
* Exposure to telemetry and observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, gNMI/gRPC streaming telemetry
* Familiarity with cloud\-native deployment patterns: Kubernetes, Helm, containerised microservices

**Soft Skills \& Ways of Working**

* Communicates with precision: produces artifacts that can be handed to engineering without re\-interpretation; does not rely on verbal context to carry written requirements
* Operates with structured autonomy — asks for direction on priorities, not on how to execute
* Comfortable managing ambiguity in a maturing product function; can define process where none exists
* Strong stakeholder influence without authority — particularly with senior R\&D and architecture counterparts
* Intellectually honest: surfaces blockers and trade\-offs proactively; does not manage upward by omission

**Qualifications**

**Dimension**

**Requirement**


Education


B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics \& Communication, or related engineering discipline. MBA from a Tier\-1 institution (IIM, ISB, XLRI, IIMB) is advantageous but not required.


Certifications


CSPO, PSPO, or equivalent Product Owner certification preferred. AWS/GCP/Azure cloud practitioner beneficial.


Languages


Fluent English (written and spoken) — the role involves daily interaction with UK and US\-based stakeholders. Tamil working proficiency advantageous for Chennai\-based operator engagement.

**Why This Role**

* **Platform breadth:** NITRO covers the full network stack (L1–L9\); this role owns the AI intelligence and vertical solution layers — not a feature PM role, but a capability platform ownership role
* **Agentic AI at the frontier:** VIAVI is actively deploying multi\-agent orchestration, LLM\-assisted RCA, and autonomous remediation workflows in live operator environments — this role shapes those product decisions
* **India market significance:** Chennai is a strategic R\&D hub for VIAVI; this hire is part of building a Singapore\-Ireland\-India delivery model with global product authority
* **Cross\-functional influence:** The role interfaces directly with global Solution Architecture, PLM, R\&D, and field leadership — not a back\-office backlog management position
* **Career trajectory:** Natural path to Principal PM / Director of Product for the right candidate within 2–3 years as the India team scales

title: Technical Product Manager - Recommendations
description:
**About Atlys**
---------------


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries**. But we’re still early.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a **Technical Product Manager** to own data ingestion for Atlys Signals pod the team responsible for collecting, structuring and surfacing the real\-time signals that power Atlys' AI\-driven travel decisions.


You'll drive the pipelines, integrations and data quality that keep Signals reliable at scale.

**The Job**
-----------

* **Lead automation and AI/ML infrastructure initiatives** across data pipelines, model serving, evaluation and monitoring to build reliable, scalable systems.
* **Own end\-to\-end execution** across Engineering, Product, AI and Operations, driving initiatives from problem definition through delivery and impact measurement.
* **Translate complex technical and business requirements** into structured execution plans, accounting for AI constraints, dependencies, risks and scalability.
* **Track and improve AI system performance** through dashboards and metrics such as accuracy, latency, cost and model quality.
* **Drive cross\-functional alignment and responsible AI practices**, including guardrails, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop review.

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 4 to 7 years as a Technical PM or Data PM, ideally owning data pipelines or ingestion systems
* Are comfortable with data architecture and APIs, ETL/ELT, schemas, data quality tooling etc.
* Are structured and detail\-oriented, able to prioritise across many sources and stakeholders.
* Are analytical, using pipeline and data\-quality metrics to guide decisions.
* Communicate well, aligning engineering, AI/ML and product teams around data needs.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**
-----------------------


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.


Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity** so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work**, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Product Manager
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
   

  

 Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
   

  

 Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top\-tier global investors, 60\+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will deploy and run our platform inside pharma customers with your own hands, and be the product manager for the platform based on what that teaches you. You'll model a customer's QC and manufacturing data, build the pipelines, ontology, and apps (directing our AI agents to do the heavy lifting — and verifying everything they produce), and get real users live. Then you'll turn the friction and gaps you hit in the field into the product roadmap, working directly with the CPO.
   

  

 This is the shortest path from a customer's real problem to a shipped platform improvement. It suits a technical builder who is genuinely comfortable in SQL and data models, skeptical and sharp when reviewing AI output, and obsessed with getting the data right.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Deploy the platform at customers (hands\-on)
   

  

* Model the customer's data end\-to\-end: build source→gold data pipelines (transforms, joins, incremental loads, dedup, grain, schema drift) and design the business ontology — entities (batch records, deviations, QC results, instruments, sampling, etc.), their relationships, and how they map to the customer's real source columns
* Write and debug SQL against the data warehouse; validate correctness with dry\-runs, row counts, and spec checks before anything reaches a user
* Build operational apps and dashboards on the platform for customer users (data bindings, platform components), and drive adoption with quality/manufacturing stakeholders
* Troubleshoot pipeline, data\-model, and app issues to root cause — across the data, the generated artifacts, and logs


 Operate and verify AI agents
   

  

* Direct the platform's AI agents to generate pipelines, data models, and apps — and rigorously review their output: read the generated SQL/specs, catch silent failures (all\-zero dashboards, fan\-out joins, malformed models), and tell a genuine platform bug apart from a bad prompt
* Use AI\-assisted / "vibe coding" tools to prototype and validate ideas before spending engineering time


 Be the platform's PM
   

  

* Convert field learnings — recurring friction, capability gaps, real bugs — into prioritized, well\-scoped product work; own the roadmap for one or more areas with the CPO
* Write crisp PRDs and specs engineering and design can build from without guesswork
* Define and track the metrics that matter (time\-to\-value on a deployment, adoption, retention) and report to the CPO
* Partner with engineering, design, sales, and customer success to ship and land features


**Requirements**
**What We're Looking For (must\-haves)**
* Solid SQL — day one, non\-negotiable. You can write and debug non\-trivial queries (joins, aggregations, window functions, CASE logic) without ramp\-up. This is tested in the interview
* Proven data modelling. You can take messy source tables and design a clean, correct model — reasoning about grain, keys, relationships, incremental loading, and dedup. Comfortable with a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery a plus)
* Operate and critically evaluate AI agents / AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Replit, v0, Lovable) — you build with them and reliably catch when they're wrong
* A correctness mindset — you never confuse "it ran" or "it looks done" with "it's right," especially where data drives decisions
* Strong product instincts: turn ambiguous, real\-world needs into clear requirements and prioritize ruthlessly
* Excellent communication — equally credible with a customer's QC lead, your engineers, and the CPO
* High agency; comfortable owning a customer's outcome in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment
* 3\-5 years in product management, forward\-deployed / solutions engineering, data/analytics engineering, or a hands\-on technical delivery role
* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent hands\-on experience)


**Good to Have**
* Experience in pharma / life sciences / manufacturing / quality / compliance (GxP) — not required; we'll teach the domain to someone with the hunger to master it
* Prior forward\-deployed, implementation, or solutions experience deploying software directly at customers
* Ontology / semantic\-layer experience; familiarity with data\-pipeline or warehouse tooling (dbt, Data form, Airflow, or similar)
* A portfolio of things you've actually built (including with AI tools)
* Early\-stage start\-up experience


**Benefits**
* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting\-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high\-performing team building innovative AI\-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry\-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals \& Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family\-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments
