title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Just Walk Out Technology
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.  

  

Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and leave the store. This checkout\-free shopping experience is made possible by Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned, and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from small airport kiosks to massive university stores.  

  

The Merchant In\-Store Operations team, within JWO, owns the tools, systems, and workflows that enable merchants and their store associates to operate autonomous retail environments at scale. The role spans directly working with two engineering teams that are responsible for unattended store operations, planogram and product layout tooling, and in\-store associate experience and education; Together, these teams serve JWO's growing global footprint, supporting diverse retail configurations—from fully staffed locations to completely unattended kiosks and micro\-markets—enabling merchants across Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, and Hospitality verticals to run Just Walk Out stores efficiently and confidently. This Senior Product Manager\-Tech will own the product vision spanning both teams, defining how merchants and store teams interact with, monitor, and maintain their autonomous retail environments day\-to\-day, and how customer support and tech operations teams diagnose and resolve issues at speed.  

  

You will define the product roadmap spanning two engineering teams—In\-Store Operations —covering unattended store operations, store associate tooling, planogram management, store availability, and customer support experience capabilities that scale from hundreds to thousands of stores with vastly different operational models. You will work with Enterprise Customers, System Integrators, Engineering, Solution Architects, Customer Support, and Tech Operations teams to drive the long\-term Merchant In\-Store Operations vision as JWO expands from 350\+ stores today to thousands of stores globally. This role requires deep understanding of physical retail operations, store\-level workflows, customer support systems, and the ability to design intuitive tools that empower merchants, frontline associates, and support teams to succeed in autonomous retail environments.  

  

As a tenured Product Manager, you are familiar with the product development lifecycle. You exhibit high proficiency and efficacy in core product management disciplines such as defining user stories, priorities, success metrics, presenting vision that works backwards from customers, and are comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-paced and ambiguous environment. A successful candidate will combine an ability to Think Big with keen attention to detail. We are looking for a passionate, data\-driven decision maker who likes building from scratch, experimenting with emerging technologies like generative AI and AI\-powered agents, and setting high standards. You have a high degree of ownership, deep retail operations and customer support expertise, and are an excellent written and verbal communicator who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Define and evangelize the long\-term vision for Merchant In\-Store Operations, developing strategic roadmaps for unattended operations, planogram tooling, and in\-store associate experience that align with Just Walk Out's goal of scaling from 400 to 7,000\+ stores by 2028


  

* Own the unattended operations strategy, designing and delivering the systems, workflows, and merchant\-facing capabilities that enable fully unmanned JWO stores (micro\-markets, kiosks, grab\-and\-go locations) to operate reliably at scale with minimal human intervention, including remote monitoring, automated alerting, and self\-service recovery mechanisms


  

* Lead the planogram tools vision and execution, owning the end\-to\-end product experience that enables merchants and solution architects to design, configure, validate, and update store layouts and product placements across diverse physical formats, reducing planogram setup time and improving accuracy for new store launches and seasonal resets


  

* Own the JWO In\-Store Associate Experience and Education strategy, building intuitive tools, dashboards, and training resources that empower store associates to understand autonomous retail operations, troubleshoot common issues, manage day\-to\-day store tasks, and deliver excellent customer service in a checkout\-free environment


  

* Partner with engineering leadership to deliver scalable, enterprise\-grade in\-store operations capabilities, making technical decisions that balance merchant needs across diverse verticals (Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, Hospitality) with engineering constraints, platform stability, and the ability to support stores with vastly different physical layouts and operational requirements


  

* Own the operational playbook for unattended store formats, defining standard operating procedures, escalation paths, and automated remediation workflows that ensure consistent store uptime and customer experience across geographies and merchant types


  

* Define and track key metrics including store uptime, mean\-time\-to\-resolution, associate task completion rates, planogram accuracy, and merchant satisfaction to drive continuous improvement and inform product investment decisions

title: Product Manager
description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024\).
   

  

 HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward\-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI\-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best\-in\-class AI\-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.
   

  

**HackerOne Values**
 HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is
 **Customer Obsessed** 
 and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We
 **Default to Disclosure** 
 by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners
 **Win Together** 
 by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.
   

  

**Product Manager, Agentic Vulnerability Elimination**
 Location: Pune, India (In\-office)
   

  

 Working timing : UK Shift
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 HackerOne is seeking a hands\-on, technically curious Product Manager to join the team building Agentic Vulnerability Elimination (AVE). AVE is how HackerOne brings AI agents and human expertise together to validate, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities at scale. The agents do the heavy lifting on every finding, while our triage analysts and security researchers keep them accurate and trustworthy. In this role, you will drive improvements to the quality and performance of these agents and the harness they run in, working closely with our Pune triage and offensive security teams and partnering closely with product development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for someone who is energized by AI, comfortable getting into the details of how an agent actually behaves, and motivated by close collaboration with the operators, security researchers, and customers who use and pressure\-test our products every day.
   

  

 This hybrid role is located in Pune, India, and reports to the Principal Product Manager for Agentic Vulnerability Elimination.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 Success in the Product Manager role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne:
   

  

* Lead the definition and delivery of improvements to AI agent quality, performance, and cost management across validation, prioritization, exploitation, deduplication, and remediation, balancing model capabilities, operational workflows, customer outcomes, and engineering tradeoffs.
* Own the evolution of the evaluation framework and agent harness, establishing scalable evaluation methodologies, quality gates, and feedback loops that improve agentic capabilities over time.
* Partner with triage, engineering, offensive security researchers, and product teams to align priorities, influence product direction, and translate operational workflows into scalable, AI\-driven product capabilities.
* Work closely with our offensive security researchers to validate exploitability, adversarially stress\-test agent decisions, and improve how the agents reason about real\-world attack scenarios.
* Partner with customer\-facing teams in EMEA and the US to join customer calls and understand user workflows, gather feedback, and keep agent improvements grounded in real\-world needs.
* Define the product health metrics for your area, design experimentation frameworks, and use evidence to make prioritization decisions that improve customer and business outcomes.
* Own significant product initiatives, independently defining problem statements, success metrics, and execution plans while influencing the broader product strategy alongside senior product leadership and partnering closely with development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
* Navigate ambiguous product problems where customer needs, AI capabilities, and security workflows are still emerging, bringing structure, prioritization, and clear execution plans to cross\-functional teams.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally on technical or AI/LLM products at high\-growth tech or SaaS companies.
* A track record of building products with close cross\-functional collaboration across engineering, design, and operations.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM\-based solutions, including prompting, evaluations, quality control, and the practical realities of building features on top of generative AI.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working directly with data to define metrics, run experiments, and make decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build alignment among technical and operational staff.
* Experience working with distributed/async product development teams in different time zones.
* Based in Pune or willing to relocate, and able to work on\-site there on a hybrid basis.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience building agentic systems, evaluation pipelines, agent harnesses, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, or bug bounty and penetration testing.
* Prior experience working closely with an operations or triage team, or directly with security researchers.
* Comfort with SQL or light scripting to pull and analyze your own data.


 Compensation Band
   

  

 INR 30\-37\.50 LPA
   

  

 Job Benefits:
   

  

* Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance\*
* Equity stock options
* Retirement plans
* Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO
* Paid maternity and parental leave
* Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Eligibility may differ by country


 We're committed to building a global team! For certain roles outside the United States, India, the U.K., and the Netherlands, we partner with Remote.com as our Employer of Record (EOR).
   

  

 Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available.
   

  

*Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.*
 HackerOne is an Equal Opportunity Employer in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, pregnancy, disability or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

 This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

title: Product Owner II
description:
**About Vista Equity Partners**



Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology\-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90\+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long\-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45\+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.



Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision\-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio\-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.


**About Amtech**



Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.



With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technological organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.

  

**Our Employee Value Proposition**



At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:


**Purpose**



Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission\-critical enterprise software used by industry\-leading organizations.


**Growth**



Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross\-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.


**Culture**



Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people\-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.


**Innovation**



Engage with cutting\-edge technologies, including AI\-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.


**Role Description**



We are looking for a Product Owner II to lead product execution for our automated scheduling applications across our labeling and corrugated ERP platforms. This role works closely with product management, engineering, UX, and customers to ensure our scheduling products deliver measurable operational value for manufacturers.



Working under the direction of a Product Manager, the Product Owner translates roadmap initiatives and projects into actionable development work. This individual will own the product backlog, break initiatives into epics and stories, coordinate multi\-team planning, and collaborate with engineering to deliver high\-quality scheduling capabilities.



The ideal candidate understands manufacturing operations, ERP systems, and production scheduling, and is comfortable working with both technical teams and manufacturing customers.

  


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Product Ownership**


* Own and manage the product backlog for the automated scheduling products.
* Work with Product Managers to create epics from initiatives and roadmap projects.
* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and bug fixes based on customer needs, product strategy, and business goals.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria for development teams.
* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan sprints across multiple months.
* Ensure backlog items are ready for sprint planning and development.


**Customer \& Market Insight**


* Work with the Product Manager to understand and implement the roadmap.
* Work with customers, customer support, and services to fix software defects and to define and implement customer\-specific features.
* Engage with customers to understand manufacturing workflows, scheduling challenges, and product opportunities.
* Translate manufacturing and scheduling requirements into scalable product capabilities.


**Agile Development Collaboration**


* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during sprint planning, development, and release cycles.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, tech leads, and the development team in Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies including planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Clarify requirements and ensure development teams understand the desired product outcomes.


**Product Delivery**


* Validate that delivered functionality meets acceptance criteria and business objectives.
* Support product releases including documentation, training, and internal enablement.
* Collaborate with product management and leadership on roadmap execution.


**Cross\-Functional Coordination**


* Work with implementation, support, and sales teams to ensure product features align with customer needs.
* Provide product expertise for internal stakeholders.
* Help drive continuous improvement of scheduling capabilities.


**SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS**


* 3–5\+ years experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst in a software environment.
* Experience working in Agile / Scrum development environments.
* Experience with ERP systems.
* Strong experience managing product backlogs and writing user stories.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical product specifications.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Product backlog management
* Agile / Scrum development
* Scheduling / manufacturing operations
* Requirements definition
* Stakeholder communication
* Data\-driven decision making


**Nice to Have:**


* Experience with manufacturing or other scheduling and scheduling\-optimization applications (strongly preferred).
* Knowledge of production scheduling, shop floor operations, or manufacturing analytics.
* Experience with ERP integrations and manufacturing workflows.
* Background working with industrial, manufacturing, or supply chain software.
* Experience with tools such as Jira or similar backlog management systems.


**Why Join Amtech**



At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world\-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross\-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture



— backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of **Vista.**

title: Senior Product Manager – Freight Forwarding / 3PL
description:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager – Freight Forwarding / 3PL to drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of digital products that enable modern freight forwarding and third\-party logistics operations.
 



 The ideal candidate will bring strong logistics domain expertise, particularly across freight forwarding, transportation, warehousing, shipment management, carrier management, customs, order fulfilment, and supply\-chain operations, combined with a proven track record of building and scaling B2B digital products.
 



 You will work closely with customers, business stakeholders, operations teams, engineering, design, data, and technology teams to identify high\-value problems and translate them into scalable products and solutions.
 



  





**Job Locations** 
 : Bangalore, Chennai, Kochi, Trivandrum
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Product Strategy \& Vision** 



* Define and drive the product vision and strategy for freight forwarding / 3PL products.
* Develop product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends.
* Identify opportunities to digitize and optimize logistics and supply\-chain processes.
* Conduct market, customer, competitor, and industry analysis to identify product opportunities.
* Define product KPIs and establish mechanisms to measure product adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and business impact.



**Freight Forwarding \& Logistics Products** 




 Own and evolve products across one or more of the following areas:
 


* Shipment / freight management
* Transportation Management Systems (TMS)
* Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
* Order and fulfilment management
* Carrier / vendor management
* Rate management and freight pricing
* Booking and shipment planning
* Track \& Trace / shipment visibility
* Customs and trade compliance
* Documentation and invoicing
* Last\-mile and delivery management
* Returns management
* Customer portals and self\-service
* Logistics control towers
* Supply\-chain visibility and analytics
* Integration with carriers, ports, airlines, shipping lines, marketplaces, ERP and other enterprise systems



**Product Discovery \& Customer Focus** 



* Engage directly with customers and logistics operations teams to understand pain points and unmet needs.
* Translate complex logistics workflows into intuitive digital experiences.
* Conduct user research, discovery workshops, interviews, and validation exercises.
* Define customer journeys, personas, use cases, and product requirements.
* Prioritize opportunities based on customer value, business impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment.



**Product Execution** 



* Own the product backlog and prioritization across multiple squads / product areas.
* Develop PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Partner closely with Engineering, UX/UI, Architecture, Data, QA, and Operations teams.
* Drive product development from discovery through launch and post\-launch optimization.
* Resolve product trade\-offs and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality solutions.
* Establish effective Agile product practices and continuously improve product development processes.



**Data, Automation \& AI** 



* Leverage data and analytics to improve logistics decision\-making and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities for automation across freight forwarding and 3PL workflows.
* Explore and incorporate AI/ML, GenAI, predictive analytics, intelligent document processing, optimization, and automation into logistics products where relevant.
* Define experiments and measure outcomes to validate product hypotheses.



**Stakeholder \& Business Management** 



* Collaborate with senior business and operations leaders to align product strategy with organizational priorities.
* Work with sales and pre\-sales teams to support enterprise customer engagements where required.
* Communicate product vision, roadmap, priorities, progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.



**Required Qualifications** 



* 8\+ years of experience in Product Management, with significant experience in logistics, supply chain, transportation, freight forwarding, or 3PL products.
* Strong understanding of freight forwarding and/or 3PL business processes and operating models.
* Experience building and scaling B2B / enterprise SaaS or logistics technology products.
* Proven experience owning products through the complete lifecycle: discovery → strategy → roadmap → development → launch → adoption → optimization.
* Strong understanding of transportation, logistics, and supply\-chain workflows.
* Experience working with enterprise customers and complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, prioritization, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum product development environments.
* Ability to translate complex business problems into simple, scalable product solutions.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with TMS, WMS, OMS, freight management, shipment visibility, logistics marketplaces, or supply\-chain platforms.
* Experience across air freight, ocean freight, road transportation, or multimodal logistics.
* Understanding of customs, trade compliance, freight rating, documentation, invoicing, and carrier operations.
* Experience with ERP and enterprise integrations such as SAP or Oracle.
* Experience with APIs, EDI, carrier integrations, and logistics ecosystem integrations.
* Experience building products for global logistics operations.
* Exposure to AI/ML, GenAI, automation, optimization, or data products in logistics.
* Experience managing products across multiple geographies or business units.
* MBA / PGDM from a reputed institution is a plus.
* Engineering / Computer Science / Technology background is a plus.



**Key Competencies** 




 Domain
 


* Freight Forwarding
* 3PL
* Supply Chain \& Logistics
* Transportation
* Warehousing
* Shipment Management



 Product
 


* Product Strategy
* Product Discovery
* Roadmap Management
* Product Prioritization
* Customer Experience
* Product Analytics
* Agile Product Development



 Technology
 


* SaaS / Enterprise Platforms
* APIs \& Integrations
* TMS / WMS / OMS
* Data \& Analytics
* AI / ML / GenAI
* Automation



 Leadership
 


* Strategic Thinking
* Stakeholder Management
* Executive Communication
* Cross\-functional Leadership
* Customer Orientation
* Problem Solving



**Success Measures** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 


* Product adoption and customer engagement
* Customer satisfaction and retention
* Revenue / business impact
* Reduction in logistics operating costs
* Process automation and productivity improvement
* Reduction in manual intervention and errors
* Shipment visibility and operational efficiency
* Product delivery predictability and quality
* Successful launch and scaling of new product capabilities



  





 The ideal candidate is a domain\-led Senior Product Manager who understands how freight actually moves through the logistics ecosystem and can translate those operational complexities into scalable technology products.
 



 They should be comfortable discussing topics such as freight rates, carrier booking, shipment lifecycle, documentation, customs, warehouse operations, transportation planning, track \& trace, delivery, invoicing, and logistics integrations, while also being strong in modern product management practices.
 



  





 Candidates coming from freight forwarders, 3PLs, logistics technology companies, supply\-chain SaaS companies, TMS/WMS providers, or enterprise technology organizations serving the logistics industry would be particularly relevant.

 At Refyne, we're building the financial infrastructure that powers millions of employees across India. With Resure by Refyne, we are extending our financial wellness platform into insurance, building a native insurance vertical to offer seamless Motor, Health, and Credit Protect solutions directly within the Refyne app.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Just Walk Out Technology
description:
**Description**
 As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
   

  

 Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and leave the store. This checkout\-free shopping experience is made possible by Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned, and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from small airport kiosks to massive university stores.
   

  

 The Merchant In\-Store Operations team, within JWO, owns the tools, systems, and workflows that enable merchants and their store associates to operate autonomous retail environments at scale. The role spans directly working with two engineering teams that are responsible for unattended store operations, planogram and product layout tooling, and in\-store associate experience and education; Together, these teams serve JWO's growing global footprint, supporting diverse retail configurations—from fully staffed locations to completely unattended kiosks and micro\-markets—enabling merchants across Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, and Hospitality verticals to run Just Walk Out stores efficiently and confidently. This Senior Product Manager\-Tech will own the product vision spanning both teams, defining how merchants and store teams interact with, monitor, and maintain their autonomous retail environments day\-to\-day, and how customer support and tech operations teams diagnose and resolve issues at speed.
   

  

 You will define the product roadmap spanning two engineering teams—In\-Store Operations —covering unattended store operations, store associate tooling, planogram management, store availability, and customer support experience capabilities that scale from hundreds to thousands of stores with vastly different operational models. You will work with Enterprise Customers, System Integrators, Engineering, Solution Architects, Customer Support, and Tech Operations teams to drive the long\-term Merchant In\-Store Operations vision as JWO expands from 350\+ stores today to thousands of stores globally. This role requires deep understanding of physical retail operations, store\-level workflows, customer support systems, and the ability to design intuitive tools that empower merchants, frontline associates, and support teams to succeed in autonomous retail environments.
   

  

 As a tenured Product Manager, you are familiar with the product development lifecycle. You exhibit high proficiency and efficacy in core product management disciplines such as defining user stories, priorities, success metrics, presenting vision that works backwards from customers, and are comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-paced and ambiguous environment. A successful candidate will combine an ability to Think Big with keen attention to detail. We are looking for a passionate, data\-driven decision maker who likes building from scratch, experimenting with emerging technologies like generative AI and AI\-powered agents, and setting high standards. You have a high degree of ownership, deep retail operations and customer support expertise, and are an excellent written and verbal communicator who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and evangelize the long\-term vision for Merchant In\-Store Operations, developing strategic roadmaps for unattended operations, planogram tooling, and in\-store associate experience that align with Just Walk Out's goal of scaling from 400 to 7,000\+ stores by 2028
* Own the unattended operations strategy, designing and delivering the systems, workflows, and merchant\-facing capabilities that enable fully unmanned JWO stores (micro\-markets, kiosks, grab\-and\-go locations) to operate reliably at scale with minimal human intervention, including remote monitoring, automated alerting, and self\-service recovery mechanisms
* Lead the planogram tools vision and execution, owning the end\-to\-end product experience that enables merchants and solution architects to design, configure, validate, and update store layouts and product placements across diverse physical formats, reducing planogram setup time and improving accuracy for new store launches and seasonal resets
* Own the JWO In\-Store Associate Experience and Education strategy, building intuitive tools, dashboards, and training resources that empower store associates to understand autonomous retail operations, troubleshoot common issues, manage day\-to\-day store tasks, and deliver excellent customer service in a checkout\-free environment

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
**Who We Are:**
Gameberry Labs, a thriving mobile games studio established in 2017 and headquartered in Bangalore, has aimed for an extraordinary vision – to become the premier game development company on a global scale. As a bootstrapped and profitable startup, Gameberry Labs has taken the mobile gaming scene by storm. Since our inception in 2017, our games 'Ludo STAR' and 'Parchisi STAR' have captivated players around the globe, resulting in an impressive 300M\+ downloads. **Our Belief:**
Our profound belief in the transformative ability of mobile games lies in their power to reshape modern connections, entertainment, and learning experiences. We see them as personal buddies that boost our brains, melt away stress, and keep spirits high \- anytime, anywhere. **Our Mission:**
We want to make millions of people happy with games that they would love to grow old with. We are driven by passion for creating exceptional gaming experiences that people will cherish for years to come. With our fearless team of dreamers and innovators we are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of mobile gaming. **Highlight Reel:*** We’ve smashed through 300M\+ game downloads — and counting!
* Our games have pulled in a whopping $275M\+ in lifetime revenue
* Over 15M\+ players jump into our worlds every single month
* Both Parchisi STAR and Ludo STAR have each crossed the 120M\+ download mark — absolute legends in their own right
* Crowned Bootstrap Champ at the ET Startups Awards 2023
* Dropped our latest hit “Sorry World” in Oct 2025 — hit \#1 on the US Play Store in just 2 weeks!
* Oh, and yes — we’ve handled 1M\+ players online at once without breaking a sweat

 **Cool Tidbits:*** Our games attract a monthly player base equivalent to the population of


Australia, with over 20M players engaging each month!* Players spend an astronomical 297\.6 Mars Round Trips worth of time on our


games daily!!! **About the role:**
We're building a new\-games engine, and this role owns it. It exists to do something structurally different from what made us successful so far: instead of deepening one enduring title, it puts many concepts into the market quickly, reads the signal honestly, and doubles down only on what earns it. We run this as a factory, not a series of bets. Concepts move through a staged funnel — creative signal, then install economics, then engagement, then ROAS — and most of them die at a stage. That is the point. The ones that survive get built into hybrid\-casual titles: ads\-led at the core, with a meta layer engineered to carry IAP as the game matures. You'll own that engine end to end. **What You'll Own** **Vision**. Set the thesis for what we build and why. Decide which mechanics, genres,
and audiences we chase this quarter and which we deliberately ignore. Turn
market signal — competitive intel, store movement, creative trends, UA data —
into a portfolio strategy leadership can back. **Product**. Own the full lifecycle on titles in the pipeline: concept, prototype, soft
launch, scale. Write the specs, design the core loop and progression, define the
economy, and shape the meta layer that takes a title from ad\-monetized to
hybrid. **Production**. Own throughput. Small pods, tight cadence, external partners where it
makes sense. You are accountable for how many concepts reach test, how fast
they get there, and what each one costs us to learn from.
Judgment. Run the kill/scale calls. Defend them with data, own them when they're
wrong, and keep the bar honest when a concept everyone loves isn't clearing its
numbers. **People**. Mentor and grow the product and game designers working across the
pipeline. Build the practice, not just the product. **Responsibilities*** Own the product vision, roadmap, and portfolio strategy for Gameberry's hybrid\-casual line
* Drive concepts through the full lifecycle — writing specifications and working across design, art, engineering, and UA to ship playable builds fast
* Define and defend the metrics that gate each stage of the testing funnel, and make the kill/scale decision at every gate
* Design core loops, progression systems, economies, and the meta layer that carries a title from IAA\-led to hybrid monetization
* Partner closely with UA and creative teams — in this genre, creative is product, and the two cannot be sequenced
* Own production planning, team allocation, and delivery cadence across multiple concepts running in parallel
* Present strategy, results, and honest post\-mortems to founders and senior leadership
* Mentor and guide product and game designers; raise the analytical and craft bar across the pod
* Build the operating system — playbooks, scorecards, benchmarks — so the pipeline gets better with every cycle, not just busier

 **Requirements*** 8\+ years in Product Management, with meaningful time in game development. Hybrid\-casual, hypercasual, or casual puzzle experience is a strong plus
* Demonstrated ownership of a title from concept to launch — ideally more than one, ideally including one that didn't work
* Fluency in the economics of the genre: CPI, IPM, D1/D7 retention, ARPDAU, LTV, and payback. You should be able to read a ROAS curve and say


something useful about it without an analyst in the room* Strong grasp of ad monetization and how an IAP meta layer is built on top of it
* Ability to create wireframes, product specifications, and system designs that engineers and artists can build from without a translation layer
* Strong project management skills and the ability to present work to executive staff
* Comfort with ambiguity and speed. This is a zero\-to\-one function; the process is partly yours to invent
* Self\-starter with a bias for action and a genuine love for solving unsolved problems
* Previous start\-up or studio\-building experience is a strong plus
* Working knowledge of AI tooling in the production pipeline is a plus — we're actively building this into how the team operates

 **Your Adventure at Gameberry Labs:**
At Gameberry Labs, we're all about riding the wave of new trends, tech and building the best possible player experience that shapes the gaming universe. We strive to be at the forefront of casual game entertainment. When you join us, you're stepping into a place where your ideas count and your impact matters. We offer an autonomous studio setup that fosters fast decision\-making, empowering you to make a significant impact and accelerate your professional growth. **Why Choose Us:*** Freedom to be you.
* Get in on a seriously competitive salary.
* Hungry? Enjoy free daily lunches.
* We've got your back with company\-paid health insurance.
* Team fun? It's our thing!
* Opportunity knocks with limitless growth potential.
* We're making a global splash.
* Your playground: a studio that owns the P\&L of its creations.
* Inspiring, down\-to\-earth teams are our secret sauce.
* Dive into challenges, learning, and growth at warp speed.
* We want to take India to the list of "Top 10 Gaming Studios" in the World.


Ready to embark on this thrilling quest? Join us and let's create gaming history, one
pixel at a time.

title: Product Delivery Manager
description:
**Safety \& Quality Product Delivery Manager**

Exposure to Aviation Safety \& Quality \| Good Communication

Employment Type: Full\-Time

**Location: Bangalore**

**Role Summary**

The QMSMART Safety \& Quality Specialist is the operational and functional expert for the organization's QMSMART Safety \& Quality Management System (branded internally as SQMS/ESMS). This role owns day\-to\-day use, configuration integrity, and continuous improvement of the QMSMART platform across its core modules — Occurrence Reporting, Investigation Management, Document Control, Risk Assessment, and Audit Management — while acting as the key business\-side resource during implementation phases (CRP, UAT, Data Migration, Training, Go\-Live, Hypercare) and ongoing operations.

This is a safety\-critical, regulated role (ICAO/IOSA/CAA) where accuracy, sign\-off discipline, and data integrity within QMSMART directly support the organization's Safety Management System (SMS) and Quality Management System (QMS).

Key Responsibilities

**QMSMART Platform Ownership**

* Serve as the subject matter expert on QMSMART configuration, workflows, and module functionality (Occurrence Reporting, Investigation Management, Document Control, Risk Assessment, Audit Management).
* Maintain the role/user mapping and permissions matrix, ensuring access aligns with job function (Safety Reporter, Safety Investigator, Quality Officer, Auditor, System Admin).
* Monitor system usage and data quality; flag and resolve configuration issues or defects (using P1–P4 priority classification: P1 blocks go\-live/24h fix, P2 major/fix before UAT exit, P3 workaround exists, P4 minor/post go\-live).

**Be a Specialist and Act as a Service Manager**

* Process and triage occurrence reports; ensure timely routing for investigation per SLA.
* Support investigators with structured workflow tools, document control, and risk assessment scoring within the platform.
* Maintain audit schedules, findings, and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) tracking within the Audit Management module.
* Ensure risk assessments are logged, scored, and reviewed in line with the organization's risk matrix.

**Implementation \& Change Support**

* Act as business SME during Conference Room Piloting (CRP), validating process maps, role matrices, and test scripts.
* Coordinate or execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) test cases; track defects and support IT/vendor resolution within SLA; confirm zero open P1/P2 defects before UAT exit sign\-off.
* Support data migration validation and training material validation during Design \& Configuration.
* Contribute to Go\-Live readiness across the four pillars — Technical, Data, People, Regulatory — and support Hypercare/adoption activities post go\-live.

**Project Management**

* Manage projects end\-to\-end by Project Plan, RAID Log, Track User Acceptance tracker and be an advocate for QMSMART during project implementation
* Log and maintain risks, actions, issues, and decisions (RAID) related to QMSMART operations and project activity, using the standard RAID register format and scoring (Likelihood × Impact for risks; Urgent/High/Low/Resolved for issues).
* Provide input to Project Steering Group (PSG) status reporting — workstream updates, red/amber risks and issues, milestones, and decisions required.
* Track and report on safety performance indicators (SPIs) and quality metrics generated from QMSMART data.

**Training \& Adoption**

* Deliver or support role\-based QMSMART training (Orientation, Occurrence Reporting, Investigation Management, Document Control, Risk Assessment, Audit Management, System Admin) per the training matrix for each user group.
* Support Train\-the\-Trainer (TTT) sessions and champion network activities to drive adoption (ADKAR: Awareness, Desire, Knowledge, Ability, Reinforcement).
* Communicate role\-specific benefits (e.g., faster reporting for Safety Reporters, elimination of spreadsheets for Quality Officers) to drive user buy\-in.

Add\-on Support

* Provide support to Sales team for product demo
* Provide support for RFP preparation and delivery
* Act as a Customer support representative during monthly customer success meetings.

Qualifications

Required

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Aviation Management, Aeronautical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Good communication and ability to communicate
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in aviation safety, quality assurance, or SMS/QMS administration.
* Hands\-on experience with QMSMART or a comparable aviation SMS/QMS software platform.
* Working knowledge of ICAO Annex 19, IOSA, and applicable CAA regulatory requirements.
* Familiarity with occurrence reporting, investigation management, document control, risk assessment, and audit management processes.

Preferred

Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team builds software to improve customer experience by : (1\) Enabling Agentic Shopping experiences through World Product Catalog that contains all shoppable products sold anywhere in the world, (2\) Growing number of customer relevant brands and products on Amazon, and (3\) enriching product and brand information in Amazon catalog. title: Product Manager, Amazon Business India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Opportunity: The IN B2B market is made of 63 MM Micro \& Small Customers and 0\.5MM Medium \& Large customers together spending $400B annually. That is the market segment that the Amazon Business team is creating solutions for.  

Problem: Over the past many years, individual shoppers in India have come to appreciate the convenience, infinite selection and competitive pricing that Amazon offers.  

While Indian businesses want many of the same benefits listed above, e\-commerce is still not a preferred/ reliable purchase option for them. That is because the needs of the Indian businesses are different from that of individual shoppers and the current state of consumer\-oriented B2C platforms does not fully address the requirements of a business purchase. That is the problem that the PM team at Amazon Business intends to solve. We intend to make buying online as simple, reliable and cost\-effective for businesses as it is for individuals.  

  

This means that the PMs in Amazon Business India have to re\-look at every aspect of the customer's journey \- browsing, selection, price display, checkout, payment, delivery and returns experience and enhance them to fir the needs of the business customer. In addition, the team has to build new products \- approval workflows, GST compliance, multi\-user accounts, spend analytics reports etc. to address unique requirements of Indian business customers. title: Growth Product Manager
description:
**Role : Growth Product Manager** 




**Job Location : Chennai (Work from Office)** 




  





**Brief Description about the role** 




  





 Growth Product Managers at Matrimony.com are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by optimizing the customer journey across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, referral, and monetization. They leverage customer insights, data analytics, experimentation, and product innovation to identify growth opportunities and improve key business metrics.
 



 As the voice of the customer and the business, Growth Product Managers work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, CRM, and Business teams to build and optimize product experiences that accelerate user growth and maximize customer lifetime value across mobile apps, mobile web, and desktop platforms.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Growth Strategy \& Execution** 



* Own and drive key growth metrics across the customer lifecycle, including acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, referral, and revenue.
* Identify growth opportunities through customer research, behavioral analysis, funnel diagnostics, and market intelligence.
* Develop growth hypotheses and design data\-driven experiments to improve conversion and business outcomes.
* Create and maintain a growth roadmap aligned with business objectives and customer needs.



  





**Product \& Experimentation** 



* Define product requirements and work with UX teams to create wireframes, prototypes, and optimized user journeys.
* Lead A/B testing and experimentation initiatives to validate ideas and drive continuous product improvement.
* Optimize onboarding, engagement, subscription, and monetization funnels through iterative product enhancements.
* Drive personalization and recommendation strategies to improve user experience and conversion rates.



  





**Data \& Analytics** 



* Partner with Analytics teams to establish measurement frameworks, track KPIs, and generate actionable insights.
* Monitor product performance and growth metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend corrective actions.
* Use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize opportunities and influence product decisions.



  





**Cross\-functional Leadership** 



* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Marketing, CRM, Sales, Operations, and Customer Success teams to execute growth initiatives.
* Ensure seamless alignment between product strategy, customer experience, and business goals.
* Drive end\-to\-end execution and delivery of growth\-focused product initiatives.



  





**Customer \& Market Understanding** 



* Develop a deep understanding of customer behavior, motivations, and pain points.
* Stay updated on industry trends, consumer internet best practices, competitor strategies, and emerging growth techniques.
* Champion customer\-centric product thinking across the organization.



  





**Skill and Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of growth frameworks including Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral, and Revenue (AARRR).
* Deep customer empathy and ability to translate insights into scalable product solutions.
* Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in data interpretation and experimentation methodologies.
* Experience in A/B testing, funnel optimization, cohort analysis, and growth experimentation.
* Excellent problem\-solving and structured thinking skills.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to balance customer experience and commercial outcomes.
* Ability to independently drive initiatives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Understanding of consumer internet products, mobile ecosystems, and digital marketing channels.
* Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics, or similar platforms.



  





**Education and Experience** 



* Engineering Graduate with MBA from a reputed institution preferred.
* 3–6 years of experience in Product Management, Growth Product Management, or Digital Product roles within Consumer Internet, E\-commerce, Marketplace, Subscription, SaaS, Dating, Social, or Digital Platform businesses.
* Proven track record of driving measurable improvements in customer acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, or revenue metrics.
* Experience working in high\-growth startups or consumer technology companies will be preferred.



  





**About Matrimony.com** 




 Matrimony.com Ltd, a Great Place to Work Certified Wed\-Tech company listed on the BSE and NSE, is a leader in matchmaking and wedding services. Its flagship brand, Bharat Matrimony, is the largest and most trusted matrimony brand (Brand Trust Report 2014\) spanning customers across the entire economic strata. The company serves over 8 million members with the support of 3,000\+ associates and a network of 130\+ company\-owned retail outlets.
 



  





**Key Offerings:** 




  





**Matchmaking Services:** 



* **BharatMatrimony and 200\+ matrimony brands** 
 segmented on religion, languages, communities, and occupation.
* **BharatJodii:** 
 An exclusive matchmaking app for non\-degree holders in 9 Indian languages
* **Assisted Service and EliteMatrimony** 
 : Personalised services for the HNI, NRI and Premium segment of customers



  





**Wedding Services:** 



* **Wedding Bazaar:** 
 Largest wedding services provider.
* **Mandap.com:** 
 Largest online wedding venues platform.
* **MakeMyWedding:** 
 Personalized \& curated wedding planning services.



  





**New Initiatives \& Verticals** 



* **Astro Free Chat:** 
 It is an exclusive app for any astrology consultation
* **ManyJobs:** 
 Employment platform targeting grey collar workforce. In vernacular language for the Tamil Nadu market (initial phase) and with some of industry first features for both companies and candidates

 Matrimony.com has successfully expanded into international markets, with UAE operations thriving for 4\+ years and Bangladesh operations commencing in 2021\. With a mission to dominate the $55 billion wedding services industry.

title: Senior Product Manager II - Identity & Access Management
description:
Here at Appian, our values of
 **Intensity** 
 and
 **Excellence** 
 define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.
 



*Own the Identity and Access Management product roadmap and deliver enterprise\-grade authentication features that secure every connection between Appian and the enterprise.* 




  
 



**ABOUT THE TEAM** 




 The IAM Product team is on a mission to secure every identity, authentication flow, and access point that connects Appian to the enterprise. This team operates with high autonomy and directly influences how global enterprises trust and deploy AI\-Powered Process Automation at scale. Your work will define how millions of users authenticate securely across mission\-critical workflows.
 



  
 



**THE OPPORTUNITY** 




 As enterprises accelerate digital transformation, identity security has become the frontline of platform trust. This role exists because Appian is scaling its authentication and authorization capabilities to meet zero trust demands from the world's most security\-conscious organizations. You will shape how the platform handles federated identity, modern protocols, and seamless user experiences in highly regulated environments.
 



  
 



**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end IAM product roadmap, defining priorities that balance enterprise security requirements with developer and end\-user experience
* Partner with Engineering to evaluate, design, and enhance authentication and authorization capabilities including native authentication and support for SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, and federated identity frameworks
* Execute discovery and requirements gathering with enterprise customers to understand identity provider integrations, compliance needs, and zero trust adoption patterns
* Architect product specifications and user stories that translate complex identity protocols into intuitive, scalable platform features
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with Security, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver authentication features that accelerate enterprise adoption
* Analyze product performance metrics, customer feedback, and competitive positioning to continuously improve IAM capabilities and reduce friction in authentication flows


  
 
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
* 4\+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager with a proven track record of successfully managing products that involve identity and access management
* Deep experience with identity and access management, user authentication, or identity provider software in enterprise environments
* Strong technical proficiency with authentication protocols including SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, and federated identity architectures
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver secure, scalable authentication solutions


  
 
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Knowledge of zero trust architecture principles and implementation strategies
* Experience working with cloud identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity, or Auth0
* Background in cybersecurity, compliance frameworks, or enterprise security product management
* We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise\-Grade Orchestration environment.



**This role is based at our Chennai office in DLF Downtown Chennai.**

Employees hired for this position are expected to be in the office 5 days a week to foster that culture and ensure we continue to thrive through shared ideas and teamwork. We believe being in the office provides more opportunities to come together and celebrate working with the exceptional people across Appian.** 
   
 




**Tools and Resources** 




* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department\-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First\-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee\-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

 healthcare

About the Role

This role is ideal for a performance marketer who has experience marketing **high\-ticket education, personal development, coaching, training, webinars, events, masterclasses or digital learning programs**.

You will be responsible for the complete paid marketing journey — from **audience research, campaign strategy and tracking to lead generation, webinar/event registrations, sales conversion, revenue attribution, optimisation and profitable scaling**.

This is a **high\-ownership role**. We are looking for someone who can independently analyse numbers, identify problems, make decisions and take action to improve business outcomes.

**About the Business**

We are a leading **personal and professional development platform** working with renowned coaches, trainers and speakers to create transformational learning experiences.

Our offerings span **live webinars, masterclasses, personal\-growth programs, business and professional\-development programs, summits and large\-scale learning events**. We work with a diverse ecosystem of Indian and international coaches and speakers across areas such as wealth, business, career, personal growth, performance and professional development.

The business operates across both **digital and physical experiences**, making performance marketing an important part of driving registrations, qualified leads, program sales and revenue.

What You Will Own

1\. Paid Acquisition

* Own performance marketing across **Meta Ads and Google Ads**
* Develop paid acquisition strategies for webinars, masterclasses, events, summits and learning programs
* Plan campaign structures based on business objectives, audience segments and funnel stages
* Manage and optimise significant advertising budgets
* Continuously test audiences, creatives, messaging, offers and campaign structures
* Identify winning campaigns and scale them while maintaining profitability

2\. Funnel \& Revenue Performance

* Manage campaigns across the complete customer journey:
* **Ad → Landing Page → Lead/Registration → Webinar/Event → Sales → Revenue**
* Understand and optimise different funnel models including:
* Lead Generation Funnels
* Webinar Funnels
* Event Registration Funnels
* VSL Funnels
* Masterclass Funnels
* High\-Ticket Sales Funnels
* Retargeting Funnels
* Analyse conversion drop\-offs across the funnel
* Work with funnel and sales teams to improve conversion rates
* Optimise campaigns based on **actual sales and revenue**, not simply lead volume3\. Tracking \& Attribution
* Own and maintain accurate conversion tracking across advertising platforms
* Hands\-on experience with:
* **Meta Pixel**
* **Meta Conversion API (CAPI)**
* **Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)**
* **Google Tag Manager (GTM)**
* **Google Ads Conversion Tracking**
* Track the customer journey from advertisement to lead, registration, sale and revenue
* Identify tracking gaps and coordinate with technology/funnel teams to resolve them
* Ensure campaign optimisation is based on reliable data

4\. Audience \& Customer Research

* Develop a strong understanding of the target audience for different programs and events
* Conduct **ICP and audience research**
* Analyse customer intent, pain points, motivations and buying behaviour
* Build and optimise:
* Cold audiences
* Lookalike audiences
* Retargeting audiences
* Website visitors
* Video viewers
* Lead\-based audiences
* Customer\-based audiences
* Understand the complete customer journey from awareness to purchase

5\. Creative Performance

* Work closely with creative, content and marketing teams to develop high\-performing advertisements
* Identify creative patterns that drive better CTR, CPL, CAC and ROAS
* Analyse creative performance and provide clear briefs for new creatives
* Continuously test:
* Hooks
* Angles
* Ad copy
* Videos
* Creatives
* Offers
* Landing\-page messaging
* Build a structured creative testing and scaling process

6\. Budget Management \& Scaling

* Plan and manage campaign budgets based on performance and business targets
* Identify opportunities to increase spend on profitable campaigns
* Scale winning campaigns without unnecessarily increasing CAC
* Reallocate budgets based on performance
* Understand the relationship between **spend, leads, sales, CAC, revenue and ROAS**
* Balance growth and profitability while scaling

7\. Reporting \& Decision Making

* Prepare weekly performance reports covering:
* Ad Spend
* Leads
* Qualified Leads
* Registrations
* Sales
* Revenue
* CPL
* CAC
* CPA
* ROAS
* Conversion Rate
* Clearly identify:
* **What happened → Why it happened → What needs to change → What will be done next**
* Present actionable insights rather than simply sharing dashboards
* Take ownership of performance improvement based on dataMandatory Requirements
* **3\+ years of hands\-on Performance Marketing experience**
* Experience managing **₹3 Crore\+ cumulative advertising spend**
* Strong hands\-on expertise in **Meta Ads and Google Ads/PPC**
* Proven experience in **Lead Generation and Conversion\-focused campaigns**
* Experience with **Education, Coaching, Training, Personal Development, Events, Webinars or similar businesses**
* Experience working with **Webinar, VSL, Event Registration, Masterclass or Sales Funnels**
* Strong understanding of **CAC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, Revenue and Conversion Rate**
* Hands\-on experience with **Meta Pixel, CAPI, GA4, GTM and conversion tracking**
* Experience integrating landing pages, CRM systems and marketing automation
* Strong understanding of **audience research, ICP, retargeting and customer journeys**
* Proven ability to manage significant budgets and scale profitable campaigns
* Ability to analyse campaign performance based on **sales and revenue**, not just leads
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of performance

What Will Make You Stand Out

You will be a strong fit if you have:

* Managed **high\-ticket education, coaching or personal\-development campaigns**
* Worked on **webinar or event registration funnels**
* Managed campaigns where leads move through a **CRM → Sales Team → Purchase** journey
* Experience scaling campaigns from smaller budgets to significant monthly spends
* A proven track record of improving **CAC and ROAS while increasing revenue**
* Experience running campaigns across multiple products, programs or events
* Experience working with large audiences and nationwide campaigns
* Strong understanding of both **marketing metrics and business/revenue metrics**
* The ability to connect advertising performance with actual business outcomes

Key KPIs

You will be primarily accountable for:

**Revenue \| CAC \| ROAS \| Qualified Leads \| Sales \| CPL \| CPA \| Conversion Rate \| Budget Utilisation \| Profitable Scaling**

Who Should NOT Apply

Please do not apply if:

* Your experience is mainly limited to boosting posts
* You have only handled basic campaign setup
* You know Meta Ads but cannot independently manage Google Ads/PPC
* You optimise only for CPL and lead volume
* You have no understanding of CAC, sales, revenue or ROAS
* You have never worked with funnels
* You have no hands\-on experience with Pixel, CAPI, GA4 or GTM
* You cannot demonstrate the advertising spend you have managed
* You cannot explain the results generated from your campaigns
* You require continuous instructions to optimise campaigns
* You are uncomfortable being accountable for performance and revenue

What We Expect

This is **not a campaign\-execution role**.

We are looking for someone who thinks like a **performance owner**, not simply an ad operator.

You should be able to look at the numbers and independently answer:

**Where are we losing money?**  
**Which campaigns are working?**  
**Which audiences are converting?**  
**Which creatives should we scale?**  
**Why is CAC increasing?**  
**Where is the funnel leaking?**  
**What should we change today?**  
**How can we scale revenue profitably?**

You will work closely with **creative, content, funnel, sales, CRM, technology and leadership teams** to improve the overall customer acquisition engine.

The mindset we are looking for:

**Ownership → Analyse → Test → Optimise → Scale → Measure → Repeat**

If you are someone who enjoys working with numbers, solving performance problems and building campaigns that generate **real revenue**, we would like to hear from you.

Compensation

**₹30,000 – ₹50,000 fixed per month \+ performance\-based incentives**

Higher compensation can be considered for exceptional candidates who can demonstrate strong experience in managing and scaling **high\-spend campaigns with measurable revenue and profitability outcomes**.

Application Requirement

Candidates should be prepared to discuss:

* Total cumulative ad spend managed
* Highest monthly ad spend handled
* Platforms managed
* Types of funnels handled
* Best CAC / CPL / ROAS achieved
* Revenue generated through paid campaigns
* Examples of campaigns successfully scaled
* Tracking and attribution systems implemented
* A specific example where you identified a performance problem and independently solved it

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager - Agentic
description:
**About This Role** 



* We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi\-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
* You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale.
* This is not a pillar\-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end\-to\-end.
* You'll report directly to the
 **Product Director** 
 and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact.
* This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Strategic ownership** 



* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities



  





**Execution leadership** 



* Lead cross\-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data\-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively



  





**Partnership with platform PMs** 



* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success



  





**We're Looking For** 




**Experience shipping one or more of the following:** 




 AI\-native products or features that users love · Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on) · Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization · Cross\-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas · Experiences that balance power with usability.
 



  





**Core capabilities** 



* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non\-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine\-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Shipped copilot or AI\-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross\-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

title: Digital Product Manager
description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 As a Digital Product Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the processes related to the definition and delivery of digital products.  Join us and help shape the future of healthcare through digital innovation.

title: Product Manager II
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
   

  

 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
   

  

 Job Description: Product Manager II
   

  

**Role Summary**
 F5 Digital is building the enterprise AI muscle that will power the next generation of intelligent, secure, and scalable internal platforms. We are seeking an AI Product Manager II to own our AI model ecosystem, token economy, and core agentic platform enablement.
   

  

 This role is responsible for the end\-to\-end management of our LLM stack, developer\-facing AI resources, and token economics. Beyond managing costs and access, this PM will actively support F5’s agentic transformation, building the tools, documentation, and developer experience that make it seamless for engineering teams to build secure and scalable AI agents.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is highly analytical, technically curious, and passionate about the rapidly evolving LLM and agentic software frameworks, combining product execution with a strong focus on developer enablement and platform economics.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Model Ecosystem Management**
* Own the lifecycle of AI models within F5, evaluating, onboarding, and managing access to the latest foundational models (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, open\-source models).
* Partner with platform engineering to ensure seamless, secure, and observable model integration into our developer environments.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the evolving LLM landscape to guide internal development teams toward the right architectures and models.


**Agentic Transformation \& Developer Enablement**
* Serve as the product owner for developer\-facing tooling, SDKs, and APIs that facilitate agentic AI development.
* Support teams across F5 in transitioning from simple prompt\-engineering to complex, multi\-agent workflows and systems.
* Create and curate high\-quality developer resources, sample code, and onboarding paths to accelerate internal agent deployment.


**Token Economics \& Platform Efficiency**
* Own the enterprise token economy: track usage patterns, forecast capacity, and develop optimized pricing and chargeback models.
* Define and track key platform metrics, including model latency, token efficiency, usage anomalies, and cost\-per\-query.
* Partner with Finance and Cloud FinOps to manage and project enterprise AI spend while scaling capacity.


**Governance \& Responsible AI**
* Ensure model access and agent integrations adhere to strict corporate security, privacy, and data governance policies.
* Implement guardrails, logging patterns, and cost controls to reduce model risk and mitigate shadow AI across developer groups.


**Product Ownership \& Execution**
* Manage and prioritize the backlog for model hosting, API routing, token metrics, and developer enablement tools.
* Lead Agile sprints and collaborate closely with systems, platform, and security engineers.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3\+ years of Product Management experience delivering developer platforms, APIs, SaaS, or technical infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI fundamentals (LLMs, API integrations, context windows, token consumption, and model routing).
* Familiarity with agentic concepts (e.g., tool\-calling, agent frameworks, MCP, orchestrators) and a desire to help developers build agents.
* Highly analytical with experience monitoring technical metrics, usage data, cloud spend, or subscription economics.
* Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to build trust with engineering teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with developer platforms, technical documentation, or internal developer relations (DevRel).
* Understanding of cloud governance, FinOps, or managing usage costs for API platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) or secure hosting platforms (Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock).


**What Success Looks Like**
* Maintain a streamlined, secure model\-onboarding pipeline that keeps F5 at the absolute forefront of AI technology.
* Build an intuitive developer experience that reduces the time\-to\-first\-agent for internal engineering teams.
* Establish a completely transparent, observable, and cost\-effective token\-tracking model.
* Mitigate security and cost risk by migrating developers away from unmanaged third\-party APIs to the secure, internal ecosystem.


**Why Join F5 Digital?**
 This is an opportunity to help shape F5’s enterprise AI foundation and build a platform that empowers every team to innovate responsibly with AI. You will work at the intersection of AI strategy, platform engineering, governance, and real\-world business impact—defining how F5 scales intelligent automation across the company.
