title: Product Supply Planning Manager
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role**



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. Our Supply Chain team is growing, and we are looking to strengthen it with a passionate and driven team member. If you are eager to be part of a dynamic, global, and fast\-growing organization—where a positive mindset, personal development, and making a meaningful impact on people's health are valued—we could be the perfect match. As Product Supply Planning Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end supply plan for our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), collaborate across departments, and play an active role in shaping the future of our company.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Create and maintain the supply plan for CMOs on a monthly basis, considering inventory and open orders (firmed and planned), to identify and communicate status to internal and external stakeholders.
* Based on the supply plan, issue Purchase Orders and forecasts to CMOs, and monitor deliveries of purchase orders against requested dates.
* Proactively manage supply constraints to minimize business impact.
* Provide accurate and complete supply planning parameters and purchasing conditions for all SKUs; act as the Expert User for key planning Master Data.
* Set and maintain all required Master Data and ensure its integrity and correctness.
* Create and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external partners.
* Oversee the successful launch of new products into the market, ensuring timely supply, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with manufacturing and distribution teams.
* Propose stock holding levels within the supply chain through a detailed understanding of key planning parameters and the E2E process (safety stock, lead times, supply reliability, demand variability, service objectives), in line with Working Capital targets.
* Perform monthly inventory reconciliations, ensure inventory accuracy, and minimize discrepancies.


**Required Skills and Experience**


* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* Minimum 10 years of proven experience in end\-to\-end (E2E) planning within the pharmaceutical industry, including direct interaction with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) in an international environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities and evolving business needs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with excellent communication abilities.
* Proven track record of effective collaboration with both internal cross\-functional teams and external partners.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks efficiently.
* Quick learner with a proactive and adaptable mindset.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Familiarity with Oracle ERP systems; functional knowledge is an advantage.
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) or equivalent supply chain qualification.
* Experience supporting new product introductions/launches in a regulated (GMP) pharmaceutical environment.
* Experience working across multiple time zones with global CMO networks.


By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Manager - Net Revenue Management
description:
Overview:

RGM strategy Playbook \- Associate plays a pivotal role in our organization, with a primary focus on brand ladder and price pack architecture analysis, Mix Management and Promo Strategy. This role encompasses a range of responsibilities related to optimizing our product and pricing strategies to maximize brand equity, profitability, and consumer engagement.


Key responsibilities of the Brand Ladder / Price Pack Architecture (PPA) Playbook \- Associate include:

* Conducting in\-depth market research and data analysis to identify and evaluate brand positioning / price pack architecture opportunities
* Analyzing consumer behavior and preferences to gain insights into how our brand ladder / pricing strategies impact purchasing decisions
* Developing and refining brand ladder and PPA models and methodologies to streamline decision\-making / enhance operational efficiency
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure that our brand and pricing strategies align with overarching business objectives and regulatory requirements
* Utilizing data\-driven insights to enhance the overall consumer experience and perception of our brands and pricing structures
* Contributing to the long\-term brand and pricing strategy of the organization, actively participating in the creation of innovative approaches to optimize brand equity and profitability


The Brand Ladder / Price Pack Architecture (PPA) Playbook \- Associate leverages advanced analytical skills and tools to shape our brand and pricing strategies, ensuring they are aligned with our strategic goals, compliance standards, and customer satisfaction objectives


Responsibilities:
* Perform advanced analytics using Tableau/Power BI and develop predictive models, regression modeling, price elasticity analysis, and promotion optimization to extract actionable insights from data
* Collaborate on sector NRM strategic projects, such as promotions optimization, terms priorities, competitor benchmarking, and Price Pack Architecture (PPA) initiatives, to drive revenue realization
* Conduct statistical and trend analysis to identify market opportunities, highlight sector strengths, and provide recommended corrective actions to enhance performance
* Monitor existing KPI metrics, develop new relevant metrics, and identify correlations and root causes to support data\-driven decision\-making
* Design and build visualization dashboards to accelerate information\-to\-action at scale, enabling easy access to critical insights for various stakeholders
* Develop programs, methodologies, and reports for analyzing and presenting data, making data\-driven insights accessible and actionable
* Ensure the timely and accurate submission of reports and data to the Revenue Management teams in line with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA)
* Improve the utility of operational and performance data within various teams, supporting Business Intelligence (BI), reporting, analysis, and insights efforts
* Assist the GBS Commercial lead in developing an ongoing training and capability plan for COE associates, ensuring continuous growth and expertise development within the team


Qualifications:

Key Skills/Experience Required

* Broader data analysis capabilities. Previous experience in Consumer Insights, Key account Management, Trade Marketing or CPG consulting
* Experience in pricing and promotions management, demonstrating a deep understanding of pricing strategies, market dynamics, and consumer behavior
* Proven experience working in the Fast\-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) sector with a strong understanding of business processes related to Revenue Management, including promotions, pricing, and sales
* Excellent visualisation skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable solutions and processes, enabling data\-driven decision\-making
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and a strong command of PowerPoint, with the ability to quickly learn various in\-house software applications for data analysis and reporting
* Working knowledge of Power BI software is added advantage
* Ability to function effectively in a team environment and collaborate with individuals across the organization, as pricing and promotions strategies often require cross\-functional teamwork
* Good verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with stakeholders and present findings and recommendations in a clear and compelling manner


Differentiating Competencies Required

  

* Highly organized and responsive, with ability to work to SLAs and tight deadlines
* Numerate thinker, good at data analysis with strong attention to detail
* Language skills \- English fluent
* Excellent written and oral communication skills; proactively communicates using appropriate methods for situation and audience in clear, concise and professional manner
* Ability to work collaboratively and proactively with multi\-functional teams
* Be flexible, organized and able to handle competing priorities
* Ability to combine insights from various data sources

title: Senior Manager - Net Revenue Management
description:
Overview:

ICC is a growing function within PepsiCo that leverages one strategy and common approach to introduce new, technology\-driven capabilities and elevate service quality while meeting current and future business needs. PEP RGM is a key priority function where transformation, technology, strategy and capabilities enablement are aimed to be the best in class, and to be standardized and deployed globally. The vision is to develop playbook to develop analytic packs with insights across Brand Ladders, Channel PPA, In\-Market Pack Price realization, Trade Investment Strategy, Promo ROI and Mix Management. This work will accelerate growth through efficient positioning across price tiers, optimized channel\-based package types, right pricing, well directed commercial strategy and increase promotional ROI driven by enhanced and standardized insights.

  



This position will be part of the ICC \- Revenue growth Management organization. This position contributes to the success of the company and contribute to growth through strategy development, and implementation of RGM frameworks. The incumbement will work for different markets across the globe and work with different stakeholders to develop RGM playbooks and ensure analytics execution


Responsibilities:

Functional Responsibilities

* ICC RGM analyst will be responsible for conducting data analyses across all RGM levers \- Pricing, Promotion, Assortment Mix and Trade Investment
* Lead data aggregation and harmonization that will form the backbone of RGM analytics
* Collaborate with Market Cluster Leads to understand market dynamics and incorporate market feedback into analyses
* Bring out Next Gen Revenue Management insights by implementing advance analytics
* Integrate insights comprehensive summaries for RGM Tower Lead and RGM leader
* Improve understanding of pricing, promotions, pack architecture and trade investments through use of data analytic tools and visualization tools
* Improve processes of analyses and data management across category business units and marketing functions
* Develop observations/insights for each analysis in the RGM playbook and synthesize insights across analyses to create a storyline of opportunities
* Implement continued improvements and simplifications of processes, standardization of reporting and optimal use of technology
* Create an inclusive and collaborative environment
* Adavanced Analytics – Price Elasticity, Promotion Effectiveness and knowledge of Python, R, Tableau/Power Bi


Key Activities


* Perform granular level analysis to identify growth opportunities
* Prepare data for the analyses to be performed (Data Pre\-processing Tools – Alteryx/KNIME exp preferred)
* Understand the nuances of the product category and market to tailor the output according to business needs
* Run the analyses and create visualizations (Power BI and Tableau experience preferred); prepare drill down analyses to derive insights
* Create a storyline out of various analyses output for the business to comprehend the output
* Meet the service level agreements and perform QC of the end\-to\-end analysis
* Expand playbook analytic pack scope to include additional analyses upon alignment with market


Qualifications:
* \+7 years of experience in Retail Analytics/Category Management/Revenue Management
* 2\-3 years of relevant professional experience working with large data sets and experience in CPG /Consulting / ICC Organizations
* Experience in any of the RGM lever practices\- Pricing, Promo, Assortment, Trade Investment
* Strong analytics skills with expertise in data analytics and data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI
* Strong Advanced Analytics acumen, Agile ways of working, managing high end data science
* Prior experience in data analytics to derive data driven insights and consolidate them to generate recommendations
* Experience in developing data\-driven models for sales and marketing function
* Ability to handle multiple work streams simultaneously and to tight deadlines in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience working with stakeholders in North America, LATAM, APAC, or EMEA markets (preferred)
* Very strong analytical skills – excellent competency in MS Excel is a must, as is experience of managing complex, incomplete \& inconsistent datasets and defining strategic analytics (market sizing/growth forecasts etc).
* Experience in Tableau / Power Bi is preferred
* Proven experience using PowerPoint and ability to producing visually compelling presentations (i.e. beyond just operating the software) that are impactful with a senior audience
* Clarity in communication (English language) to enable production of a very high standard of commentary that is impactful and credible amongst our most senior audiences.
* Bachelor’s in commerce/business administration/Engg., Master’s degree is a plus
* Best\-in\-class time management skills, ability to multitask, set priorities and plan

**Position Summary**
 Join athenahealth’s Clinicals division as a Product Manager responsible for a defined product area within the broader portfolio. In this role, you will understand customer needs and market opportunities, contribute to product vision, and define features that meet business and user requirements. You will also work closely with engineering, data science, and design teams to deliver safe, trustworthy, and valuable product experiences, including responsible use of AI in clinical workflows. **About The Team**
 The Mobile team brings together Product Management, Engineering, User Experience, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve the efficiency and experience of healthcare providers. The team works across product strategy, execution, and measurement to deliver both core product capabilities and AI\-enabled solutions where they add value. The team collaborates closely to ensure products are usable, reliable, and aligned with clinical and business needs. This role will support that mission by helping shape product decisions and delivery for an assigned area.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Define and manage the product strategy and roadmap for an assigned product area.
* Work with engineering and scrum teams to prioritize backlog items and guide day\-to\-day delivery.
* Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements that support successful implementation.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to evaluate customer needs, market trends, and business opportunities.
* Contribute to product discovery, including identifying problems, testing concepts, and validating solutions with users and stakeholders.
* Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to shape AI\-enabled features that are usable, measurable, and appropriate for clinical workflows.
* Define how AI\-enabled capabilities should behave, including expectations for trust, explainability, and human oversight where needed.
* Monitor product performance after release and use feedback, data, and user input to guide improvements.
* Support launch planning, adoption activities, and resolution of production issues as needed.
* Use AI\-enabled tools and product analytics to help refine requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and improve decision\-making across product planning and delivery.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Support build\-versus\-buy evaluations for product capabilities.
* Partner with product leadership on release decisions and stakeholder alignment.
* Help manage alpha and beta feedback during product testing and rollout.
* Represent the voice of the customer in product discussions and decision\-making.
* Coordinate with legal, compliance, sales, marketing, and operations partners when needed.
* Contribute to measurement frameworks for product and feature performance.
* Support continuous improvement efforts across the product lifecycle.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or a related field is preferred.
* 5\+ years of product management experience.
* Experience working in an Agile environment preferred.

description:
UNBOXROBOTICS LABS PRIVATE LIMITED
   

  

 UNBOXROBOTICS LABS PRIVATE LIMITED
   

  

**Product Manager (Software)**
 Product Team \| Pune, India \| In Campus
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking a high\-ownership Product Manager to own the complete software surface of our robotics platform — spanning the core robot software stack, fleet management across the sorting systems, AMRs, customer integration pipelines, and the operator\-facing UI applications used on the warehouse floor every day. You will be the single owner of the software experience, from intelligence running on each robot to the dashboard a warehouse manager opens every morning.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Robot Software
* Own the product roadmap for on\-robot software: task execution, navigation APIs, fault recovery workflows, and firmware interface contracts.
* Define acceptance criteria and simulation test suites for robot software releases; monitor live fleet telemetry to surface regressions and prioritise fixes.
* Specify versioned, backward\-compatible API contracts between the robot stack, fleet orchestration layer, and WCS.
* Fleet Management
* Own the Fleet Management System (FMS) roadmap: real\-time task allocation, multi\-robot traffic management, zone\-based routing, and throughput optimisation across heterogeneous fleets.
* Drive fleet health features — battery management, predictive maintenance alerts, automated rebalancing — and define KPIs: utilisation rate, cycle time, deadlock frequency, and MTTR.
* Own fleet provisioning UX: robot registration, map management, zone configuration, and operational parameter tuning.
* Customer Integration
* Own the integration product roadmap: REST/webhook APIs, WMS connectors (SAP EWM, Manhattan, Blue Yonder, Oracle), ERP integrations, and EDI support.
* Define data contracts for order ingestion, sort\-to\-destination logic, and fulfilment callbacks; set SLAs for API uptime, message latency, and retry policies.
* Build and maintain an Integration Playbook — API references, sandbox environments, and code samples — to reduce customer time\-to\-live; productise repeatable connectors into self\-serve modules.
* UI Applications \& Operator Experience
* Own the roadmap for all operator\-facing UIs: Fleet Dashboard, Warehouse Control Console, sorting configuration UI, and mobile floor apps.
* Lead user research with warehouse managers and floor staff; define UX requirements and work with Design to produce wireframes and prototypes.
* Drive design system strategy — component reuse, visual consistency, and WCAG 2\.1 accessibility across all Unbox UI surfaces.
* Execution \& GTM
* Partner with Software, Backend, Frontend, and QA squads for sprint delivery; own stage\-gate reviews from alpha through GA and post\-launch retrospectives.
* Co\-own GTM with Sales: release notes, demo environments, capability matrices, ROI models, and software packaging/pricing frameworks.


****Requirements****
* 2–4 years in Product Management; 2\+ years owning software in robotics, industrial automation, IoT, or enterprise SaaS
* Proven experience across 2\+ of the four product areas: robot software, fleet management, integration products, or operator UI
* Strong grasp of agile delivery, API design, release management, and production observability
* Proficiency in SQL, Python notebooks, or BI tools for metrics and business case development
* Ability to write sharp PRDs, API contracts, and user stories; comfortable working with software, backend, and frontend engineers
* UX research skills user interviews, usability testing, journey mapping with hands\-on experience collaborating with product designers
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management across engineering, customer success, sales, and leadership
* Data\-driven mindset; comfortable defining and tracking product KPIs end\-to\-end


**Good to Have**
* Familiarity with WMS/WCS platforms and warehouse order fulfilment workflows
* Experience with fleet management platforms for AMRs or AGVs
* Exposure to API integration ecosystems — REST, webhooks, event\-driven architectures (Kafka)
* Knowledge of cloud\-native architectures, microservices, and edge compute for robot fleets
* Experience with design systems and WCAG accessibility for industrial UIs
* Prior experience in a high\-growth startup or Series A–C environment


**Qualification**
* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Electronics, Robotics, or related discipline (required)
* MBA or M.Tech in Product / Systems Engineering (preferred, not mandatory)


**We Value**
* Bias for action and ownership mentality in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Portfolio of software products shipped 0→1 or scaled in industrial, logistics, or robotics context
* Ownership mentality you close loops, not just open them
* Systems thinking across robot behaviour, fleet coordination, and operator experience
* Empathy for warehouse operators; comfort translating floor observations into elegant software

 Competitive Salary

title: Product Owner
description:
**Who We Are** 




 Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI\-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.
 



  





 As a Product Owner at Ontic, you will work closely with Product Management, UX Design, QA, and Engineering to ensure product requirements are clearly defined, technically feasible, and delivered with high quality. This role is primarily focused on supporting current and upcoming product releases by creating clarity from ambiguity, maintaining backlog readiness, and enabling Engineering teams to execute efficiently throughout the software development lifecycle.
 



  





 You will serve as the primary Product representative supporting Engineering teams during active development and release. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, excellent communication skills, and the ability to drive alignment across cross\-functional teams. Success will be measured by the quality of requirements, backlog readiness, stakeholder alignment, and the team’s ability to deliver roadmap commitments predictably and on time.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Partner closely with Product Managers to translate product strategy and roadmap initiatives into detailed feature requirements and user stories
* Collaborate with Engineering, UX, and QA teams to refine requirements, clarify business logic, and ensure readiness for development
* Own and manage the team backlog, ensuring priorities are clearly defined and aligned with business objectives
* Write detailed epics, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria
* Lead backlog refinement sessions and support sprint planning activities with Engineering teams
* Work directly with developers during implementation to answer questions, clarify requirements, and support delivery execution
* Partner closely with Engineering to identify delivery risks, dependencies, scope tradeoffs, and requirement gaps in the development lifecycle
* Monitor development progress and proactively address requirement issues that could impact release timelines, scope, or quality
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and defect triage
* Ensure features are fully defined, dependencies are identified, and edge cases are considered prior to development
* Support Product Managers in gathering and synthesizing input from Client Success, Services, and Sales into clear requirements
* Support user acceptance testing, release readiness activities, and post\-release validation
* Continuously improve backlog quality, delivery processes, and cross\-functional collaboration



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 4\-6 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar delivery\-focused product role supporting Agile software development teams
* Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to understand APIs, data flows, system configurations, permissions models, and integration requirements.
* Experience working closely with Agile Engineering teams in a SaaS, preferably B2B, software environment
* Strong experience writing detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and functional requirements
* Proven ability to manage and prioritize a product backlog in a fast\-paced Agile environment
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Technical aptitude and understanding of software development concepts and processes
* Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and product analytics platforms is preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field preferred



  





**You Believe** 



* Clear requirements and strong collaboration lead to better product outcomes
* Solving customer problems requires close partnership between Product and Engineering
* Agile development thrives on communication, transparency, and continuous improvement
* Delivering high\-quality user experiences requires attention to detail and operational excellence



  





**Ontic Benefits \& Perks** 



* Passionate and purpose\-driven team to work with
* Competitive Salary
* Medical Benefits
* Internet Reimbursement
* Meals

title: Product Manager 1
description:
**About AlphaSense:**
---------------------



The world's most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients' own research content.


The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

### **About the Team:**



The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating, licensing and integrating best\-in\-class unstructured and structured data that is both self\-sourced and from third party content providers. The Content teams report to the Chief Content Officer and have strategy, product management, content operations and support responsibilities for each Content vertical. We have been experiencing a rapid growth cycle across all content sets, including the Broker Research team. We value and uphold transparency, trust and accountability in our relationships within the team and with external and internal stakeholders.


### **About the Role:**



We are seeking a Product Manager I to join the Broker Research team. The PM I must have working knowledge of investment research, including the business models and client use cases for research content and associated data. The focus of this role will be the integration and maintenance of third\-party content in AlphaSense. Additional responsibilities will include the need to continuously analyze and enhance processes by working with our agile teams. The candidate must also be capable of articulating and delivering a vision for research and data on AlphaSense.


### **Who You Are:**


* 3\-5 years' experience in financial services with a specific focus on broker research.
* A strong knowledge of broker data, content, and metadata.
* Content delivery experience using iterative / agile development methodologies.
* A proven track record of delivering content from initial engagement to release.
* A superior ability to set priorities, stay focused and meet deadlines.
* Experience working with distributed teams.
* Existing relationships with broker research departments and key third\-party distribution vendors.
* Strong analytical skills and outstanding attention to detail.
* B2B SaaS and/or enterprise software application company experience.
* Solid experience with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace products (Excel, Word, Sheets, etc)

### **What You'll Do:**


* Responsible for the end\-to\-end integration of third\-party content and data feeds.
* Work with external and internal stakeholders to create detailed requirements for broker data and content.
* Collect product \& workflow enhancement requests from brokers \& internal stakeholders.
* Applying agile development methodology and working iteratively with engineers and various stakeholders to define scope and deliver features and improvements rapidly, while iterating to make improvements.
* Work with other members of the broker research team, continuously analyze our processes and tools to identify gaps and areas of improvement.
* Manage and maintain strong broker and independent research relationships with key decision makers; including product, business, technology, and operations teams.
* Project manage partnership initiatives with research providers.
* Create and manage a project roadmap by working with development teams to understand and optimize costs, benefits, and timelines for all aspects of implementation.
* Contributing to the successful launch of content into the market, including the creation of announcements, marketing collateral, documentation, user training and internal training.
* Track industry trends and deliver competitive intelligence to better evolve product vision.

AlphaSense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense's commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non\-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.



In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.



Recruiting Scams and Fraud



We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:


* AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
* All official communications will come from an @alpha\-sense.com email address.
* If you're unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.


If you believe you've been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Senior Product Manager - Technical
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Product Manager \- Technical
Who is Mastercard?
  

  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments sector. We power payments and provide products and services for individuals and industries all around the world. Our people, technology, data and brand provide the capabilities that drive our success. We believe in connecting people to priceless possibilities.  

  

As a company, we know that our success is driven by the skills, experience, integrity and mindset of the talent we hire. By building an inclusive, world\-class culture, our employees have once\-in\-a\-career opportunities to be a part of teams that have a greater impact on our community and our world. We invite you to join our team to find out how you too can start something priceless.
  

  

Overview  

The Senior Product Manager – Technical is responsible for managing the improvement of new and existing product features for both our consumer business and our B2B2C business. This role balances frontend and platform product management, owning UX outcomes across direct UI design and API behavior. The PMT works closely with engineering, UX/design, and cross functional partners to deliver intuitive, scalable, and on brand experiences across the Priceless ecosystem while building foundational technical, product, and business fluency.  

  

Responsibilities  

* Support delivery of end to end Priceless capabilities spanning Priceless.com frontend experiences and platform APIs used by internal teams and whitelisted B2B partners
* Treat APIs as long lived platform products while ensuring the Priceless.com website evolves as a high quality consumer experience
* Contribute to requirements across frontend features, backend services, APIs, request/response behavior, validations, error handling, and session management
* Own UX outcomes through both API behavior and direct UI design, ensuring cohesive, intuitive, and consistent experiences.
* Understand how user experiences shape across Priceless.com consumer journeys and whitelisted external B2B partner sites.
* Define and validate end to end journeys (discovery, eligibility, checkout, payment, confirmation, fulfilment) across UI and APIs.
* Ensure frontend and API decisions collectively support performance, clarity, error recovery, redirects, callbacks, session lifecycle, and third party handoffs.
* Partner closely with UX/design and engineering teams to translate journey intent into UI experiences and supporting API contracts.
* Understand consumers, developers, and B2B partners as distinct customer types and balance UX quality, partner flexibility, and platform consistency.
* Translate business, UX, and platform needs into engineering ready epics, features, and acceptance criteria.
* Participate in agile ceremonies including refinement, planning, and demos; validate outcomes against UX intent, API behavior, and business goals.
* Continuously monitor feature development at the feature level adjusting throughout implementation and post\-launch.
* Leverage AI assisted product workflows to improve effectiveness (e.g., drafting requirements, analyzing feedback and usage patterns, accelerating discovery and iteration) while applying AI responsibly with awareness of data sensitivity and accuracy.

  

All About You  

* Foundational experience or strong interest in technical product management for platforms, APIs, or digital consumer products.
* Ability to reason about UX across both frontend UI and backend APIs.
* Solid understanding of software systems, APIs, and integrations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous learning mindset.
* Experience with consumer facing websites and API driven platforms.
* BA or equivalent education
* 3\-5 years previous experience working with both product/dev and front end teams

  

Nice to Have:  

* Exposure to B2B partner integrations
* Familiarity with AI assisted product workflows
* Awareness of platform governance, security, or compliance considerations

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Product Manager – Shopify & E-commerce
description:
Role Details Industry: Apparel \& Fashion / E\-commerce
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Compensation: Up to 15 LPA \+ ESOP \+ performance based variable
 



 Location: Okhla, New Delhi (Work from Office)
 



  





 The Product Context Our tech stack is Shopify at its core, extended with a constellation of best\-in\-class third\-party integrations — CRM, WMS, loyalty, and beyond. On top of this, we run a native mobile app built in partnership with Appbrew. As we scale, the surface area of product decisions is expanding fast: how customers discover us, how orders flow through our operations, how retention is engineered, and how the app experience keeps improving. You will be the person who holds this entire product landscape together — managing vendors, owning the roadmap, and ensuring every touchpoint is working harder for both the customer and the business.
 



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 • A systems thinker who can hold a complex, integrated tech ecosystem in their head and spot where things are breaking, slowing down, or could work better.
 



 • Deep comfort with Shopify — you understand how apps, themes, and APIs interact, and you know the boundaries of what's native versus what needs a third\-party or custom solution.
 



 • Experience managing or coordinating with external tech vendors and development partners (like Appbrew or similar app\-building platforms) to deliver product improvements.
 



 • Strong data instincts — you are comfortable pulling meaning out of Google Analytics, Klarity, and other tools to identify drop\-off points, UX friction, and growth opportunities.
 



 • Consumer research chops — you know how to talk to customers, run surveys, interpret qualitative feedback, and translate it into product decisions.
 



 • Structured roadmap thinking: ability to prioritise across competing requests from marketing, operations, and leadership, and communicate trade\-offs clearly.
 



 • Bias for ownership — you treat the product like it's your own business and don't wait to be told what needs fixing.
 



 • Clear, crisp communication — written and verbal — with both technical partners and nontechnical stakeholders.
 



  





 What You'll Own
 



 1\. Tech Stack \& Vendor Management
 



 • Own the day\-to\-day health of Salty's entire Shopify ecosystem — core store, integrated apps, and third\-party tools (CRM, WMS, loyalty, and others).
 



 • Be the primary point of contact with Appbrew for our mobile app — driving feature development, managing timelines, and QA\-ing releases.
 



 • Evaluate, onboard, and manage new third\-party solutions as business needs evolve; ensure integrations don't create technical debt or data fragmentation.
 



 • Maintain a clear map of how all systems connect and proactively flag single points of failure or inefficiencies.
 



  





 2\. Roadmap \& Prioritisation
 



 • Build and maintain the product roadmap across the website, app, and internal tooling — balancing quick wins with long\-term capability building.
 



 • Work closely with marketing, operations, and leadership to gather requirements, align on priorities, and communicate timelines.
 



 • Write clear product briefs and specs that external developers and vendors can execute against without hand\-holding.
 



 • Run sprint reviews and track delivery against commitments.
 



  





 3\. Data \& Consumer Research
 



 • Own the data feedback loop: regularly study Google Analytics, Klarity, and other sources to surface drop\-off points, friction in the funnel, and conversion improvement opportunities.
 



 • Run structured consumer research — user interviews, surveys, usability sessions — to understand the customer's relationship with our product and app experience.
 



 • Translate insights from data and research into actionable hypotheses, A/B tests, or product changes.
 



 • Build dashboards or reporting rhythms so that product health metrics are visible to the broader team.
 



  





 Requirements
 



 • 3–5 years of product management experience, preferably in D2C e\-commerce or a consumer tech product.
 



 • Hands\-on familiarity with Shopify — you've worked on or managed a Shopify store before.
 



 • Experience coordinating with external development teams or app vendors to ship features.
 



 • Working knowledge of Google Analytics (GA4\) and CRM/marketing tools like Klaviyo.
 



 • Strong written communication — you can write a PRD, a brief, or a stakeholder update that doesn't require a follow\-up call.
 



 • This is a work\-from\-office role — you must be willing to commute to Okhla, Delhi.
 



  





 Good to Have
 



 • Experience with mobile app product management.
 



 • Familiarity with WMS or OMS tools used in D2C fulfilment.
 



 • Basic SQL or data querying ability — enough to pull your own numbers when needed.
 



 • Prior experience in a high\-growth startup where processes were still being built.

title: Technical Product Manager - Recommendations
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Technical Product Manager** 
 to own data ingestion for Atlys Signals pod the team responsible for collecting, structuring and surfacing the real\-time signals that power Atlys' AI\-driven travel decisions.
   

  

 You'll drive the pipelines, integrations and data quality that keep Signals reliable at scale.
   

  

**The Job**
* Lead automation and AI/ML infrastructure initiatives across data pipelines, model serving, evaluation and monitoring to build reliable, scalable systems.
* Own end\-to\-end execution across Engineering, Product, AI and Operations, driving initiatives from problem definition through delivery and impact measurement.
* Translate complex technical and business requirements into structured execution plans, accounting for AI constraints, dependencies, risks and scalability.
* Track and improve AI system performance through dashboards and metrics such as accuracy, latency, cost and model quality.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment and responsible AI practices, including guardrails, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop review.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 4 to 7 years as a Technical PM or Data PM, ideally owning data pipelines or ingestion systems
* Are comfortable with data architecture and APIs, ETL/ELT, schemas, data quality tooling etc.
* Are structured and detail\-oriented, able to prioritise across many sources and stakeholders.
* Are analytical, using pipeline and data\-quality metrics to guide decisions.
* Communicate well, aligning engineering, AI/ML and product teams around data needs.


*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

**2\. Meta Ads (Facebook \+ Instagram)**

▸ Install and maintain Meta Pixel on callas.in for conversion tracking and retargeting

▸ Create ad creatives — product shots, room setups, assembly reels, price\-comparison graphics

▸ Manage monthly ad budget starting ₹50,000–1,00,000 with clear ROAS targets

▸ Run special campaigns around Amazon/Flipkart sale events to capture deal\-seeking traffic on callas.in

**3\. Instagram (@official.callas)**

▸ Post 3–4 reels per week: assembly time\-lapses, before/after room transformations, unboxing → assembled shots, customer testimonials

▸ Grow from current \~1,400 followers to 10,000\+ in 6 months through consistent content \+ paid promotion

▸ Set up Instagram Shopping (linked to Shopify via Meta Commerce Manager) so products are tappable in posts/reels

▸ Respond to DMs, comments, and inquiries promptly — this is a sales channel, not just branding

▸ Coordinate with factory team for raw content — you'll visit Bahalgarh periodically to shoot assembly/production footage

**4\. Google Shopping \+ SEO**

▸ Set up and manage Google Merchant Center via Shopify's Google channel app (catalog auto\-sync)

▸ Run Google Shopping ads on high\-intent keywords like 'study table under 5000', 'shoe rack with seating', 'DIY bed'

▸ Basic on\-page SEO — product titles, descriptions, blog posts targeting furniture buying queries

**5\. Other Channels**

▸ List top SKUs on Meesho for tier 2/3 city reach

▸ Manage a Callas YouTube channel — upload assembly videos, room setup ideas, product comparisons

▸ Create and maintain a 'Bulk Orders' page on callas.in for B2B/corporate inquiries (co\-living spaces, hostels, offices)

▸ Pinterest — pin room setup photos with product links

**Using Claude (AI) as a Core Work Tool**

This is non\-negotiable. We use Claude (by Anthropic) as a daily productivity tool across the business. You will be trained on it and expected to use it for:

**Ad copy \& content** — Listing optimization

▸ Upload Amazon/Flipkart keyword data → Claude analyzes gaps, rewrites titles, bullets, descriptions with the right keywords baked in

**PPC optimization** — Ad performance analysis

▸ Download weekly Search Term Reports, Campaign Reports → upload to Claude or the Callas Ops Console (internal tool) → get exact actions: which keywords to scale, which to negative\-match, which bids to change

**Content creation** — Creative briefing

▸ Use Claude to draft Instagram captions, ad copy variations, email sequences, blog posts, product descriptions — then edit for brand voice

**Market intelligence** — Competitor analysis

▸ Paste competitor listings, reviews, or Brand Analytics exports into Claude → get positioning insights, keyword gaps, content improvements

**Weekly summaries** — Reporting

▸ Use Claude to turn raw data (Shopify analytics, Meta ads dashboard, Google Analytics) into concise weekly reports with action items for the founder

You don't need prior experience with Claude specifically — we'll train you. But you must be comfortable working with AI tools, prompting them effectively, and integrating them into daily workflows rather than doing everything manually.

**RequirementsMust Have**

▸ 1–3 years of hands\-on experience running a Shopify or similar e\-commerce store

▸ Proven experience running Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns with measurable ROAS results — show us your numbers

▸ Working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, Ads Manager, Pixel setup, and audience building

▸ Basic design skills — Canva at minimum; Figma or Photoshop is a plus. You'll make creatives, not just brief them

▸ Comfortable with data — you'll read spreadsheets, ACOS/ROAS numbers, and weekly reports. No fear of numbers

▸ Strong written communication in English and Hindi — ad copy, captions, product descriptions

▸ Self\-starter mentality — you'll be the only person on this function. No one will tell you what to do each

title: Associate Product Manager (MyBiz)
description:

 Location: Gurugram
   

  

**About The Function**
 The Product Management function at MakeMyTrip sits at the core of how we build, scale, and reimagine travel. By bringing together technology, data, design, and business insight, it creates seamless experiences for millions of travelers across discovery, personalization, payments, and loyalty.
   

  

 Our PM teams act as mini\-CEOs — shaping strategy, translating insights into impact, and pushing the boundaries of travel tech to make MMT a truly product\-first organization.
   

  

 Within this, myBiz — MakeMyTrip's comprehensive business travel suite — is redefining how organizations manage corporate travel end to end. The Post Sales charter focuses on everything that happens after a booking is made: servicing, support, modifications, and issue resolution, ensuring corporate travelers and travel admins get a fast, reliable, and delightful experience at every step.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Product Manager role for myBiz Post Sales is centered around building high\-impact, AI\-led solutions that transform how corporate travelers are serviced after booking. The incumbent will own the Voice Bot and conversational AI experience within the post\-sales journey — driving automation, deflection, and quality across customer interactions.
   

  

 A core focus of this role is leveraging AI to power the Voice Bot, systematically measuring and improving its quality through evaluation frameworks (Evals) and customer frustration scoring, and continuously expanding the range of use cases the bot can resolve autonomously. A key success metric is measuring actual agent handoff and consistently reducing it through smarter, higher\-quality automation.
   

  

 This role demands a strong product mindset, comfort with AI/ML\-driven products and data, and close collaboration with business, tech, design, and analytics teams. The Product Manager will be expected to deeply understand post\-sales pain points, prioritize impactful initiatives, and deliver outcomes that improve customer experience and operational efficiency for myBiz.
   

  

 What will you be doing
   

  

* Owning the AI\-powered Voice Bot roadmap for the myBiz post\-sales journey — conceptualizing and building accurate, scalable, and impactful conversational experiences that resolve customer needs autonomously.
* Defining and driving the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI\-led servicing to deliver measurable improvements in automation, deflection, and customer satisfaction.
* Building and operationalizing Evals (evaluation frameworks) to measure Voice Bot quality, accuracy, and reliability, and driving consistent quality improvements based on these signals.
* Defining, measuring, and improving customer frustration scores across bot interactions, and using these insights to refine flows and responses.
* Measuring actual agent handoff rates and driving initiatives to systematically reduce handoffs through higher\-quality automation and expanded coverage.
* Continuously identifying and adding new post\-sales use cases for the Voice Bot to handle, expanding automation coverage while maintaining quality.
* Collaborating closely with technology, design, QA, supply, finance, AI/ML, and customer support teams to ensure seamless execution of product releases.
* Owning and tracking key product KPIs, analyzing performance continuously, and iterating post\-launch to strengthen adoption and experience.
* Building strong product insights through consistent customer engagement, conversation analysis, market research, and competitive benchmarking.
* Creating a seamless and differentiated service experience for corporate travelers and travel admins within the myBiz ecosystem.
* Demonstrating a passion for data, problem\-solving and simplifying complex experiences to deliver intuitive, high impact solutions.


 Qualification \& Experience
   

  

* Management graduate from a reputed institute with 1\-3 years of experience in a consumer\-facing, technology\-enabled business or product environment.
* Exposure to AI/ML\-driven products, conversational AI, or automation is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment.


 Key Success Factors for the Role
   

  

* Customer Centricity: A deep passion for understanding and improving customer and partner experiences.
* Ownership \& Execution: Ability to translate ideas into impactful products through structured execution and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Strategic Thinking: Aptitude for building long\-term product vision aligned with business goals.
* Analytical Rigor: Data\-driven approach to problem\-solving and decision\-making, especially around Evals, quality metrics, and handoff reduction.
* Innovation \& Agility: Eagerness to experiment with AI, learn quickly, and adapt solutions to dynamic market needs.
* Communication \& Influence: Strong ability to articulate product vision and rally teams around shared outcomes.

title: Data Products Manager
description:
**About 1Lattice:**



1Lattice™ is a 360\-degree business decision support platform with a tech\-enabled services stack of data, people network, and custom research. Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data\-gathering approaches, 1Lattice offers an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation, Execution and Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping them solve a wide variety of business and organizational problems through actionable research\-led insights.

  


**About the role**



We are looking for a Data Products Manager who can research markets and businesses, organise data and turn it into useful insights. The role involves working with information from websites, reports, databases, APIs and other external sources.



The person should be comfortable understanding a business problem, finding the right data, structuring it properly and presenting clear findings. This is primarily a research and analytics role, not a machine learning role.

  


**Key responsibilities**


* Research industries, markets, companies, competitors and customers.
* Understand business questions and decide what information and data are required.
* Find relevant data from public sources, government portals, company websites, reports, databases and APIs.
* Collect and combine information from spreadsheets, PDFs, websites and other sources.
* Create and maintain data models for business entities, attributes and relationships.
* Clean, standardise, validate and remove duplicate data.
* Use SQL, Excel and Python to analyse data and identify trends, gaps and opportunities.
* Prepare market sizing, benchmarking, company profiling and comparative analysis.
* Build simple scoring and classification models where required.
* Document data sources, definitions, assumptions and limitations.
* Present findings through reports, presentations and dashboards.
* Work with product and engineering teams when research or data needs to be included in a product.

  


**Required skills**


* Strong business and secondary research skills.
* Good understanding of business models, industries and market structures.
* Strong Excel and SQL skills.
* Working knowledge of Python, especially Pandas.
* Good understanding of relational data modelling.
* Experience cleaning and combining data from multiple sources.
* Ability to define metrics, categories and scoring methods.
* Basic knowledge of APIs and web scraping using tools such as BeautifulSoup, Scrapy or Playwright.
* Ability to explain findings clearly to business and product teams.

  


**Education and experience**


* B.Tech in a relevant discipline or an MBA from a recognised institution.
* 3–6 years of experience in business research, data analytics, market intelligence, consulting or a related role.
* Experience working with incomplete or unstructured business data.

  


**Preferred experience**


* Experience in a consulting, research, analytics or data\-driven product company.
* Experience with external business, consumer, healthcare, financial, demographic or geographic datasets.
* Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, Metabase or a similar visualisation tool.
* Exposure to statistical analysis, geospatial data or LLM\-based information extraction.

  


**What we are looking for**



The ideal candidate is curious, detail\-oriented and comfortable working with incomplete information. They should be able to investigate a topic independently, question the quality of a source and organise the findings in a way that others can use.

title: Associate Corporate Relation Support Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking. for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further

 **International Mid Markets**


HSBC provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from large corporates to mid\-market enterprises in a variety of industry sectors all over the world. Leveraging the strength, scope and expertise of our global product network, International Mid markets (IMM) is positioned as an essential partner to large and mid\-market enterprises seeking to maximize their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the IMM Banking team in Gurgaon as Corporate Banking Manager

 **Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Delivery of revenue and asset/liability target(s) from existing portfolio of clients and the acquisition of new clients in a responsible manner and compliant with HSBC policies.
* Assist HSBC to attain its strategic growth targets in line with Portfolio Returns target of the bank and undertake cross sell initiatives to achieve the same. Focus would be to acquire and grow banking wallets in companies with international footprint .
* To regularly monitor and screen portfolio for early warning signals and take corrective actions as appropriate. To complete the Annual Reviews in a time bound manner and ensure housekeeping , approval conditions and covenant monitoring are tracked and closed in a timely manner.
* Mentoring of ARMs to deliver a broad base contribution to meet the client's needs and support ARM’s development.
* To liaise with various internal stakeholders (Risk, CDT OPS, GPS, GTS, etc) and ensure efficient servicing of corporate customers and capturing of wallet opportunities
* Ensure timely compliance with all FCC requirements for the portfolio. Ensure implementation of all audit and regulatory recommendations and constant monitoring/ review of the assigned portfolio.
* Demonstrate leadership in all aspects of your role, set exemplary standards, values and behaviours consistent with our Group values.
* Protect the reputation and integrity of the HSBC Brand. This should be evidenced by overall conduct ("do the right thing") and by proactively demonstrating active compliance with both the letter and the spirit of applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, procedures and Global Standards together with the management of risks including , but not limited to Credit, Operational, Regulatory (including Financial Crime), Reputational and Sustainability. Demonstrating through escalating and speaking up, a proactive approach to identifying when things go wrong or when potential risk issues are identified
* Proactively identify financial crime risks (AML, Sanctions and AB\&C) utilizing available tools / support functions as appropriate and undertaking all requisite actions to mitigate/eradicate unacceptable risk.

 **Qualifications**

  

* CA/MBA with relevant experience ( min 5 years ) in a client management and corporate banking role.
* Sound commercial banking skills including knowledge of credit and lending , trade and treasury products ,key market sectors, local regulatory environment, financial analysis etc.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to interact and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Ability to work on fast turnarounds, tight deadlines \& handle competing priorities
* **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.

  

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

 *Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

title: International Product Growth Manager, India
description:
Meta's mission is "Building the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible."\~90% of people use our products from outside of North America, and we continue to expand internationally. We play a crucial role in breaking down the barriers for the international community to support our mission. If this excites you, we have a unique opportunity for you to join our dynamic team and help us achieve local at a global scale!As an International Product Growth Manager for India, you will ensure that Meta is locally relevant and successful in the region. With your deep understanding of the local product landscape and cultural context, you will identify product gaps, uncover growth opportunities, and drive the execution of growth initiatives for India.We're looking for a self\-driven individual with extensive knowledge of the market and products, and a passion for driving product growth to serve the needs of the international community. If you are ready to make a difference for your market through the Meta family of apps, we highly encourage you to apply!  

  

  

### **International Product Growth Manager, India Responsibilities:**

* Ensure the Meta family of apps is well adapted to be successful in India
* Provide local insights — identify strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats relevant for Meta's success in India
* Explore and identify strategic growth opportunities in India leveraging internal and external resources as well as in\-country activities
* Drive solutions that address the identified market\-specific opportunities
* Influence and partner with product teams to execute on the solutions
* Partner with the analytics team to identify high\-impact opportunities, validate key findings, and measure impact of execution

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of experience in product management, product growth, or business strategy
* Experience in the understanding of the India market, including its unique challenges and opportunities
* Native fluency in one or more indigenous languages used in India, such as Hindi, as this role requires the understanding of local product landscape and cultural context to develop solutions
* Excellent communication and collaboration experiences, with the ability to work effectively with and influence cross\-functional teams such as engineering, product management, and analytics across different countries and cultures, in English

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in data analysis and problem\-solving, with experience in interpreting data to inform decision\-making
* Experience working in a global environment across multiple time zones
* Experience working effectively in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal direction
* Experience working in startups or entrepreneurial ventures
* Experience with building products tailored to India

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

  

  

  

  

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Senior Customer Experience Manager
description:
What is this role all about?
 



 As a
 **Senior Customer Experience Manager** 
 , you will own the
 **technical success, customer experience, and long\-term growth** 
 of a portfolio of enterprise accounts on the Kapture platform. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to drive successful implementations, platform adoption, integrations, and value realization.
 



 You will act as a trusted advisor to customers while leading internal teams across Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to deliver solutions that address customer business needs. The role combines
 **customer relationship management, project and delivery ownership, technical solutioning, and business value realization** 
 .
 



  





 What will you do in this role?
 


* **Own enterprise customer success:** 
 Take end\-to\-end ownership of customer health, adoption, technical success, and long\-term account growth.
* **Lead and develop the team:** 
 Monitor team performance, provide coaching and feedback, build accountability, and ensure consistent delivery standards.
* **Build strategic customer relationships:** 
 Establish trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, manage multiple stakeholders, and drive a structured operating cadence.
* **Drive implementations \& change requests:** 
 Own the delivery of new implementations, enhancements, and change requests in close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
* **Drive adoption \& value realization:** 
 Identify opportunities to improve product adoption, platform utilization, customer experience, and measurable business outcomes.
* **Lead technical solutioning:** 
 Understand customer requirements and translate them into scalable solutions, guiding internal teams on feasibility, approach, integrations, and implementation.
* **Manage complex integrations:** 
 Work with APIs, JSON, webhooks, databases, CRM integrations, and other enterprise systems to ensure seamless platform adoption.
* **Own critical escalations:** 
 Lead complex technical and customer escalations, drive root\-cause identification, coordinate resolution across teams, and ensure timely communication to stakeholders.
* **Drive stakeholder communication:** 
 Provide regular updates on implementation progress, risks, dependencies, escalations, and business outcomes to customer and internal stakeholders.
* **Partner cross\-functionally:** 
 Work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support to represent the customer's voice and drive timely resolution of customer requirements.
* **Identify growth opportunities:** 
 Understand customer business priorities and identify opportunities for deeper adoption, additional use cases, and account expansion.



  





 What does success look like in this role?
 



 Success in this role means delivering exceptional customer experiences while driving measurable business outcomes. You consistently ensure customers adopt the platform effectively, resolve technical challenges efficiently, build executive relationships, improve customer health, and identify opportunities for expansion. Your ability to combine technical expertise with business consulting helps customers maximize the value of Kapture's platform while contributing to retention and revenue growth.
 



  





 What would make you a good fit for this role?
 



 Basic Requirements
 


* 5–7 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, or Enterprise SaaS.
* Experience managing enterprise customers across both business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, onboarding, adoption, retention, and stakeholder management.
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, troubleshooting, and enterprise SaaS implementations.
* Ability to manage multiple customer engagements while collaborating effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams.



  





 What are the most critical skills for this role?
 


* Strong customer\-first mindset with ownership of customer outcomes and business success.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for customers.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with experience debugging integrations and resolving technical issues.
* Familiarity with monitoring and debugging tools such as Kafka, Grafana, Sentry, or similar platforms.
* Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify adoption gaps, customer risks, and account growth opportunities.
* Excellent cross\-functional collaboration skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.
